chapters.title: Chapter 1401: Capture Ning Huayin
paragraphs: Ning Huayin had arrived at the Twin Flames Main Domain, and she was quite surprised by the changes in it. "Before the Endless Night Dungeon appeared, this domain had not changed at all compared to its previous state. However, this domain has now become a dense forest, hiding all the sects within it."
Ning Huayin ignored the changes occurring in the Twin Flames Main Domain, mainly because she was carrying out an important task from Xuan Meiyun.
Just as Ning Huayin was about to leave for the Moonlit Passion Sect, Tian Kui and Serpentera appeared and surrounded her, which made her nervous because they were stronger than her.

’Crap! Are they both protectors of the sect? Since when did they get two such powerful protectors? Their strength is on par with my Empress, at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.’ Ning Huayin stiffened once Tian Kui restricted her movements, and his sharp gaze made her break out in a cold sweat. "Senior, I—"
"Shut up." Tian Kui released his aura, making her even more terrified of him.
Serpentera asked her. "Where are you from? Who is your leader? Why did you come here?"

’Ugh! Hun Lingwu should have told my Empress about these two powerful beasts!’ Ning Huayin was truly terrified of them. "Seniors, my name is Ning Huayin, and I am a member of the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race. My Empress asked me to come to this domain, and she asked me to investigate a man named Zhang Fei."
Tian Kui and Serpentera raised their eyebrows. "Who is your Empress? Why did she order you to investigate our master?"
"Is... is Zhang Fei really the master of you two, Seniors?" Ning Huayin was stunned in shock.
"Heh!" Tian Kui snorted at her. "Tell us the truth or we’ll kill you right now."
Cold sweat dripped from Ning Huayin’s body even more. "A man named Hun Lingwu came to my Empress, and he offered pills that were beneficial for our breakthrough as payment for capturing Zhang Fei."
"That old man truly hasn’t changed." Serpentera shook his head.
Tian Kui asked him, "What should we do with this spider woman? Should we take her to the sect and wait for our master to emerge from seclusion?"
"Yes." Serpentera nodded to him. "We should take this female spider to our master, and we can hand her over to one of his wives."
"Alright." Tian Kui made a move to seal the female spider’s cultivation. "Let’s go back."
’Ugh! I’m dead! Zhang Fei will kill me!’ Ning Huayin muttered in her heart.
Upon arrival at the Moonlit Passion Sect, Tian Kui took Ning Huayin to the residence behind the mountain and handed her over to the woman there before returning to his post.
Ning Huayin was shocked when she saw Tianshi Shengjie there, and she immediately recognized her identity as the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race. ’Shit! Why is this woman here?’
"Do you know her, Shengjie?" Luo Yunxiao asked her.

"No." Tianshi Shengjie shook her head in response. "However, I know the leader of the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race, and Xuan Meiyun is a cheap woman who is willing to do anything to improve her cultivation. She likes to find men and kill them by draining their Yang Qi, but no one dares to attack her because her targets are small clans. She made a fatal mistake by agreeing to Hun Lingwu’s offer, and Zhang Fei will kill her."

Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "Hun Lingwu seemed to be aware of my husband’s actions towards him, but he didn’t dare to attack us openly, mainly because of his relationship with Feng Yao. Therefore, he used other people to take revenge on him, and the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race was one of them."

"Yes." Tianshi Shengjie turned to her. "It’s just that I’m confused about how that old man could know about Zhang Fei’s actions, even though he had already erased some of his memories, especially about him and this sect."

Luo Yunxiao fell into deep thought and considered several possibilities. "After all, that old man is an experienced soul cultivator, and he might have a way to restore his memories that my husband had erased. If my guess is correct, he can remember my husband, and he might realize that the mirror has disappeared."
"You might be right about that him." Tianshi Shengjie sighed softly. "I’m not a soul cultivator, so I don’t understand that field very well, and your guess about that old man might be correct."

Ning Huayin’s eyes widened when two other women landed beside Luo Yunxiao, and she immediately recognized their identities. ’Shit! What was the first princess of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race in this sect doing? If I’m not mistaken, the woman next to her is the second princess of the demon race. However, she had been missing for a long time, and no one knew her whereabouts.’
"Who is this woman, Big Sister?" Nalan Yushu crouched in front of Ning Huayin, making her even more frightened by their presence.

"If I’m not mistaken, she’s a subordinate of Xuan Meiyun, the leader of the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race." Nalan Wangzi turned to the two other women, who immediately explained to her that the two ancient beasts captured Ning Huayin. Her empress ordered her to search for information about Zhang Fei, mainly because Hun Lingwu offered valuable pills to capture him. "Hahaha! Her empress is a stupid woman, and she too easily fell for the old man’s offers. She should be wondering why the old man doesn’t dare attack us directly, and he’s asking for her help to do that."

Nalan Yushu observed Ning Huayin’s body before speaking. "I’m sure my husband won’t be interested in this woman, especially since she has a lot of yang qi in her body, which means she has slept with many men."

"That’s right." Nalan Wangzi nodded to her sister. "The Black Lotus Spider Beast Race is a group of prostitutes, both male and female. They use other people’s bodies to improve their cultivation, and they will drain their yin and yang qi clean, which leads to their deaths. My brother-in-law may not be interested in them, but he can use them for other things, such as monitoring the old man."
"Hehehe." Luo Yunxiao chuckled. "My husband doesn’t need to use them to monitor the old man, and he must have left something in his body that is undetectable for him to monitor him."

Nalan Wangzi nodded in agreement. "My brother-in-law is indeed cunning, so I am not surprised if he uses other means to monitor the old man, and he probably already knows the steps taken by him. However, the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race is still useful to us, so I hope he does not exterminate them, and he uses them for our benefit."
"By the way, where is Zhang Fei now? Why isn’t he back yet?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.

The three women could only shake their heads at her, especially since Zhang Fei hadn’t said anything to them. "His real body is with Qi Qingxiu in the Seven Emotions Demon Domain to accompany him, and his third clone is in the training space to monitor Zhang Lin. His fifth clone may still be in the training space, but I don’t know the whereabouts of his other three clones."

Ning Huayin was utterly shocked as she listened to Luo Yunxiao’s words, especially regarding Zhang Fei’s five clones. She was also shocked that he had such a relationship with the Seven Emotions Demon God, Qi Qingxiu. ’Crap! My empress made a fatal mistake by accepting the old man’s offer, and he will definitely do something to her later.’

"For now, we just need to wait for him to return, and we’ll await his plans for the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race." Luo Yunxiao picked Ning Huayin up and carried her into their residence, followed by the other three women.
Ning Huayin was even more shocked when he saw hundreds of women inside the residence; moreover, all those women were Zhang Fei’s women.

After a long time passed, Zhang Fei [5] stopped helping Yin Yue and Tian Taiyang. "I think this process is enough for now, and we will continue again in a few days. You two have been dead for a long time, so your soul power has weakened quite significantly, and it will take me quite a while to help you recover it. Perhaps, I need a few years to help your souls recover, and you can reform your bodies by then."
"Haha." Tian Taiyang laughed at that. "I’ve been dead for a long time, and I never thought I’d have a chance to live again, so it’s no problem for me to wait a few years to reshape my body."

Yin Yue nodded in agreement with him. "Thank you for all your help so far, Zhang Fei. Not only did you save me from death and free me from my imprisonment, but you also helped me strengthen my soul enough to reform my body."
"No problem at all." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Yin Ling. "Why did you suddenly decide to give the fragment of the Moon Flame to me?"
Yin Ling shook her head at him. "You’ve helped my master recover her soul over the past few months, so you can consider the fragment of the Moon Flame as my repayment."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] said to those people. "I’ll come back later to help you two recover your souls."

chapters.title: Chapter 1402: Meet Xuan Meiyun
paragraphs: After Zhang Fei [5] returned to his residence behind the mountain, Luo Yunxiao brought Ning Huayin to him. She told her about the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race and their leader, Xuan Meiyun.
Ning Huayin raised an eyebrow when she saw Zhang Fei [5], but she was confused by Hun Lingwu’s reason for not capturing him himself, especially since his cultivation was too low.
Zhang Fei [5] glanced at Ning Huayin. "How strong is that spider woman?"
"Her cultivation is at the 3-Sun Celestial Realm." Tianshi Shengji answered him.
Nalan Wangzhi asked him. "Are you going to capture that woman, brother-in-law?"

"Yes." The three women looked at Zhang Fei [5] seriously, making him laugh. He pinched their cheeks one by one before explaining. "I have no interest in a cheap woman like Xuan Meiyun, but I can use her and her race for other purposes, such as creating protection in this domain. Although Bian Zhizhu has excellent defensive abilities, her cultivation is still far lower than hers. That’s why I want to capture her and use her to create protection in this domain, which will prevent people like Hun Lingwu from coming here."
Luo Yunxiao nodded in understanding. "In that case, let’s go to the Stygian Dusk Domain right now."

"Hmm? If I remember correctly, the Dusk Pavilion is also in that domain, right?" Luo Yunxiao nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "We’ll go see Xuan Meiyun, and we’ll go to the sect afterward. I’m sure Linghu Minghua is still recovering from his battle with Jian Xianzu several months ago, so this is a good opportunity to get rid of him, and I’ll hand him over to my parents-in-law."
"What about this woman?" Nalan Wangzi pointed at Ning Huayin.

"Just leave her here." Zhang Fei [5] contacted Qing Qiu’er and told her about his plans to go to the Stygian Dusk Domain, but she hurried to the residence because she wanted to join them. "Let’s go now."
’Crap! My empress will definitely be captured by them.’ Ning Huayin said in her heart.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Stygian Dusk Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]

When they arrived there, Zhang Fei [5] opened the map to locate Linghu Minghua and Xuan Meiyun’s location. After he found the location of the queen of the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race, he immediately brought them there.

As they descended into the palace, the two gate guards were shocked by their sudden arrival. They were even more shocked when they recognized Tianshi Shengji and Qing Qiu’er, and it was impossible for guards like them to fight the two women.
Before they could escape, Zhang Fei [5] hastily suppressed their bloodlines, causing them both to fall to the ground, as they were inferior to his.

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t kill them or knock them unconscious. He immediately led the women into the palace as he activated the soul link to borrow the power of the evil beasts in his beast space. Although their numbers were small because he sent them to other domains to protect his wives there, it was enough to raise his cultivation to the 3-Star Celestial Venerable Realm.

As they walked into the palace, Zhang Fei [5] made all the spider beasts there fall unconscious. Several powerful spider beasts tried to stop them, but all of them failed because his bloodline was simply superior to theirs.
Tianshi Shengji shook her head at his action. "Our presence here is unnecessary, and he can deal with all these spiders alone, including Xuan Meiyun."
"Haha." Qing Qiu’er chuckled. "I was a little bored staying in our sect, so I wanted to go for a walk. It just so happened that he wanted to go to this domain, so I chose to tag along."
Nalan Wangzi spoke. "As long as our enemies are not for perils, no one will be able to stop my brother-in-law, including Xuan Meiyun."

"However, Linghu Minghua is not a beast like them, and his cultivation is also at the 3-Star Celestial Venerable Realm." Luo Yunxiao turned to Qing Qiu’er. "You have to help our husband to fight that man, Sister Qiu’er."

Qing Qiu’er nodded at her. "I’ve known your parents for a long time, and we’re sisters from one husband now, so they’re my family too. I’ll beat Linghu Minghua black and blue, and I’ll hand that man over to them."
"Hahaha." Luo Yanxio laughed at that. "I feel amused when I remember my mother being jealous of you, and she repeatedly said that you were a temptress."

Qing Qiu’er let out a helpless sigh. "Your mother already knew that I didn’t have a romantic relationship with your father, but her jealousy was too strong, and she disliked me because of our closeness. Luckily, I have now found my husband, so she shouldn’t be jealous of me anymore."
"Yeah."
Before long, they arrived at the throne room, but many spider beasts were waiting for them there, and their strengths varied.

Xuan Meiyun sat on her throne, and her eyes moved over them one by one. She was not surprised by Qing Qiu’er’s presence, mainly because she was the sect master of the Moonlit Passion Sect. She was shocked when she saw Tianshi Shengjie and Nalan Wangzi, especially since she recognized their identities. However, she was unable to recognize Luo Yunxiao, mainly because her parents hid her whereabouts for hundreds of years.

Xuan Meiyun looked at Zhang Fei [5] before being shocked by his cultivation, and she also felt the powerful pressure from his Heavenly Fox Bloodline, even though he was not using his half-fox form or full beast form, which made her realize that she was not his opponent.

Xuan Meiyun was utterly shocked when the sword pressed against her neck, and she glanced behind her, finding Zhang Fei [5] already standing there holding the Demon Extermination Sword. ’Shit! How can he move so fast? All the spiderwebs I’ve set up here haven’t moved at all, which means he didn’t touch them while he was moving.’

Zhang Fei [5] pressed his sword harder, causing Xuan Meiyun’s neck to bleed. "You can forget about escaping from me since your speed and bloodline are inferior to mine, and I will behead you if you dare move. Tell me, what did Hun Lingwu promise you to capture me?"

’Shit! This kid is much scarier than that experienced cultivator.’ Xuan Meiyun broke out in a cold sweat and answered him directly. "Hun Lingwu promised me his pills to help my subordinates break through."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow for a moment before taking out some beast pills from his inventory, showing them to Xuan Meiyun. "My pills are much more useful to beasts like you than the old man’s, but I will give them to you on one condition: you and your race must submit completely to me. If you are all loyal to me, I will give you better pills than these, and you will not regret being my follower."

Xuan Meiyun frowned upon hearing that, but Zhang Fei [5] gave the bottles to her and asked her to examine them herself. She was shocked again when she peeked at the pill bottles, especially since all the pills inside were superior grade.

Zhang Fei [5] took the pill bottles back from her and put them away. "That old man might be able to concoct superior-grade pills, but he won’t be able to concoct my pills, which are specifically designed for beasts like you and your subordinates. If you bring members of your race to my side, I will give these pills to all of them as well. That way, they can reach a higher level, and they will also have a chance to evolve. However, I hate traitors the most, and I will kill you all if you guys betray me. So, what’s your answer?"

Xuan Meiyun pondered over Zhang Fei [5]’s offer. His offer was indeed attractive, and his pills were extremely valuable, but he did not want to become someone else’s underling. If she became his subordinate, she would lose her freedom, and she would have to obey him for the rest of her life, which was unacceptable to her.

Even so, Zhang Fei [5]’s pills were extremely useful to her and her subordinates, which put Xuan Meiyun in a dilemma. She wanted his pills to become even more powerful, and her race could also benefit from them.

However, Xuan Meiyun wanted to continue living as she was now and not have anyone control her, but she realized that Zhang Fei [5] wouldn’t let them go, which was due to her decision to follow Hun Lingwu’s request.

Zhang Fei [5] spoke again. "If you decide not to side with me, then you and the members of your race are my enemies, and I will wipe you all out right now. If you want to blame someone for your situation, then you can blame yourself, especially since you gave in to that old man’s wishes just for the sake of his pills."
’Tch! Damn Hun Lingwu! He got me into this situation.’ Xuan Meiyun finally made up her mind. "I’ll follow you! I hope you don’t do anything to my race."

"I’m a man of my word." Zhang Fei [5] pulled Xuan Meiyu’s soul out of her body, which shocked her. He duplicated her soul, merged it with his, and returned her original soul to her body. "From now on, you and your race are my subordinates, understand?"

"However, Linghu Minghua is not a beast like them, and his cultivation is also at the 3-Star Celestial Venerable Realm." Luo Yunxiao turned to Qing Qiu’er.
"You have to help our husband to fight that man, Sister Qiu’er."
Qing Qiu’er nodded at her.
"I’ve known your parents for a long time, and we’re sisters from one husband now, so they’re my family too.
I’ll beat Linghu Minghua black and blue, and I’ll hand that man over to them."
"Hahaha." Luo Yanxio laughed at that.
"I feel amused when I remember my mother being jealous of you, and she repeatedly said that you were a temptress."
Qing Qiu’er let out a helpless sigh.
"Your mother already knew that I didn’t have a romantic relationship with your father, but her jealousy was too strong, and she disliked me because of our closeness.
Luckily, I have now found my husband, so she shouldn’t be jealous of me anymore."
"Yeah."
Before long, they arrived at the throne room, but many spider beasts were waiting for them there, and their strengths varied.
Xuan Meiyun sat on her throne, and her eyes moved over them one by one.
She was not surprised by Qing Qiu’er’s presence, mainly because she was the sect master of the Moonlit Passion Sect.
She was shocked when she saw Tianshi Shengjie and Nalan Wangzi, especially since she recognized their identities.
However, she was unable to recognize Luo Yunxiao, mainly because her parents hid her whereabouts for hundreds of years.

Xuan Meiyun looked at Zhang Fei [5] before being shocked by his cultivation, and she also felt the powerful pressure from his Heavenly Fox Bloodline, even though he was not using his half-fox form or full beast form, which made her realize that she was not his opponent.
Xuan Meiyun was utterly shocked when the sword pressed against her neck, and she glanced behind her, finding Zhang Fei [5] already standing there holding the Demon Extermination Sword. ’Shit!
How can he move so fast?
All the spiderwebs I’ve set up here haven’t moved at all, which means he didn’t touch them while he was moving.’
Zhang Fei [5] pressed his sword harder, causing Xuan Meiyun’s neck to bleed.
"You can forget about escaping from me since your speed and bloodline are inferior to mine, and I will behead you if you dare move.
Tell me, what did Hun Lingwu promise you to capture me?"
’Shit!
This kid is much scarier than that experienced cultivator.’ Xuan Meiyun broke out in a cold sweat and answered him directly.
"Hun Lingwu promised me his pills to help my subordinates break through."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei [5] raised an eyebrow for a moment before taking out some beast pills from his inventory, showing them to Xuan Meiyun.
"My pills are much more useful to beasts like you than the old man’s, but I will give them to you on one condition: you and your race must submit completely to me.
If you are all loyal to me, I will give you better pills than these, and you will not regret being my follower."
Xuan Meiyun frowned upon hearing that, but Zhang Fei [5] gave the bottles to her and asked her to examine them herself.
She was shocked again when she peeked at the pill bottles, especially since all the pills inside were superior grade.
Zhang Fei [5] took the pill bottles back from her and put them away.
"That old man might be able to concoct superior-grade pills, but he won’t be able to concoct my pills, which are specifically designed for beasts like you and your subordinates.
If you bring members of your race to my side, I will give these pills to all of them as well.
That way, they can reach a higher level, and they will also have a chance to evolve.
However, I hate traitors the most, and I will kill you all if you guys betray me.
So, what’s your answer?"
Xuan Meiyun pondered over Zhang Fei [5]’s offer.
His offer was indeed attractive, and his pills were extremely valuable, but he did not want to become someone else’s underling.
If she became his subordinate, she would lose her freedom, and she would have to obey him for the rest of her life, which was unacceptable to her.
Even so, Zhang Fei [5]’s pills were extremely useful to her and her subordinates, which put Xuan Meiyun in a dilemma.
She wanted his pills to become even more powerful, and her race could also benefit from them.

However, Xuan Meiyun wanted to continue living as she was now and not have anyone control her, but she realized that Zhang Fei [5] wouldn’t let them go, which was due to her decision to follow Hun Lingwu’s request.
Zhang Fei [5] spoke again.
"If you decide not to side with me, then you and the members of your race are my enemies, and I will wipe you all out right now.
If you want to blame someone for your situation, then you can blame yourself, especially since you gave in to that old man’s wishes just for the sake of his pills."
’Tch!
Damn Hun Lingwu!
He got me into this situation.’ Xuan Meiyun finally made up her mind.
"I’ll follow you!
I hope you don’t do anything to my race."
"I’m a man of my word." Zhang Fei [5] pulled Xuan Meiyu’s soul out of her body, which shocked her.
He duplicated her soul, merged it with his, and returned her original soul to her body.
"From now on, you and your race are my subordinates, understand?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1403: Capture Linghu Minghua
paragraphs: "What did you just do to me? Didn’t I agree to be your subordinate? Why did you do that to me?" Xuan Meiyun asked angrily.

Zhang Fei [5] shrugged. "The tongue has no bones, okay? You say you’re loyal to me today, but you could betray me tomorrow. That’s why I need your guarantee, and I cloned your soul just in case you betray me."
"What do you mean you cloned my soul?" Xuan Meiyun asked in confusion.

’Sigh! I’ve lived here for so long, but I still often use terms from Earth.’ Zhang Fei [5] immediately answered her. "The point is, I cloned your soul, and your soul copy has merged with mine. This way, I can control you, and you won’t be able to betray me."
Xuan Meiyun’s face was darkened. "If you don’t trust me, then why did you take me and the members of my race as your subordinates?"

"In this world, even family members can betray us, so a subordinate is even less trustworthy. To ensure the safety of everyone around me, I’m doing this to you so I can control you. However, you don’t have to worry; I won’t do anything to you if you don’t betray me." Zhang Fei [5]’s eyes turned sharp as he looked at her. "If you dare betray me, I will destroy your copy’s soul, and that will also destroy your original soul, which means you will die immediately. Do you understand?"

Xuan Meiyun shivered when she heard Zhang Fei [5]’s words, making her feel that the man in front of her was more terrifying than those expert cultivators. She sighed softly and nodded to him. "Don’t worry, I and the members of my race will not betray you."

"I hope so." Zhang Fei [5] gave Xuan Meiyun several pill bottles, containing his basic pills, beast pills, and some other pills. He also explained to her the function of each pill, which excited her. "I want you to bring the members of your race to move from this domain to the Twin Flames Main Domain, and I will prepare special residences for all of you there."

Xuan Meiyun was hesitant about the move because she and the members of her race had lived in the Stygian Dusk Domain for a long time, so it wouldn’t be easy for them to adapt to a new domain. Moreover, the Twin Flames Main Domain served as a gathering place for dual cultivators, whereas she and her race were not dual cultivators.
Xuan Meiyun released a soft sigh. "Give me a month to prepare everything, and I’ll take them straight to the domain a month later."

"I’ll give you a month, and you can directly bring members of your race there at that time." Xuan Meiyun nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "After you all move there, I will give my pills to the members of your race."
"Alright."
After Xuan Meiyun agreed, Zhang Fei [5] led the four women away from the place, and they went straight to the Dusk Pavilion to capture Linghu Minghua.
Xuan Meiyun sat cross-legged on the floor, and she swallowed the pills one by one in the order given by Zhang Fei [5], which caused her to improve significantly.

Since the domain was quite small, Zhang Fei [5] and the four women arrived at the Dusk Pavilion quickly. Unlike before, they didn’t hold back and killed the people from the pavilion as they moved into the main room, where Linghu Minghua was focused on healing his injuries.
Zhang Fei [5] and the four women slaughtered everyone from the pavilion without exception until they arrived at the main hall, which shocked Linghu Minghua.

Before Linghu Minghua could react, Qing Qiu’er had already moved. Her greatly improved speed, due to her perfect adaptation to the level seven gravity feature, left him with no opportunity to move or dodge.
Qing Qiu’er quickly sealed Linghu Minghua’s cultivation, leaving him shocked and in disbelief at her speed. "Hehehe! It’s too easy to catch this man, husband."
"Qing Qiu’er!" Linghu Minghua roared loudly.
"Shut up! Your shouting hurts my ears." Qing Qiu’er stomped on Linghu Minghua’s back, making him vomit blood. "What do you want to do with him, husband?"
"Cripple his cultivation now, and I will bring him to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary." Qing Qiu’er nodded to Zhang Fei [5] and crippled Linghu Minghua’s cultivation straight away.
"No! My cultivation!" Linghu Minghua screamed hysterically, feeling his cultivation rapidly disappearing. "You bitch! I will definitely kill you!"

"Heh!" Qing Qiu’er snorted in disgust and lifted Linghu Minghua to her feet. "What can you do to me without your cultivation? You are now no different from an ordinary human, and Huang Xiaoyi will be happy to have you. Oh, I forgot to tell you that their daughter is in front of you now, and she gave birth to her on one of the planets there."

Luo Yunxiao smiled when Linghu Minghua looked at him, and she walked in front of him as she spoke. "Back then, you and your friends surrounded my parents, forcing them to flee for years. However, I’m grateful for your actions back then because I was born there, and I was able to meet my husband there. Unfortunately, your time is up, and my parents would surely be overjoyed to be able to kill you with their own hands."
"You bitch! My old friends will notice I’m missing, and they will definitely attack the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary." Linghu Minghua threatened in a harsh tone.
"Is that so?" Zhang Fei [5] took one of the corpses, used his body modification ability, and transformed it into Linghu Minghua. "Do you think your friends will know you’re missing now?"

Linghu Minghua stared at Zhang Fei [5] and the corpse in shock, but Qing Qiu’er hurriedly knocked him unconscious, and she threw him to her husband. "I won’t be joining you in going to the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and I’ll be returning straight to our sect."
"Me too." Tianshi Shengjie and Nalan Wangzi spoke in unison.
Zhang Fei [5] shouldered Linghu Minghua directly. "Alright, the three of you can return to our sect, and I will take Luo Yunxiao to see her parents."
"Yes."

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi were puzzled that Zhang Fei [5] and Luo Yunxiao had arrived in the middle of the night, and they rushed to meet the two. However, they were shocked when they saw Linghu Minghua on their son-in-law’s shoulders, which made them disbelieving.

Luo Yunxiao smiled and explained to them. "We had business in the Stygian Dusk Domain just now, so we also went to look for this man because he attacked you in the past, forcing you two to flee to the Three Mortal Realms."

"What business brings you to that domain, Yunxiao?" Luo Yunxiao explained to Huang Xiaoyi about Hun Lingwu and his actions, which shocked both her and Luo Fenghan. "You guys are really crazy! Why are you looking for trouble with that old man? What if his acquaintances attack your sect?"
"If his acquaintances attack our sect, we just need to kill them, right?" Zhang Fei [5] put Linghu Minghua down from his shoulders. "Are you two happy now? You two will soon be grandparents, right?"
"Hahaha!" Luo Fenghan laughed upon hearing that. "We’re happy! We’re happy to be grandparents, and we’ve waited a long time for our dream to come true."

Huang Xiaoyi nodded with a smile. "They’ve been trying for so long, but Bing Xingying has never been able to get pregnant. If it weren’t for your help, she probably wouldn’t be pregnant now. We’ve been eagerly awaiting that day, but unfortunately, we have to wait a few more months for their child to be born."
"How about you help Cheng Mengyao get pregnant too? That way, their children will be born soon, and we’ll have two grandchildren." Lou Fenghan asked.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at them. "I have no problem with that because I can help Sister-in-law Cheng Mengyao easily, but the problem is whether she is ready to be a mother or not. If she is not ready to be a mother, then you two should not force her to get pregnant, or she will feel pressured by it."
"Wife, please wake up Cheng Mengyao, and we’ll ask her directly." Huang Xiaoyi nodded to Luo Fenghan and hurriedly left. "What about you? Are you not ready to be a father yet?"

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his nose awkwardly and immediately shook his head at his father-in-law. "Father-in-law, I know you want a child from me and Yunxiao, but I’m not ready to be a father yet. For now, there are many problems plaguing my mind, which makes me unable to calm down. After I have successfully resolved everything, I will impregnate her, and we will give you grandchildren."

Lou Fenghan let out a soft sigh because he had been waiting for his daughter’s grandchild for a long time, but he had to be patient for a little longer, especially since his son-in-law was not ready to have children yet.

Luo Yunxiao walked over to her father and hugged his arm. "Father, please understand our reasons for not having children soon. When my husband is ready, we will give you many grandchildren, not just one, but several at once."

"Hahaha." Luo Fenghan laughed and patted his daughter’s hand. "I don’t need many grandchildren, and two grandchildren from you two are enough for us. When your husband is ready, you must give me two grandchildren, understand?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1404: With Three Female Demons
paragraphs: Before long, Huang Xiaoyi returned with Luo Jiaxuan and Cheng Mengyao, who were still very sleepy.

Since Luo Jiaxuan and Cheng Mengyao agreed, Zhang Fei [5] took out a large cloth. After covering their lower bodies with their genitals connected, he used his reproduction manipulation ability to help them have a child as soon as possible.
After the process was complete, they quickly arranged their clothes, and Luo Jiaxuan asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Is my wife pregnant now, brother-in-law?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded at him. "Brother-in-law, you will see signs that your wife is pregnant in a few days, and you will be a father in the following months. Since you will soon be a father, you must improve your life, and you must be more responsible towards your wife."
"Hahaha." Luo Jiaxuan laughed wryly and turned to his wife. "Did you hear that, wife? We will be parents in a few months, and I promise you that I will be a good father to our child."
Cheng Mengyao nodded with a smile. "Thank you, brother-in-law. We’ve always wanted to be parents, but fate had other plans because I never got pregnant, even though we’ve been trying for so long."

"That’s what family is for, right? Therefore, you don’t need to thank me, and I’m happy to help you all." Cheng Mengyao nodded to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately warned her. "For now, you shouldn’t overwork yourself because your womb is a bit weaker than our sister-in-law’s, so you have to take good care of yourself."
Cheng Mengyao rubbed her slender stomach. "Don’t worry, brother-in-law. I will take good care of my condition, and I will give birth to my child in a few months."

"You two should go back to rest now, and you should restrain yourself from playing with your wife, brother-in-law." Luo Jiaxuan smiled bitterly and took Cheng Mengyao back to their room, and Zhang Fei [5] asked his parents-in-law. "Do you two also want to have another child? If you like, I will help you too now."
"We—"

"No." Huang Xiaoyi immediately refused. "We’re too old to have another child, so it’s time for us to hold onto our grandchildren. Cheng Mengyao and Bing Xingying will give birth to two grandchildren for us in a few months, but we’ll still be looking forward to having grandchildren from you two, understand?"
Luo Yunxiao hugged her mother’s arm. "Be patient, okay, mother? When we are ready to have children, I will ask my husband to impregnate me straight away, and you can hold our children later."
"Sigh." Huang Xiaoyi sighed helplessly as she hugged her daughter. "Don’t let us both wait too long, okay?"
"Yes, mother." Luo Yunxiao immediately let go of her mother and returned to her husband’s side. "We will leave now, and we will go straight back to the Moonlit Passion Temple, father and mother."
"Alright."
After Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi agreed, Zhang Fei [5] took Lou Yunxiao away from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary and returned to the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Luo Fenghan crouched in front of Linghu Minghua to check his cultivation, only to discover that their son-in-law had crippled him. "What do you think we should do with this man, wife?"

"Kill him." Luo Fenghan turned to Huang Xiaoyi in surprise. "Actually, I wanted to torture this man, but his cultivation has been crippled by our son-in-law. Therefore, there’s no point in doing that anymore, and we have to kill him directly."

"I see." Luo Fenghan touched Linghu Minghua’s head and killed him directly. After that, he called some guards to get rid of the body, and he led his wife back to their room. "I can’t wait a few more months, and our two daughters-in-law will soon give birth to our grandchildren, which will make our family even more complete."

Huang Xiaoyi sighed softly. "I’m happy because our two daughters-in-law will soon give birth to grandchildren for us, but I’m upset because our daughter still doesn’t want to have children. I’m looking forward to the birth of her child, but I have to wait longer because our son-in-law doesn’t have any intention of getting her pregnant yet."
"Hahaha." Luo Fenghan laughed at that. "I can’t wait for our daughter to have a child, but we don’t need to force them, and they will give us a grandchild when our son-in-law is ready."
"Yeah."

After they arrived at the Moonlit Passion Temple, Luo Yunxiao hurriedly returned to their residence behind the mountain to rest. Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [5] went to the area where the demons lived, especially since he wanted to check on the five female demons he saved from Yuan Xiajie.
There, Zhang Fei [5] found Wang Yin sitting alone daydreaming, so he immediately went over to her and sat down beside her. "Why don’t you cultivate like the others?"

"I’m confused." Wang Yin hugged her legs and rested her head on them. "Ever since I regained my true self and you shared all your memories with me, I have been reflecting on everything up to this point. Why did that woman do all this to me? Why did she erase so many of my old memories from my mind?"

Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh, and he told Wang Yin many things, especially regarding Yuan Xiajie. "Those are all the problems I know about that woman, but I don’t have an answer for all her actions towards you, especially erasing all your memories."
"Can you help me get all my memories back?" Wang Yin asked while looking at him.

"No." Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "Actually, I have memory manipulation ability, and I can use it to restore all your memories. However, you will not be who you used to be, and you will change to match my memories of you. The only person who can help you is Yuan Xiajie, and you will be your old self again if she restores all your old memories. Unfortunately, she doesn’t live in this realm, and she lives in the Ancient Realm, which is still far from my reach."

Wang Yin let out a soft sigh and looked at Zhang Fei [5], but she felt a wave of hesitation in her heart. She quickly dismissed everything and laid her head on his shoulders, which was quite surprising for him. "I can’t remember you in my memories, but I know that the memories you showed me before are real. I need your help to recall all my memories of our relationship, and I want to be able to remember everything again as soon as possible."

"Yin’er." Zhang Fei [5] called softly and embraced her. "Yin’er, I’m happy that you want to remember all of our past relationship, but I don’t think it’s important anymore. Shall we make new memories together? We’ll start over from the beginning, and we’ll rebuild new memories of our relationship."

"Hmm?" Wang Yin turned to him. "Do you want me to not be able to remember all our old memories? I don’t mind building other memories with you, but I want to remember all our old memories. Our old memories should hold significance for us, so I want to recover all of them."

chapters.title: Chapter 1405: Give Four Demon Pills
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] found it funny to see Nong Qinhua, especially since she was entirely different from her past self. During their initial meeting several years ago, she tried to seduce him; however, he didn’t like her because she had slept with many men, and she acted like a shy woman now.
"Why are you smiling to yourself?" Nong Qinhua asked him.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled at her question. "In the past, you had a habit of sleeping with other men to stabilize the Yin Qi in your body, even though you had a husband, and you tried to seduce me during our first meeting."
"Eh?" Nong Qinhua was shocked to hear that. "Did I really sleep with many men in the past?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to her. "At our first meeting, I found a lot of yang qi in your body, and they belong to different men. You seduced me at that time, but I immediately rejected you. Even though I am a dual cultivator with many wives, I don’t like women who have slept with many men like you."

Nong Qinhua let out a heavy sigh and laid her head on her knees. "I don’t understand why I acted that way back then, but I’m grateful I’ve changed, and I will never do that again. For now, I want to organize my life for the better, and I will find a new husband here."

"That’s good." Zhang Fei [5] nodded to her. "The members of this sect are not diverse now, but members of other races will soon join us, including the demons. At that time, you will probably find a new man that catches your eye, and you can marry him later."

"Yes." Nong Qinhua then looked towards the distance. "For now, I want to focus on my cultivation and become strong, so no one will be able to control me or toy with my memories anymore. Even though I have decided to forget all my past memories, I am still furious with that woman’s actions in erasing all my memories and replacing them with new ones. Therefore, I have to become strong, and I will repay what she did to me many times over in the future."

"Good mindset!" Zhang Fei [5] handed several bottles of pills to Nong Qinhua and Bian Luosha. "Since you two are members of my sect, you can use these pills. They will help you repair your foundation and make it more solid, so you will be able to become stronger in the future."
"Thank you." Nong Qinhua stood up from her seat. "I’m going back to my room now, and I’m going to use these pills straight away."
"Why did you give me your pills? Don’t you hate me?" Bian Luosha hesitantly asked him.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head at her. "I’m not a petty person, okay? I did hate you in the past, and I wanted to kill you, but I’ve forgotten that. For now, you’re a member of my sect, and I need you to become stronger to help me with some things, so you can use those pills to improve yourself."

"Hmm?" Bian Luosha was curious about their past enmity, especially since she had no memories of her past. "Thank you, Zhang Fei. I will make good use of all your pills, and you can tell me if you need my help in the future."
Zhang Fei [5] simply nodded at her. "Go back to your room now and use all the pills quickly, so you can help me with something later."
"Alright." Bian Luosha immediately left the place.

"What exactly was your problem with Bian Luosha in the past?" Zhang Fei [5] let out a soft sigh and recalled all the past events to Wang Yin, which really shocked her. "I never thought that she would do all that, and your wife and her three daughters must be sad to lose their loved ones."

"They were truly saddened by Chu Hong’s death, but they decided to forget the matter and forgive her. Therefore, I will no longer pursue this matter, and I will use her to help me build my sect’s defenses." Zhang Fei [5] looked in another direction. "Why are you two hiding there? Come out now and join us."
Soon, Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua came out of hiding, and both of them sat in front of Zhang Fei [5] and Wang Yin.

Zhang Fei [5] hurriedly threw several bottles of pills towards them, surprising both Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua. "Like Nong Qinhua and Bian Luosha, you two have decided to join my sect, so I will treat you well. Those pills are indeed basic, and you may have taken similar ones in the past. However, my pills have higher effects than other pills, so you can use them to improve your cultivation foundation."
"Thank you." Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua gratefully said.
Dong Binghua asked him. "I’ve looked around the entire sect, but I’m truly surprised by the presence of all the races here. Do you intend to unite all races within one sect?"
"Is such a thing possible? After all, the other races hate the demon races deeply, and we might bring trouble for you and the sect in the future." Yan Huanying said.

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his lust demon form, which shocked Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua. "As you two can see, I am a lust demon myself. Even without your presence in this sect, those who dislike demons will attack this sect if they know of my presence here. However, I don’t think much of them, and I will deal with them if they want to disturb my sect. Therefore, you two don’t need to think too much about those people, and you only need to focus on improving your cultivation as quickly as possible so you can help me with the things the sect needs."
Yan Huanying asked him again. "Why can’t I feel your demon aura before you change into your demon form?"
"That’s true." Dong Binghua nodded in agreement. "I couldn’t sense your demon aura while you were in your human form, which has never happened before."

Zhang Fei [5] transformed into his complete fox form, which made Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua’s jaws fall open. On the other hand, Wang Yin was very impressed by his full fox form, and she hugged him so tightly while rubbing his soft fur.
Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua hurriedly stood up and approached Zhang Fei [5], rubbing his soft fur. "Wow! Your fur is really soft, and I can’t stop stroking your white fur."
"I’ve never seen a fox as white as you in my life." Dong Binghua rubbed her face against his chest. "I really like the softness of your white fur."
Zhang Fei [5] sighed in resignation as the three female demons acted like children who had gotten a new toy, and they couldn’t stop rubbing his fur. "Are you three satisfied with rubbing my fur?"
"No!" Wang Yin, Yan Huanying, and Dong Binghua answered in unison.
Zhang Fei [5] sighed and returned to his human form, making the three female demons pout their lips. He chuckled and quickly kissed their lips, leaving two of the three of them dumbfounded.
Yan Huanying blushed and rubbed her lips, glancing at Zhang Fei [5]. Dong Binghua also had the same reaction as her, and her heart pounded.
Wang Yin was more relaxed than them because she had already slept with Zhang Fei [5], even though she couldn’t remember it.

Zhang Fei [5] was amused by Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua’s reaction, especially since it was clear both of them were no longer virgins. "You two can go back to your rooms now and swallow all those pills, and your cultivation foundations will improve significantly after that."
"Yes." Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua hurriedly left the place.
Wang Yin asked him. "Aren’t you going to give me your pills?"
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed and hugged her. "I’ve already given you my pills in the past, and you’ve already swallowed them, so I won’t give them to you again because they’re useless."
"Oh." Wang Yin nodded in understanding. "I’ll return to my room to cultivate now, and I’ll see you again tomorrow."
Wang Yin stood on tiptoe and gave Zhang Fei [5] a gentle kiss on the lips, leaving him afterward.
Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his lips and sighed softly. "Yin’er, I will help you remember everything again."
Zhang Fei [5] checked on the other demons, and he found Xian Xiaqin with Qian Ying in her room. Ju Yingzhi was busy cultivating in her room, accompanied by Xin Yanluo.

Zhang Fei [5] checked other places, and he found Meng Qing and Meng Guanqiu cultivating together in their room. He was still confused about Feng Jiu’s words about Meng Qing a few years ago, especially since he still didn’t discover anything interesting about her.
Zhang Fei [5] also found Ming Han, Zhang Huanzi, Qing Tan, Liu Rong, Liu Ming, Zi’er, Zhang Wuji, the Hai Twins, Alder, and several others focused on cultivating in their respective rooms.
Zhang Fei [5] found Shen Xinya daydreaming in front of her room, as did Zhang Xiaoling and Jiang Tingxi.

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t have any feelings for Sheng Xinya, even though she had changed significantly. He decided to give up on approaching her mother-in-law, Jiang Tingxi. He decided to go to see Zhang Xiaoling, surprising her. "Why are you daydreaming at this time of night?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1406: Radiant Starfall Domain’s Shop
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaoling shook her head at him. "I missed the Sky Jade Realm, but I have no desire to return there, especially since it would slow down my cultivation.
"If you miss the Sky Jade Realm, I can take you back there, and we’ll be back here soon." Zhang Fei [5] said.
"No." Zhang Xiaoling looked at him. "Has your cultivation broken through again?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "My cultivation has now reached the 3-Star Celestial Lord Realm."

Zhang Xiaoling envied Zhang Fei [5] because his cultivation was still far below hers when they first met years ago, but he had now surpassed her by far. On the other hand, her cultivation was still stuck at the Seven Divine Realm, mainly because she wasn’t a dual cultivator like him, which made it difficult for her to progress. ’Sigh! As time goes on, my cultivation lags behind him, and I might fall even further behind him in the future.’
"What are you thinking about?" Zhang Fei [5] asked.
"Nothing." Zhang Xiaoling shook her head slightly. "I’ll go inside now since I’m sleepy, and I’ll continue my cultivation tomorrow morning."

Zhang Fei [5] didn’t leave immediately and paid attention to his niece-in-law, and he was well aware of her thoughts. Since they met several years ago, he has never had any interest in her, and he only considered her family.

Zhang Fei [5] sighed softly before going to the residence of the members of the Hidden Sea Sect, where he saw Hai Yuzhen cultivating with Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin. Meanwhile, Wei Luan cultivated together with her senior sisters, and they looked serious about cultivating, making her smile with satisfaction.

Zhang Fei [5] then checked the residences of the people from the Sky Jade Realm, and he saw them cultivating in their respective rooms seriously, especially since their cultivation had not yet broken through to the Five Celestial Realms.

After checking the activities of others, Zhang Fei [5] decided to meet with the natural races from the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and he asked them to build a new residence for Xuan Meiyun and her race members. However, he requested that the residence be built far from the residential areas in the domain, especially since the spider beasts were not accustomed to interacting with humans.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] returned to the top of the mountain, where Qing Qiu’er and the others were already waiting for him. He first dual cultivated with You Feiling, especially since he had never directly dual cultivated with her since she became his wife.
Five days passed quickly, and Zhang Fei finally finished virtual cultivation with Qi Qingxiu. "Where is Qiongqi? Why hasn’t he appeared until today?"
"I don’t know." Qi Qingxiu asked in turn. "What are your plans after this? Are you going back to your sect?"

"No." Zhang Fei immediately got out of bed and began to dress. "I’m going to the Radiant Starfall Domain, especially since my first shop in this realm is about to open. There are so many alchemy shops there, so I can’t leave Zhong Yan alone, and I will accompany her to our shop opening."
Qi Qingxiu nodded in understanding and got out of bed before getting dressed. "I won’t accompany you to that domain, and I’ll stay here to wait in case Qiongqi suddenly appears."

"If Qiongqi suddenly appears, and he tries to cause trouble for you, then you must contact me immediately, okay?" Qi Qingxiu only nodded to Zhang Fei, who immediately gave her a kiss and left her domain through the gate.

Qi Qingxiu rubbed her lips and smiled in satisfaction, especially since she had been dual cultivating with Zhang Fei for almost ten whole days. In her entire life, she had never thought about giving herself to a man, but she had given her body to him, and she was truly enjoying every moment they had together.

Qi Qingxiu’s face turned red as she thought of something, but she hurriedly shook her head, especially since Zhang Fei would reject her wish. "Perhaps, I will have a child from him someday, but my wish isn’t going to come true anytime soon."
While Qi Qingixu was lost in thought, someone reported to her that Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran had come to visit her, so she hurriedly went out to meet them.
When Qi Qingxiu appeared, Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran looked at her with teasing smiles, which made her face darken. "Why are you two smiling to yourselves? What are you guys thinking?"
"Hahaha." Ye Mingran laughed. "I didn’t expect you to give yourself to Zhang Fei, Qingxiu. We came here a few days ago, but your subordinates said you were dual cultivating with him."
Nalan Shizhe teased her. "Since you became Zhang Fei’s wife, you—"
"Stop it! Don’t say anything else." Qi Qingxiu shouted at them and hurriedly sat on her throne. "Why did you two come here?"
"Have you heard the news about the Celestial Demon race?"

Qi Qingxiu raised an eyebrow slightly at them before nodding. "Zhang Fei met Mo Zainan a week ago, and he was able to persuade her to agree to take over the Celestial Demon Race from her husband. This way, only four demon races remain, especially since the Nine Nether Demon Race is already under his control with the help of Jiu Moze. Shouldn’t you have heard about that matter from your daughter, Shizhe?"

"Yes." Nalan Shizhe nodded at her. "That’s why we came here to inform you of this matter, but we were surprised to find that you’re already Zhang Fei’s woman, and the two of you are spending time together."

Qi Qingxiu sighed softly and told them about her relationship with Zhang Fei, which began about seven months ago when they went to the Three Mortal Realms. "I never thought of giving myself to a man, but he used his ability to pull my subconscious into a dream space, which eventually made me accustomed to his presence. Since then, my feelings have been constantly changing, and they changed entirely when we entered the Ashen Lotus Monastery a month and a half ago, which is why I finally agreed to become his woman."
"The Ashen Lotus Monastery?" Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran were surprised to hear that.

Qi Qingxiu nodded at them. "That place was part of the Ancient Realm, but it was destroyed long ago. However, the true Yin Yang Lotus resides there, and I spent a month with Zhang Fei and the others there."
"Huh?" Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran were shocked.
"Is that domain really part of the Ancient Realm?" Ye Mingran asked.
Nalan Shizhe then spoke. "If I’m not mistaken, the Forbidden Land is also part of the Ancient Realm, right?"
"Yes." Qi Qingxiu answered them with a nod. "The Ashen Lotus Monastery and the Forbidden Land are part of the Ancient Realm, as are the Zenith Solar Sanctum and the Endless Night Dungeon."

"I see." Ye Mingran nodded in understanding and asked again. "What exactly happened to the Ancient Realm in the past? Why did the four domains related to that realm appear in this Paradise Realm? Did Zhang Fei tell you about the events in that realm?"

"Zhang Fei didn’t say anything to me, but he is sure that there are several other domains directly connected to the Ancient Realm in this Paradise Realm." Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran looked at Qi Qingxiu, but she immediately shook her head at them. "For now, that’s just his guess, and it hasn’t been proven true. However, if he already suspects that, I’m sure there are other domains that connect the two realms."
"By the way, what plans does Zhang Fei have for the other four demon races?" Ye Mingran asked.

"Zhang Fei has no plans against them yet, and he is waiting for Shang Luohu to make a decision." Qi Qingxiu told the two female demon gods about his plans for the Asura Demon Race, which involved Shang Xueli, who was already in his hands. "For now, we can only wait for that woman to give him an answer, but I’m sure it won’t happen anytime soon, especially since she needs Shang Zhanluo’s approval to do that."

After discussing a few other matters, Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran decided to leave the Seven Emotions Demon Domain and return to their respective domains. Meanwhile, Qi Qingxiu sat on her throne and pondered a few matters, particularly the evil beast, Qiongqi. "What exactly happened? Why hasn’t he shown up yet?"
Radiant Starfall Domain
Zhang Fei and several of her women had already gathered at their shop in the domain, with Zhong Yan leading the opening.
For the past week, Zhong Yan had been renovating and recruiting people to staff their shop. She deliberately didn’t recruit many people, and she asked her other sisters to help her out in the shop.

Zhang Fei wanted to sell all the pills from the shop system in their store, but he gave up because he didn’t want to have any problems with the alchemy shops in the domain. He decided to sell all his basic pills in his store, mainly because the basic pills in the domain weren’t as good as his. However, he refrained from selling other pills, only selling a few superior-grade pills, while the others were only high-grade at most.
After the opening ceremony concluded, Zhong Yan and the other women invited the curious people who had been queuing to enter their shop, resulting in a full house on the opening day.

chapters.title: Chapter 1407: Opening Day
paragraphs: "They probably came looking for trouble, husband." Luo Yunxiao, who was sitting in the teahouse opposite the alchemy shop, pointed at the group of people who had just arrived.

Tianshi Shengjie also looked at the group, and she recognized one of them. "That old man is Leng Jianmo, and he’s the leader of the alchemist union in this domain, but he’s quite greedy. Many cultivators dislike that old man, but no one dares to do anything to him because the Leng Clan is so powerful in this domain."
’Show his status, Mei.’
[Wait a second, Master.]
Name: Leng Jianmo
Race: Human
Gender: Male
Cultivation: 1-Sun Celestial Venerable
Soul Cultivation: Saint Level [Half-Perfection Stage]
Element: Fire [Peak Stage]
Law: Fire [Half-Perfection Stage]
Core: Upper-Rank Fire Core
Physique: Human
Special Physique: None
Special Bloodline: None
Partner: None
Likes: None
Dislike: Huo Lanyin, Jin Nanqing, and many more.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei read the old man’s status while stroking the Wind Weasel, You Bai, on his lap. "How influential is he compared to Jin Nanqing?"
"Haha." Luo Yunxiao laughed at that. "No one can match Senior Jin’s influence in this realm."
Tianshi Shengjie nodded in agreement. "Jin Nanqing is the best male alchemist, and Huo Lanyin is the best female alchemist in this realm."
"I see." Zhang Fei contacted Huo Lanyin and asked her to come to the Radiant Starfall Domain as soon as possible. "Are you close to breaking through again, You Bai?"
You Bai nodded at him. "Thanks to the pill you gave me last time, my cultivation is getting closer to breaking through to the next stage, Master."
"Go back now and prepare to break through." Zhang Fei directly sent the beast back to his beast space.
"Are you going to come down and go inside, husband?"
"No need." Zhang Fei answered Luo Yunxiao with a shake of his head. "Huo Lanyin will arrive soon, and she will take care of the old man if he looks for trouble."
Even so, Zhang Fei sent a voice transmission to Zhong Yan, asking him to be careful of the old man.
Upon arrival, Leng Jianmo and his entourage immediately looked at the pills, but they were not interested in the high-grade ones, and they were only interested in the superior-grade ones.

Zhong Yan followed behind them and explained the effects of the pills to them, but Leng Jianmo and his entourage’s reaction was one of mockery, mainly because the number of superior-grade pills sold in the shop was small. ’They are so arrogant! They will die standing if my husband sells all his pills in this shop, and they will turn into greedy creatures.’
Leng Jianmo and his entourage raised an eyebrow when they arrived at the display case of basic pills, especially the ones that were superior-grade.
Leng Jianmo turned to her. "Who is the alchemist who concocted these pills?"

"My husband, Senior." Zhong Yan’s answer surprised Leng Jianmo and his entourage, but they could sense that the man’s yang qi within his body was very dense. "He’s currently in another domain, so he can’t attend this shop opening."
"Which domain is he in?" Another man asked her.

"The Empyrean Main Domain." Leng Jianmo and his entourage were taken back for a moment, and one of them wanted to ask him, but Zhong Yan immediately told them. "My husband is also the son-in-law of Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and he went to that domain to visit his two in-laws."
After Zhong Yan’s statement, there was a long silence, and then another old man turned to Leng Jianmo and asked. "Have you heard that Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi have a daughter, Old Leng?"

"As far as I know, Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi only have two sons, and I know that they are married because I was also present at their wedding." Leng Jianmo looked at Zhong Yan. "Why did you have to lie to us?"
"She didn’t lie to you, you know?" Leng Jianmo and his entourage froze upon hearing that voice, and they trembled as they saw Huo Lanyin, Huo Yu’er, and Huo Hao’er walking towards them.
Huo Yu’er asked Zhong Yan. "Are these old men trying to pressure you?"
"If they dare to pressure you, I’ll burn their genitals to ashes, and they’ll be ashamed for the rest of their lives." Huo Hao’er nonchalantly said.

Leng Jianmo and his entourage instinctively covered their lower bodies and trembled violently at the sight of the three women. ’Crap! Why are these monster women here? Do they have any relationship with this shop? If that’s true, this shop has a direct relationship with Empress Huo; otherwise, they wouldn’t come here.’

Huo Lanyin shook her head at their frightened expressions, and she put on a playful smile as she asked, "Why are you all here? Do you want to look at all the pills in this shop? Or did you come here on purpose to cause trouble? Oh! I forgot to tell you all! If you cause trouble here, you will face us directly, and we will not hesitate to destroy you."
"We... we just came here to look at the pills in this shop, Miss Huo." Leng Jianmo replied, his body trembling. "We’re done looking around, and we’ll be leaving now."
Leng Jianmo and his entourage ran off in a panic, making Zhong Yan burst out laughing. "Sister Lanyin, those old men seem terrified of you. Have you ever done anything to them in the past?"

"Hahaha." Huo Yu’er laughed and replied to her. "Leng Jianmo once challenged Big Sis Lanyin, but she immediately shattered his pride with the pills she concocted, and he hasn’t dared to meet her again since then."

Huo Hao’er nodded her head several times. "Big Sis Lanyin crushed that old man’s pride to the point that he didn’t dare to perform alchemy for a while, but he eventually recovered and returned to alchemy."

"I’m innocent." Huo Lanyin said with a shrug. "At that time, the old man had just advanced to the level of an alchemist god, and I was traveling without wearing the clothes from my domain. He felt big-headed and tried to challenge me, so I taught him a lesson he never forgot."

"Haha." Zhong Yan laughed. "No wonder the old men feel so afraid of you, Sister Lanyin. If my husband knew that those old men were so afraid of you, he wouldn’t have to hold back and sell all his pills in this shop."

"Hmm?" Huo Lanyin turned her head and looked at all the pills in the shop, but she sighed heavily because Zhang Fei didn’t sell his best pills there, and he only sold second-grade pills. "Your husband is indeed lousy! He already has strength, and he’s done many things that others can’t, but he still acts too cautiously."

"Hey! I heard you, okay?" Zhang Fei said as he walked in with Luo Yunxiao and Tianshi Shengjie. "I want to sell peacefully in this domain, and I would rather not cause trouble with the people here, so I deliberately limited the sales of my pills."

Huo Lanyin shook her head and pointed at his chest. "If you always act too cautiously, you will never succeed in winning my empress’s heart. Compared to you, she always acts openly, and she will challenge everyone who tries to disturb her without exception, including Long Wuzhao. If you want to win her heart, you have to act more boldly and more openly, or she will never accept you as her husband."

"Tch!" Zhang Fei gritted his teeth. "If I were the one running this shop instead of Zhong Yan, I would sell all my pills here because I can protect myself. I won’t risk putting her or my other women in danger, which is why I’m limiting the types of pills I sell here."

Huo Lanyin could only sigh and say to him again. "Once they find out about my relationship with this shop, I’m sure those old men won’t dare mess with your shop, let alone Zhong Yan. Therefore, you can sell all your pills freely, and no one will bother you."
"Are you sure those old men won’t bother the shop anymore?"
"Do you doubt my words?"

"I don’t dare doubt the words of a senior like you." Zhang Fei then gave all his pills to Zhong Yan. "You can start selling them today, but you don’t need to get rid of the high-grade pills. Not everyone can afford the superior-grade pills, so let them choose those."
"Alright." Zhong Yan immediately arranged the pills on several display cases, which completely shocked the buyers.

Since they had previously seen Leng Jianmo and his entourage, they thought that Zhong Yan was limiting the sale of their pills, and she hadn’t released all the superior-grade pills to avoid their anger. They immediately scrambled to look at the pills and read their effects one by one, some of which shocked them.

After they read the description of the pills, they immediately scrambled to buy them, which caused the stock to run out quickly, especially the beast pills. Apart from these pills, they also bought many superior-grade healing pills and recovery pills, forcing Zhang Fei to increase the amount of their stock.
"Haha." Huo Lanyin laughed at the sight of the customers. "My two sisters and I will be watching over this shop, so you don’t have to worry about Zhong Yan’s safety."
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh. "I’ll monitor the sales of these pills today."

Huo Lanyin shook her head at their frightened expressions, and she put on a playful smile as she asked, "Why are you all here?
Do you want to look at all the pills in this shop?
Or did you come here on purpose to cause trouble?
Oh!
I forgot to tell you all!
If you cause trouble here, you will face us directly, and we will not hesitate to destroy you."
"We... we just came here to look at the pills in this shop, Miss Huo." Leng Jianmo replied, his body trembling.
"We’re done looking around, and we’ll be leaving now."
Leng Jianmo and his entourage ran off in a panic, making Zhong Yan burst out laughing.
"Sister Lanyin, those old men seem terrified of you.
Have you ever done anything to them in the past?"
"Hahaha." Huo Yu’er laughed and replied to her.
"Leng Jianmo once challenged Big Sis Lanyin, but she immediately shattered his pride with the pills she concocted, and he hasn’t dared to meet her again since then."
Huo Hao’er nodded her head several times.
"Big Sis Lanyin crushed that old man’s pride to the point that he didn’t dare to perform alchemy for a while, but he eventually recovered and returned to alchemy."
"I’m innocent." Huo Lanyin said with a shrug.
"At that time, the old man had just advanced to the level of an alchemist god, and I was traveling without wearing the clothes from my domain.
He felt big-headed and tried to challenge me, so I taught him a lesson he never forgot."
"Haha." Zhong Yan laughed.
"No wonder the old men feel so afraid of you, Sister Lanyin.
If my husband knew that those old men were so afraid of you, he wouldn’t have to hold back and sell all his pills in this shop."
"Hmm?" Huo Lanyin turned her head and looked at all the pills in the shop, but she sighed heavily because Zhang Fei didn’t sell his best pills there, and he only sold second-grade pills.
"Your husband is indeed lousy!
He already has strength, and he’s done many things that others can’t, but he still acts too cautiously."
"Hey!
I heard you, okay?" Zhang Fei said as he walked in with Luo Yunxiao and Tianshi Shengjie.
"I want to sell peacefully in this domain, and I would rather not cause trouble with the people here, so I deliberately limited the sales of my pills."
Huo Lanyin shook her head and pointed at his chest.
"If you always act too cautiously, you will never succeed in winning my empress’s heart.
Compared to you, she always acts openly, and she will challenge everyone who tries to disturb her without exception, including Long Wuzhao.
If you want to win her heart, you have to act more boldly and more openly, or she will never accept you as her husband."
"Tch!" Zhang Fei gritted his teeth.
"If I were the one running this shop instead of Zhong Yan, I would sell all my pills here because I can protect myself.
I won’t risk putting her or my other women in danger, which is why I’m limiting the types of pills I sell here."
Huo Lanyin could only sigh and say to him again.
"Once they find out about my relationship with this shop, I’m sure those old men won’t dare mess with your shop, let alone Zhong Yan.
Therefore, you can sell all your pills freely, and no one will bother you."
"Are you sure those old men won’t bother the shop anymore?"
"Do you doubt my words?"
"I don’t dare doubt the words of a senior like you." Zhang Fei then gave all his pills to Zhong Yan.
"You can start selling them today, but you don’t need to get rid of the high-grade pills.
Not everyone can afford the superior-grade pills, so let them choose those."
"Alright." Zhong Yan immediately arranged the pills on several display cases, which completely shocked the buyers.

Since they had previously seen Leng Jianmo and his entourage, they thought that Zhong Yan was limiting the sale of their pills, and she hadn’t released all the superior-grade pills to avoid their anger.
They immediately scrambled to look at the pills and read their effects one by one, some of which shocked them.
After they read the description of the pills, they immediately scrambled to buy them, which caused the stock to run out quickly, especially the beast pills.
Apart from these pills, they also bought many superior-grade healing pills and recovery pills, forcing Zhang Fei to increase the amount of their stock.
"Haha." Huo Lanyin laughed at the sight of the customers.
"My two sisters and I will be watching over this shop, so you don’t have to worry about Zhong Yan’s safety."
Zhang Fei let out a soft sigh.
"I’ll monitor the sales of these pills today."

chapters.title: Chapter 1408: Fighting Shuang Yuelan
paragraphs: *Bam*

Leng Jianmo slammed the table furiously upon meeting the three women. His expression darkened, and he was completely enraged by their presence in his domain. Even so, he didn’t dare fight the people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain, and he would only be courting death if he did, especially since Empress Huo Yanling had returned.

The expressions of the old men with Leng Jianmo also became extremely ugly, and they struggled to think of a way to stop the shop without causing a commotion with the people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain. Although Zhang Fei’s alchemy shop didn’t sell high-quality pills, it did sell some basic pills that were far superior to theirs, which would reduce their shop’s income.
*Crack*
Leng Jianmo and the others turned to a woman who had just arrived and entered the room. "What happened? Why are you here now, Shuang Yuelan?"

Shuang Yuelan paid her respects to them and told them about some information she had just received from their spies, which was news about Zhang Fei’s alchemy shop selling many kinds of superior-grade pills. She also informed them that their spies had seen him in the shop with two other women, one of whom was a princess of the Celestial Dragon race. However, their spies did not recognize the other woman’s identity, and they suspected that she was the daughter of Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi.

Leng Jianmo and those old men were completely shocked to hear that Zhang Fei had a relationship with the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, which made it even more difficult for them to destroy the alchemy shop. "Are you sure that woman is the princess of that race?"
"I heard about her from our spies, and they are sure that she is the one." Shuang Yuelan looked at Leng Jianmo. "Do you want me to investigate that woman, Master?"

Leng Jianmo thought for a moment and immediately ordered her. "Go to that shop and investigate that woman’s identity. If she is indeed the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race, then I will have to think of another way to close that shop."
"Yes."

After Shuang Yuelan left, an old man asked Leng Jianmo, "In your opinion, how could that young man possibly have a relationship with Empress Huo’s people and the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race?"

"I don’t know about that." Leng Jianmo replied with a shake of his head. "However, I know for sure that the existence of that shop will disrupt the prices of pills in this domain, and they will likely take over a large portion of the alchemy market here. Therefore, we must do something to stop them before it’s too late, or we will lose control of the market that we have dominated."
"How are we going to do that?"
"We can’t possibly fight Empress Huo, let alone the Celestial Dragon Race."
"We will die if we fight both of them."

Leng Jianmo didn’t have an answer for that, and he himself didn’t have the guts to challenge those people. However, he didn’t want Zhang Fei’s alchemy shop to take over the alchemy market that they had dominated, mainly because it would be a huge loss for them.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei sat on the second floor, watching the buyers scramble to buy the pills and observing the system map. "Those guys aren’t deterred, huh? They sent a woman here, and they probably assigned her to spy on our shop."
"What will you do with that woman, husband?" Luo Yunxiao asked.
Tianshi Shengjie also asked her. "Do you want to capture that woman, Zhang Fei?"
"I don’t know." Zhang Fei immediately stood up from his chair. "I’ll meet that woman first to find out what those people want from our shop, and I’ll think of another move after I talk to her."
Luo Yunxiao and Tianshi Shengjie hurriedly followed Zhang Fei out of their shop, and the three of them moved towards the woman’s location.
Shuang Yuelan, who sensed their presence, immediately moved towards a deserted area.

Upon arrival, Shuang Yuelan raised her eyebrows after realizing that Zhang Fei’s cultivation was only at the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm. However, she didn’t dare underestimate the two women by his side, especially Tianshi Shengjie, who was clearly the strongest of the three.

Zhang Fei smirked as Shuang Yuelan’s eyes clearly looked down on him, especially since she was stronger than him with her cultivation at the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm. "Did Leng Jianmo and those old men order you to investigate us?"
"Hmm?" Shuang Yuelan was slightly surprised by Zhang Fei’s calmness. "I don’t know what you mean, and I brought you three here because I detected you following me."

Zhang Fei shook his head as he spoke. "You don’t need to lie to us because I know you left that old man’s residence, so I’m sure you’re his subordinate. If you don’t want to tell the truth, I will move to capture you. I will force you to tell the truth, and you won’t like it if I act rudely."

"Heh." Shuang Yuelan snorted at him. "Do you think you can capture me with your cultivation? Do you want to rely on the two women beside you? Are you a man who has no self-respect to rely on those two women?"
"Hahaha." Luo Yunxiao laughed upon hearing that. "Are you going to let this woman look down on you, husband?"

Tianshi Shengjie spoke to the woman. "You’re really arrogant, you know? You don’t know the depth of the sea and the height of the sky! Do you think the two of us would be on his side if he were as weak as you say?"

Shuang Yuelan wanted to attack the two women, but her body froze when a sword pressed against her neck, and she saw Zhang Fei already standing behind her, holding the sword. Moreover, she saw him still standing there and not doing anything, but her eyes widened when he disappeared. ’Impossible! Since when did he move behind me? Why can’t I see his movements at all?’

"What do you think I should do with an arrogant woman like you?" Shuang Yuelan turned around to attack Zhang Fei, but he swiftly parried her attack and locked her hands behind her. "Your cultivation is indeed one major stage above mine, but that means nothing to me because my basic strength is already far greater than yours, and my speed is also faster than yours."
Shuang Yuelan struggled to free herself, but Zhang Fei’s strength was far superior to hers, even though her cultivation was one major stage lower. "Let go of me!"

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed and let go of Shuang Yuelan, who immediately jumped away from him and took out her sword. "I already knew there were some of your master’s spies in my shop, and I deliberately left them alive to report to him. However, I didn’t expect that he would send you to me, even though he didn’t know for sure about our strength."

"Humph." Shuang Yuelan snorted and immediately attacked Zhang Fei, but he easily deflected all of her attacks, frustrating her that she couldn’t attack a cultivator who was much weaker than her. Despite her decision to quicken her pace, he effortlessly parried all her attacks.
Zhang Fei grabbed Shuang Yuelan’s sword and slashed his sword into hers, shattering it into pieces.
Shuang Yuelan jumped away from Zhang Fei and looked at her sword, which only had the hilt left, causing her heart to ache.

Zhang Fei teleported in front of Shuang Yuelan and pressed his sword against her neck. "I told you from the start that you weren’t my opponent, but you didn’t want to listen to me. Since you decided to attack me, I decided to destroy your sword as a small lesson for you."
"Kill me." Shuang Yuelan said as she looked at him with a sharp gaze.

Zhang Fei pulled his sword back from her neck. "Leave now before I change my mind! I would never kill anyone over a small matter, but I will kill your master if he dares to trouble me again. I want to trade peacefully, and I don’t want him to disturb my shop, let alone attack my wife in there."

Shuang Yuelan looked at Zhang Fei for some time, and she turned around, leaving the place. She was still shocked in her heart because he could defeat her so easily, even though she was far superior in cultivation to him.
Luo Yunxiao walked to her husband’s side and asked him a question. "Why did you decide to spare that woman, husband?"

"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled and hugged her waist. "The older I get, the more I realize things. I spared her because she wasn’t my match, and she didn’t do anything excessive. Instead, I thought about pulling her into our sect, and she would be valuable additional ammunition for us."
"Then, what are you going to do about those old men?" Tianshi Shengjie asked him.

"Nothing." Zhang Fei turned to her. "I’ll let them live for now, but I’ll kill them if they dare trouble me again. Let’s return to our shop, and we’ll leave after I’ve observed the capabilities of those buyers."
Shuang Yuelan had already returned to her headquarters, and she went to see Leng Jianmo, reporting to him about her fight with Zhang Fei just now.
"Leave."
After Shuang Yuelan left, Leng Jianmo sat limply in his chair. ’Who exactly is that man? How can he be so strong?’
