chapters.title: Chapter 1409: Tian Qiye
paragraphs: After he was sure that Zhong Yan and his other women could manage their shop on their own, Zhang Fei took the two women with him. "If I’m not mistaken, you have a private island in the Thousand River Domain, right?"

"Yes." Luo Yunxiao nodded to him. "Compared to other domains, the Thousand River Domain is much calmer, and the people in that domain are much more relaxed. They don’t like interfering in other people’s affairs, and they are more focused on their own affairs, so there is almost no commotion there. Do you want to see that island, husband?"

"Since there’s no problem in this domain, I can leave Zhong Yan and the others to manage our shop here. Moreover, our shops in the other domains are still under renovation, and we’ll have to wait at least a week before we can open them, so I want to check out the other domains." Zhang Fei turned to Tianshi Shengjie. "Has Tian Huangjin told you any news about the movements within her race?"

Tianshi Shengjie shook her head at him. "Tian Qiye and the people on her side haven’t completed their seclusion, so they haven’t come out of their private quarters. However, Tian Huangjin told me that the sign in their private quarters has started to dim, which means they will come out of their seclusion soon. I hope that they don’t find out about Mo Shentian’s departure to the Three Mortal Realms, or they will attack the Celestial Demon Domain."
"Is there a personal grudge between them?" Luo Yunxiao asked.

"Yes." Tianshi Shengjie told them directly. "Mo Shentian killed several people from the Winged Race several thousand years ago, one of whom was Tian Qiye’s son. They tried to take revenge on him, but he was too powerful for them with his ability to bend reality, and he beat them so badly that it took them quite a while to recover. Therefore, I’m sure they will attack the Celestial Demon Domain if they find out that he is going to the Three Mortal Realms, and Mo Zainan will not be able to stop them, especially since she has not yet evolved to the Demon God Rank."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I was also afraid of Mo Shentian’s reality-bending abilities, and I wasn’t confident I could defeat him with that ability. Fortunately, Feng Yao helped me prevent him from returning to this realm, and I was able to do something about his demon race members."

Tianshi Sengjie turned to him. "Do you think Mo Shentian won’t cause trouble in the Three Mortal Realms? With his current strength, he can easily destroy all the planets there. If that happens, the casualties will be enormous, and the population will decrease significantly."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "Do you think Feng Yao will allow Mo Shentian to leave the tunnel connecting the two realms? I know her quite well, and I know that she is a cunning woman. Therefore, I believe that she will never let Mo Shentian out of that tunnel, and she will probably lock him up there for a long time. Perhaps, she will only let him go after I reach my peak, and she will let me fight him myself."
"How will you reach your peak if the two souls of the ten-tailed fox are not in this realm?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.

Luo Yunxiao also asked him. "If I remember correctly, Hun Tianlang’s Envy and Greed souls are in the ancient realm, right? How are you going to find those two souls if we don’t have a way to get there?"

Zhang Fei could only sigh and shake his head at the two women. "I still haven’t found a way to get to the ancient realm, but I’m sure Feng Yao definitely has a way to get there. Apart from her, Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul definitely knows something about it, and I’ll go see him in the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain after I’ve perfectly fused with his bloodlust soul."
"Hmm?" Luo Yunxiao and Tianshi Shengjie exchanged glances for a moment. "Are you ready to face Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul?"
Their questions made Zhang Fei fall silent, and they could see that his body was trembling violently, especially since he had been so badly defeated by Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul.

Luo Yunxiao held his hand and used her qi to calm him down. "I know you’re afraid of Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul, but you’ve grown considerably since that day. Back then, my Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique hadn’t fully awakened yet, but it has now fully awakened. It’s become my main strength, and I’m confident I can help you defeat him. Furthermore, you won’t be fighting him alone, and my other sisters will be fighting by your side to help you defeat him."
"Yeah." Even though Luo Yunxiao had said that, Zhang Fei couldn’t rest easy until he defeated Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul. "Let’s go to the Thousand River Domain now."
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Thousand River Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]

The Thousand River Domain is a vast area, and it is renowned for its clear waters and numerous islands. The rivers flowed swiftly in all directions, and they formed natural paths that connected hundreds of islands of different sizes.

The domain’s atmosphere is bright, calm, and filled with powerful qi. Unlike other domains, there are no dangers there, making for a comfortable life and cultivation. Most rivers in the area are wide and fast, but some are calm and clear enough to see the bottom. Aquatic plants thrive there, and fish of various sizes swim near the surface.
Traveling between islands is easy for cultivators because they can fly, use boats, or cross simple bridges that connect each island.
Some islands are largely flat, with mostly open land suitable for growing crops and herbs for alchemy. Other islands have low hills covered with ordinary forests, bamboo groves, and other vegetation.

The atmosphere in the domain is mild year-round, making it easy for the inhabitants to adapt. Mornings and afternoons are mostly sunny, with some areas seeing light rain, but this isn’t a major problem for the residents.

The water is warm and comfortable, and the moisture from the numerous rivers creates a refreshing feeling. Even during the sweltering heat, the atmosphere is pleasant. The nights are cool, and the water reflects the moonlight clearly, giving the area a clean and tranquil atmosphere.

Luo Yunxiao led Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie to her private island, and she brought them to land on an island that wasn’t big. There was a small house far from luxury in the center, and the entire area was covered by an array of formations to protect the place from outsiders.

"Hehehe." Luo Yunxiao laughed after she brought them in. "It’s been a long time since I’ve been to this island, husband. I used to think about making this island a place for the two of us to live, but it turns out you have so many women by your side, so this island isn’t big enough to accommodate them all."
Zhang Fei smiled bitterly when he heard that and immediately hugged her. "I’m sorry; I’ve ruined your dream for the two of us to live on this island."

"Back then, I had no faith that you would make it to this realm, and I was prepared to live in solitude for the rest of my life." Luo Yunxiao hugged him and continued. "However, fate said otherwise because it brought you back to me, and I was able to be with you, so I don’t regret the situation. Even though you have many wives now, I know you love us all equally, so I’m satisfied with that."
"Yunxiao." Zhang Fei pushed Luo Yunxiao back and caressed her face. "I—"
Luo Yunxiao covered his mouth and shook her head at him. "You don’t need to say anything, okay? I’ll always be by your side, and I’ll do anything to help you."
"You two are like lovebirds." Tianshi Shengjie suddenly received a voice transmission, and she immediately informed them. "Tian Qiye and the others have come out of their seclusion."
"How is the result?"

"Tian Qiye successfully broke through to the Celestial God Realm, and she became the strongest in the Winged Race, surpassing Uncle Yizu and the others." Zhang Fei’s expression turned ugly upon hearing Tianshi Shengjie’s statement. "You must be careful not to let her discover your other identities, particularly your identity as a lust demon. You also have to be careful not to let her find out about Nalan Yushu, or she will hunt you both down."
"Yeah."

In the Radiance Domain, Tian Qiye walked out of her cultivation cave, and all the members of the race immediately knelt down to greet her. "If I’m not mistaken, you have a private island in the Thousand River Domain, right?"
"Yes." Luo Yunxiao nodded to him.
"Compared to other domains, the Thousand River Domain is much calmer, and the people in that domain are much more relaxed.
They don’t like interfering in other people’s affairs, and they are more focused on their own affairs, so there is almost no commotion there.
Do you want to see that island, husband?"
"Since there’s no problem in this domain, I can leave Zhong Yan and the others to manage our shop here.

Moreover, our shops in the other domains are still under renovation, and we’ll have to wait at least a week before we can open them, so I want to check out the other domains." Zhang Fei turned to Tianshi Shengjie.
"Has Tian Huangjin told you any news about the movements within her race?"
Tianshi Shengjie shook her head at him.
"Tian Qiye and the people on her side haven’t completed their seclusion, so they haven’t come out of their private quarters.
However, Tian Huangjin told me that the sign in their private quarters has started to dim, which means they will come out of their seclusion soon.
I hope that they don’t find out about Mo Shentian’s departure to the Three Mortal Realms, or they will attack the Celestial Demon Domain."
"Is there a personal grudge between them?" Luo Yunxiao asked.
"Yes." Tianshi Shengjie told them directly.
"Mo Shentian killed several people from the Winged Race several thousand years ago, one of whom was Tian Qiye’s son.
They tried to take revenge on him, but he was too powerful for them with his ability to bend reality, and he beat them so badly that it took them quite a while to recover.

Therefore, I’m sure they will attack the Celestial Demon Domain if they find out that he is going to the Three Mortal Realms, and Mo Zainan will not be able to stop them, especially since she has not yet evolved to the Demon God Rank."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"I was also afraid of Mo Shentian’s reality-bending abilities, and I wasn’t confident I could defeat him with that ability.
Fortunately, Feng Yao helped me prevent him from returning to this realm, and I was able to do something about his demon race members."
Tianshi Sengjie turned to him.
"Do you think Mo Shentian won’t cause trouble in the Three Mortal Realms?
With his current strength, he can easily destroy all the planets there.
If that happens, the casualties will be enormous, and the population will decrease significantly."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at that.
"Do you think Feng Yao will allow Mo Shentian to leave the tunnel connecting the two realms?
I know her quite well, and I know that she is a cunning woman.
Therefore, I believe that she will never let Mo Shentian out of that tunnel, and she will probably lock him up there for a long time.
Perhaps, she will only let him go after I reach my peak, and she will let me fight him myself."
"How will you reach your peak if the two souls of the ten-tailed fox are not in this realm?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.
Luo Yunxiao also asked him.

How are you going to find those two souls if we don’t have a way to get there?"
Zhang Fei could only sigh and shake his head at the two women.

"Are you ready to face Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul?"
Their questions made Zhang Fei fall silent, and they could see that his body was trembling violently, especially since he had been so badly defeated by Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul.
Luo Yunxiao held his hand and used her qi to calm him down.
"I know you’re afraid of Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul, but you’ve grown considerably since that day.
Back then, my Heaven-Earth Reversal Physique hadn’t fully awakened yet, but it has now fully awakened.
It’s become my main strength, and I’m confident I can help you defeat him.
Furthermore, you won’t be fighting him alone, and my other sisters will be fighting by your side to help you defeat him."
"Yeah." Even though Luo Yunxiao had said that, Zhang Fei couldn’t rest easy until he defeated Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul.
"Let’s go to the Thousand River Domain now."

Unlike other domains, there are no dangers there, making for a comfortable life and cultivation.
Most rivers in the area are wide and fast, but some are calm and clear enough to see the bottom.
Aquatic plants thrive there, and fish of various sizes swim near the surface.
Traveling between islands is easy for cultivators because they can fly, use boats, or cross simple bridges that connect each island.
Some islands are largely flat, with mostly open land suitable for growing crops and herbs for alchemy.
Other islands have low hills covered with ordinary forests, bamboo groves, and other vegetation.
The atmosphere in the domain is mild year-round, making it easy for the inhabitants to adapt.

chapters.title: Chapter 1410: Tian Qiye’s Orders
paragraphs: Tian Qiye was a beautiful, stunning, and elegant woman, and her appearance was even more majestic with twelve golden wings behind her back.

Tian Qiye had bright golden eyes that sparkled brightly, and her long golden hair flowed down her back to her hips, making her look very graceful. Her expression was very gentle but also serious, making all the men from her race not dare to look directly at her.

Tian Qiye’s body was tall and slender, and her golden dress perfectly hugged her body, showcasing her incomparable beauty. Her figure was absolutely flawless with big breasts, a slim waist, wide hips, and long legs.

Tian Qiye, with a relaxed face and seeming not to care, listened to the reports from the elders of his race, especially regarding the movements of the demon races. Her expression changed several times, and she often showed anger that others didn’t realize when they delivered their reports.

"Leader, I think we should move to get rid of the people from the Nirvana Sky Main Domain." Tian Qiye turned to an old man, who was one of the grand elders of the Winged Race. "They’re collaborating with the Nine Nether Demon Race, and most of the people from the clans in that domain have already turned into demons, including the leader of the Spirit Temple, Sheng Yaohun."

Tian Qiye raised an eyebrow. "Is it true that the people from the Spirit Temple and those clans have experienced such a severe decline that they’ve been forced to choose to become demons, Tian Liefeng?"

"Yes." Tian Liefeng nodded at her. "Some time ago, I went to that domain and found that the people there, especially their higher-ups, had already turned into demons. According to my investigation, they decided to be the subordinates of the Nine Nether Demon God, Jiu Mozu. They’ve done many horrible things in the past few years, but I didn’t take direct action against them, and I was waiting for you to come out of your seclusion."
Tian Qiye did not immediately make a decision regarding the people from the Nirvana Sky Main Domain and asked the other grand elders. "What about the other demon gods, Tian Hanyun?"

"According to the information I received, the Celestial Demon God decided to cover his domain with defensive formations, but I don’t know what he’s actually planning." Tian Hanyun answered respectfully. "I also heard that the Asura Demon God decided to enter seclusion some time ago, and he hasn’t shown any signs of coming out to this day. As for the other demon gods, they didn’t show any significant movement, and they seemed to be waiting for something before acting."

Tian Qiye fell into contemplation and thought about everything, especially about the activities of the demon gods, which were really strange to her. They usually caused commotion in various domains, but they suddenly became passive, which was really unusual in her opinion.

Tian Qiye felt strange about Mo Shentian’s decision to cover the Celestial Demon Domain with defensive formations, which was something he would never have done in the past because he was so confident in his abilities. ’Could he be planning something out of the ordinary?’ "What about the movements of those evil beasts, Tian Yaoqin?"

"There’s been no movement at all of the four perils, Leader." Tian Qiye looked at Tian Yaoqin in surprise. "Taotie and the three evil beasts seem to be waiting for something, so they haven’t made any movements for all these years. Moreover, Long Wuzhao and the others are always monitoring their movements, and those righteous beasts will move to stop them if they dare to cause trouble in other domains."
Tian Qiye nodded slightly and looked at the other grand elders, especially those standing opposite her, such as Tian Yizu and his group.
A female grand elder suddenly spoke to Tian Qiye. "Leader, there are slight changes occurring in the human races."
"Hmm?" Tian Qiye looked at the female grand elder. "What changes are you referring to, Tian Xuanyin?"

"The sect is called the Moonlit Passion Temple, which is part of the Twin Flames Main Domain." Tian Yizu, Tian Huangjin, and the others stiffened after Tian Xuanyin mentioned that sect. "That sect used to be a dual cultivation sect, and their changes were very significant, Leader. While I was in another domain, I heard them recruiting people, and the sect members said that their sect was no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal sect."

"We don’t need to interfere in that sect’s affairs because it will only waste our precious time, and we should focus on dealing with the demons. Moreover, that sect is just a small sect, and its changes don’t have a significant impact." Tian Qiye spoke about other matters. "Instead of us dealing with useless things like that sect, I want the few of you to investigate Mo Shentian’s reasons for covering the Celestial Demon Domain with defensive formations, and you should report the results to me as soon as possible."
Tian Xuanyin spoke again. "You’re wrong about that sect, Leader."
"What do you mean?" Tian Qiye asked with raised eyebrows.

Tian Xuanyin glanced at Tian Yizu and the others for a moment. "The Moonlit Passion Temple used to be a small sect, but it’s changed now. They’ve managed to recruit people who stand at the pinnacle of all cultivation paths, such as Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and people from many other clans."
"Oh?" Tian Qiye became interested in the Moonlit Passion Temple after hearing that. "Is it true that Jian Kuang and Su Shentian joined the sect? What’s their reason for joining the sect?"

"I’m not sure why Jian Kuang and Su Shentian joined the sect, Leader." Tian Xuanyin immediately explained several other things to her. "I heard that the sect’s change occurred due to the influence of a man who recently joined them, and his name is Zhang Fei. According to sect members who went to other domains to recruit, he is still very young, and his cultivation has only reached the Celestial Lord Realm. However, he is skilled in many fields, and his ranks in those fields have already reached the peak, such as god-rank sword master, god-rank alchemist, and so on. Oh! He also ascended to this realm relatively recently, about six and a half years ago."
Tian Qiye raised her eyebrows. "How could Zhang Fei achieve all that if he only ascended to the realm about six and a half years ago?"

"I don’t know about that." Tian Xuanyin replied with a shake of her head. "Even though that sect used to be a dual cultivation sect, they’ve entirely changed, and they’ve become the talk of the realm. Do you want to send people to that sect, Leader?"

Tian Qiye thought about the matter for a while, and she wanted to know more about how Zhang Fei could do all that. "I’m curious about him and that sect, but we don’t need to interfere in their affairs. As long as they’re not a heretical sect, their development will benefit the realm."

Tian Qiye’s decision brought relief to Tian Yizu, Tian Huangjin, and the others. They already knew more or less about Zhang Fei, and they didn’t want their race to have any problems with him, especially since he was under Feng Yao’s protection.
Tian Xuanyin looked at Tian Qiye, and she glanced at Tian Yizu’s group, who seemed tense about the matter.
Tian Qiye spoke to the other two. "Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu, listen to my orders."
"Yes, Leader." Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu waited for orders.

Tian Qiye stood up and delivered her orders. "Lead the best of our race to destroy the Spirit Temple and the clans in the Nirvana Sky Main Domain! Destroy those who have relations with Jiu Mozu and the Nine Nether Demon Race without exception!"
"Yes." Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu immediately left the room.
"Follow me! I have another task for you." Tian Qiye said to the grand elders who were loyal to him.

Without saying anything, those people followed Tian Qiye, and they disappeared together from the main hall. Most of the remaining people also left, leaving only a few behind, including Tian Yizu’s Group.
"Why did you mention the Moonlit Passion Temple and Zhang Fei to our leader?" Tian Yizu asked Tian Xuanyin.
"Haha." Tian Xuanyin laughed in response. "Why should you be afraid of her? Sooner or later, our leader will find out about the sect, so I deliberately told her now."

Tian Yizu shook his head at her. "You don’t know anything about our leader, and you underestimate her curiosity. She did say she wouldn’t interfere in the sect’s affairs, but I’m sure she’ll send someone close to her to go there. If she really does send one of them there, I’m sure she’ll think twice once she learns more about the sect, and she might even consider them a threat in the future."

"You think too much, and you become afraid of her because of your thoughts." Tian Xuanyin shook her head as she spoke. "I’m sure our leader won’t pay any attention to that sect even if it has undergone significant changes, so you don’t need to worry that she will send people there. We should go back now; I’m sure she will order us to do something after this."
Tian Xuanyin flew away, leaving them alone. Tian Wei spoke to Tian Yizu. "You must warn Zhang Fei so he can be prepared if our leader’s trusted people come to his sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 1411: Jiangshen Domain/Ghost Domain
paragraphs: "You don’t need to contact Zhang Fei, Father." Tian Yizu and the others turned to Tian Huangjin. "I’ve informed Tianshi Shengjie about everything, and she is currently with him, so I am confident that she has already communicated our leader’s decision to him."
"That’s good." Tian Yizu examined his daughter’s body. "How did your soul power increase so significantly after you returned from the Moonlit Passion Sect?"
Tian Wei and Tian You’an were also curious about this, prompting Tian Huangjin to explain to them about the Yin-Yang Lotus Temple in the Ashen Lotus Monastery, which surprised them.
"Such a place actually exists, huh?"

"Yes." Tian Huangjin nodded at Tian You’an. "Unfortunately, no one can enter that place because the portal is unknown, Grand Elder. However, Zhang Fei has a special ability to go there, and he has brought many people there to cultivate their souls."
"I see." Tian You’an nodded in understanding. "Let’s go now, or our leader will be suspicious of us."

Tian You’an and Tian Wei flew away from the place, but Tian Yizu did not leave right away. "Huangjin, I forbid you from going to the Moonlit Passion Sect for now. You can return to the sect once the situation has calmed down."
"Yes, Father."
After Tian Yizu left, Tian Huotian asked Tian Huangjin. "Do you think it’s okay if we leave Tian Zhiling in the sect? Should we ask her to return to our domain instead?"

"Hmm?" Tian Huangjin thought for a moment. "Tian Zhiling isn’t the child of a grand elder like us, so I’m sure our leader won’t notice her absence. However, I will warn her to be careful if our leader sends one of his trusted aides to the sect, so she can hide from that person later."
Tian Huotian nodded in agreement with that. "Alright, you can contact her now, and you have to ask her to be careful with our leader’s people."
"Yeah." They hurried to leave the place, and Tian Huangjin contacted Tian Zhiling, asking her to be careful.
"Did Tian Yizu and his group do something while I was in my seclusion?" Tian Qiye asked her aides.

Tian Liefeng answered her directly. "Leader, Tian Yizu and his group almost never left our domain, but they once went together to eliminate one of Jiu Mozu’s subordinates in the Twin Flames Main Domain a few months ago."
"Hmm?" Tian Qiye turned to face him. "Where did they get the information about the demon’s presence in that domain?"
"I don’t have any information about that."

"Do they have ties to any of the sects in that domain?" None of them had an answer for Tian Qiye, but she had other thoughts and ordered two of them. "Tian Yaoqin and Tian Hanyun, I want you two to go to the Moonlit Passion Temple to see the situation in the sect, and you guys must report everything you see in the sect to me, especially regarding Zhang Fei."
"Yes." Tian Yaoqin and Tian Hanyun immediately left the place for the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Tian Liefeng asked her directly, "Do you think Tian Yizu and the others have any connections with Zhang Fei, Leader?"

"That’s just my guess right now." Tian Qiye fell into deep thought for a moment before continuing, "If only one demon appears in that domain, they shouldn’t have needed to go there together, and they could simply send one of their own to kill it. I think their going to that domain has something to do with Zhang Fei, and he might be hiding something related to our race, so they have to go there to meet him."
"For example?"

"I can’t guess their reasons until I have clear information about Zhang Fei and the sect, and I will wait for Tian Yaoqin and Tian Hanyun to return before I make a decision on this matter." Tian Qiye fell into deep thought once again, and she took out a golden shield. However, the golden shield was sealed by golden chains, which surprised Tian Liefeng.
"Leader, that golden shield—"

"That’s right." Tian Qiye nodded to him. "This golden shield is the Holy Radiance Shield, and it belongs to our first ancestor, Tian Huangjin. I found this shield several thousand years ago in one of the domains, and I have kept it ever since. I have never shown it to anyone because I know many of our race are loyal to our first ancestor, and they have long awaited her return, including Tian Yizu and his group. Unfortunately, I have never been able to break the seal, even though my cultivation has reached the Celestial God Realm."
"So, only our first ancestor can use this set of equipment, right?"

"Ancestor Tian Huangjin is the only person who can wear this set of equipment." Tian Qiye kept the shield in her storage. "As for the Holy Radiance Sword, it chose Tian Yizu’s daughter as its new owner, and I couldn’t do anything to stop the sword from choosing her. As for her crown, armor, cape, and boots, I’ve searched for them in various domains, but I never managed to find one of them."

Tian Liefeng suddenly remembered something and shared it with her. "A few years ago, I heard about the appearance of a golden light in the Jiangshen Domain, and I thought it had something to do with one of the equipment sets. I tried to check in that domain, but all the ghosts there were bothering me, so I couldn’t reach that place."
"Hmm?" Tian Qiye raised her eyebrows. "Have those ghosts gotten stronger?"

"Haish." Tian Liefeng sighed heavily as he shook his head. "Leader, you have been in seclusion for so long that you were unaware of the changes in that domain; all the ghosts have become stronger since the appearance of the ghost emperor. The ghost emperor is extremely powerful, and I almost lost my life when I was inspecting the domain because he kept attacking me. Not to mention, the Spirit Willow Tree also resides in that domain, and the ghost emperor will kill anyone who approaches the tree."
Tian Qiye raised an eyebrow after hearing that. "The ghost emperor and the Spirit Willow Tree, huh?"

"You shouldn’t go to that domain, Leader." Tian Qiye looked at Tian Liefeng again. "That domain has changed a lot since I last went there, and it’s filled with ghost miasma now. If you set foot there, I’m sure the ghost miasma will enter your body, and—"

"You look down on me too much." Tian Qiye’s body suddenly glowed golden, blinding Tian Liefeng’s eyes. "When our winged race breaks through to the Celestial God Realm, our basic forms will evolve, and we will gain new abilities. The ghost emperor and the Spirit Willow Tree may be powerful, but I’m confident I can defeat them, so I’ll go to that domain now to check whether the golden light is related to the Holy Radiance Equipment or not."
"Are you going there yourself?" Tian Qiye didn’t say anything and enveloped Tian Liefeng with her aura, taking him away from their domain. ’I will definitely die if she takes me to that domain.’
After some time, Tian Qiye and Tian Liefeng reached the Jiangshen Domain, where dense ghost miasma enveloped it, limiting their visibility.
Tian Qiye enveloped them with her aura, preventing the ghost miasma from invading their bodies. She also activated her defenses, especially since the place was filled with wandering ghosts.
Many wandering ghosts tried to attack them, but they couldn’t penetrate Tian Qiye’s defenses, and they died instantly the moment they touched it.

Tian Liefeng was shocked to see this, and he desperately wanted to break through to the Celestial God Realm. Unfortunately, he didn’t know how to break through because it wasn’t an ordinary realm, and they had to find their own way.
Tian Qiye tried to spread her senses throughout the domain, but she frowned because she couldn’t do that, and she felt that something was intentionally limiting her senses.
"Where was the last time you saw that golden light?" Tian Qiye turned to him.

Tian Liefeng shook his head at her. "I’ve only heard about it from someone who’s been here, but I’ve never seen the golden light with my own eyes. However, that person said that the location is not far from the Spirit Willow Tree, which should be in the central area of this domain."

"Hmm?" Tian Qiye once again tried to spread her senses throughout the domain, but she got the same result, as her senses were restricted by something mysterious, preventing her from detecting too far. She was confused by it all, and she thought twice about venturing deeper into the domain. ’What exactly is restricting my senses? I’ve already broken through to the Celestial God Realm, so there shouldn’t be anything that could restrict my senses this much.’
However, Tian Qiye did not know that the Spirit Willow Tree was no ordinary living creature, and it had lived far longer than her.

"Are you going to check this domain, Leader?" Tian Liefeng looked at the wandering ghosts that kept attacking them, but they always died as soon as they touched Tian Qiye’s barrier. ’Unbelievable! Her barrier is truly strong to deal with these ghosts.’
"I can’t use my senses to check the domain areas, so we’ll have to go ourselves to check the central area." Tian Liefeng smiled wryly in response to Tian Qiyer’s decision. "Let’s go there."

chapters.title: Chapter 1412: Two Grand Elders
paragraphs: Jiu Moze walked into Jiu Mozu’s room and ordered him to prepare to go to the Nirvana Main Domain. "Our leader ordered us to deal with the two Winged Race members who went to that domain to kill our subordinates, so we will go there to rescue them and capture those two."
"Yes." Jiu Mozu summoned nine of his subordinates, including Jiu Yaoming.
Thereafter, they left the Nine Nether Demon Domain, and they hurriedly went to the Nirvana Main Domain.
"Are you sure it won’t be a problem if we capture the two grand elders of the winged race?"

Zhang Fei turned to Tianshi Shengjie. "You already know my habits, right? I won’t lock up the two grand elders, but I will use them to keep an eye on Tian Qiye. Since that woman has already broken through to the Celestial God Realm, I am currently no match for her. Even if I borrow the power of all the evil beasts, I still won’t be able to fight her, so I’ll monitor her movements for now."

"The difference in strength between a cultivator at the Celestial Venerable Realm and one at the Celestial God Realm is vast, comparable to the difference between heaven and earth." Tianshi Shengjie reminded him. "Even if you borrow the strength of all nine evil beasts, your current strength will still be no match for Tian Qiye’s, and she can defeat you easily."

Zhang Fei released a soft sigh. "I’ve been aware of that ever since I met Long Wuzhao, my father-in-law, and Long Xukong. That’s why I won’t fight Tian Qiye directly, and I’ll use other means to fight her. However, I won’t do it now because it will only disturb our peace, and I’ll fight her in the future when I’m ready to fight cultivators at her level."

’He is too shameless! I haven’t even accepted him yet, but he already addresses my father as his father-in-law.’ Tianshi Shengjie asked him again. "So, what are you going to do with the two Winged Race grand elders who went to our sect?"

"Hahaha." Luo Yunxiao burst out laughing when she saw her husband’s smile. "Are you thinking of capturing Tian Yaoqin, husband? You already have four Winged Race women in your harem, but they’re not as strong as that woman, so I’ll support you if you want to make her your woman."
Tianshi Shengjie raised an eyebrow. "Do you really want to capture Tian Yaoqin? If Tian Qiye finds out about that, she will be furious and attack our sect."

"Haha." Zhang Fei pulled Tianshi Shengjie into his lap while she was unprepared, and he kissed her, leaving her stunned. "Honestly, I’m more interested in making you my woman, especially after I saw you naked in the giant Yin-Yang Lotus. Unfortunately, you’re not ready to be my woman yet, so I’ll wait until you’re truly ready to surrender yourself to me."
Tianshi Shengjie glared at him and shifted from his lap. "To be honest, I’ve been in love with you for a long time, but I’m not ready to be your wife yet, and you should already know my reasons."

"I know." Zhang Fei looked ahead. "No matter how long I have to wait, I will wait until you are truly ready. When you are truly ready, I will take you as my wife, and you will enjoy yourself with me."
"Shameless." Tianshi Shengjie cursed at Zhang Fei as she blushed, especially since she knew his dirty thoughts.

Zhang Fei simply smiled and opened a portal. "I’ve already thought of a plan for this island, but I’ll finalize it first before executing it. We should return to our sect first, as the two grand elders of the Winged Race have already arrived there."
"Let’s go." Zhang Fei brought the two women into the portal and returned to the Moonlit Passion Sect.

After they returned to the Moonlit Passion Temple, Zhang Fei sent several of his clones to Nirvana Main Domain to assist Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu, mainly because he was not confident that the two demons would be able to face the two grand elders of the Winged Race.

Tian Yaoqin and Tian Hanyun had just arrived at the Twin Flames Main Domain, but they were surprised to see that the entire area had been transformed into a dense forest full of tall trees, making it difficult for them to see all the sects in the domain without using their senses.
Even so, Tian Yaoqin and Tian Hanyun could see the Moonlit Passion Temple clearly, especially because the sect’s position was floating high in the sky of that domain.
"Was this domain really like this before?" Tian Hanyun asked, looking at the entire area of the domain.

"No." Tian Yaoqin shook her head at him. "The people of our race who entered the Endless Night Dungeon didn’t mention any changes to this domain, so I’m sure it changed after they exited that place. Let’s go to that sect now, but we have to disguise our appearance so that we don’t attract unnecessary attention."
"Let’s go." After they disguised their appearance, especially their wings, Tian Yaoqin and Tian Hanyun flew toward the sect..
When Tian Yaoqin and Tian Hanyun arrived at the Moonlit Passion Temple, they were shocked by the multiple layers of barriers protecting the sect, especially the void barrier created by Bing Xingying.
However, Tian Yaoqin and Tian Hanyun didn’t see Tian Kui and Serpentera because Zhang Fei had hidden them in his beast space, especially since they were evil beasts.
Tian Hanyun touched the void barrier. "This barrier is strong, and we can’t possibly break through it without knowledge of the void element."

"That’s right." Tian Yaoqin also touched the void barrier. "As far as I know, only Kong Bai and Nu Liexi have void elements, but they won’t interfere in the affairs of ordinary sects, especially since this sect is a former dual cultivation sect."
"Who else in this Paradise Realm cultivator has the void element?"

"I don’t know." Tian Yaoqin replied with a shake of her head. "Void cultivators usually hide themselves well, and they won’t come to the surface, mainly because they are worried that stronger cultivators will capture them and make them slaves."

Tian Hanyun was truly curious about the identity of the person who helped the Moonlit Passion Temple to create the void barrier, especially since it was powerful enough to prevent grand elders like them from entering the sect.
Tian Yaoqin and Tian Hanyun raised their eyebrows when Zhang Fei, Qing Qiu’er, and You Feling appeared before them.

"What are the two grand elders of the Winged Race doing in our sect?" Tian Yaoqin and Tian Hanyun were shocked by Qing Qiu’er’s question. "Even though you two have hidden your wings, I can still guess your identities with a special method of mine."

’This woman’s cultivation is equivalent to us in the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.’ Tian Yaoqin and Tian Hanyun glanced at Zhang Fei. ’Is he the man that Tian Xuanyin meant before? She previously said that his cultivation was at the Celestial Lord Realm, but his cultivation had already reached the Celestial King Realm.’

Zhang Fei tried to use the demon charm on Tian Yaoqin, but his attempt failed. After all, she was a member of the Winged Race with a high cultivation base, so he wasn’t surprised she was able to ward off his demon charm. He decided to dispel the qi enveloping his body, and some of his abilities affected her, making her heart pound.

’What the hell did he do to me?’ Tian Yaoqin screamed in shock as soon as she felt the impact of Zhang Fei’s abilities, but she didn’t feel the movement of qi within his body because his passive demon abilities didn’t use it. She tried to suppress the feeling with her light element and aura, but neither could eliminate it; instead, the effects of his passive abilities grew stronger and affected her even more.

Zhang Fei used his free will manipulation and subconscious abilities, making Tian Yaoqin even more uncomfortable with herself. She felt various strange feelings for him, which made her want him so much. ’What did he do to me? Why do I feel this way towards him?
Qing Qiu’er noticed the changes in Tian Yaoqin’s eyes and body movements, and she asked them again. "So, what is your purpose in coming to visit my sect today?"

"You’re right, we’re both grand elders of the Winged Race." Tian Hanyun said this while he and Tian Yaoqin displayed their wings. "We just received news today about the changes in your sect, including the addition of many new halls, so we came here to see what other changes have occurred. Additionally, we heard that you have a new male elder, who I believe is the man beside you. Is he really the one?"

"Haha." Qing Qiu’er laughed upon hearing that. "I didn’t expect the Winged Race to pay so much attention to my small sect, but you were right. The man beside me was the new elder of my sect, and he’s the one who brought about all the changes within it. Even though his status is an elder, he is also my partner."
"Is his name Zhang Fei?" Tian Yaoqin asked the question, but her heart skipped a beat when Zhang Fei smiled at her.
Zhang Fei cupped his hands at them. "My name is indeed Zhang Fei, and I ascended to this Paradise Realm approximately six and a half years ago, seniors."

"We just received news today about the changes in your sect, including the addition of many new halls, so we came here to see what other changes have occurred.
Additionally, we heard that you have a new male elder, who I believe is the man beside you.
Is he really the one?"
"Haha." Qing Qiu’er laughed upon hearing that.
"I didn’t expect the Winged Race to pay so much attention to my small sect, but you were right.
The man beside me was the new elder of my sect, and he’s the one who brought about all the changes within it.
Even though his status is an elder, he is also my partner."
"Is his name Zhang Fei?" Tian Yaoqin asked the question, but her heart skipped a beat when Zhang Fei smiled at her.
Zhang Fei cupped his hands at them.
"My name is indeed Zhang Fei, and I ascended to this Paradise Realm approximately six and a half years ago, seniors."

chapters.title: Chapter 1413: Accompany Two Guests
paragraphs: Tian Hanyun observed Zhang Fei’s body before speaking to him. "I heard that your cultivation was at the Celestial Lord Realm, but it turns out you’ve already broken through to the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at his words, and he hugged the waists of the two women beside him. "Grand elder, I’m a dual cultivator, and I have two powerful women by my side. Additionally, I still have several partners, so I can’t let them down."

Tian Hanyun looked at Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling. ’One of them has the same cultivation as me, and the other is two minor cultivations lower than mine. This young man is truly lucky to have them, and he was able to improve his cultivation so quickly thanks to their help.’
"Can you take us into your sect to see the halls?" Tian Yaoqin asked calmly, but her heart was getting more uncomfortable because Zhang Fei’s abilities were affecting her more.
"Sure." Zhang Fei brought the two women into the sect, followed by Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin.

Zhang Fei and the two women led Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin to each hall, starting with the Sword Hall. They observed Jian Kuang instructing the sect’s disciples in swordsmanship, but his primary focus was on training Jun Qingling.
Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin exchanged incredulous glances, and Jian Kuang’s presence there proved Tian Xuanyin’s information that he had joined the Moonlit Passion Sect correct.

Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin also saw Zhuxian Sheng; they didn’t know him directly, but they had heard of his name and his fighting abilities, especially because he possessed the Ancestral Battle Saint Physique.
Jian Kuang and Zhuxian Sheng looked at Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin for a moment, but they didn’t say anything to the two and simply ignored them, focusing on training those disciples.

The winged race coveted Zhuxian Sheng’s Ancestral Battle Saint Physique, but they did not approach him, mainly because their people considered humans far inferior to them. The winged race was also different from all the demon races, which typically resorted to any means of acquiring something valuable. Therefore, they did not take action against him, despite their desire to obtain his special physique.
Thereafter, Zhang Fei and the two women took Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin to the Soul Hall, where they were shocked to see Hun Di and his disciples.

Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin’s attention was drawn to Hun Di, mainly because his soul level was higher than his cultivation, which proved that he was talented in soul cultivation rather than normal cultivation.
"He is my master in soul cultivation." Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin turned to Zhang Fei. "In fact, I was his youngest disciple, and he accepted me because of my talent in soul cultivation."
Tian Hanyun asked him directly. "How can you reach the peak rank in several fields at once?"
"Someone told us that you’re a god-rank sword master, a god-rank alchemist, and so on." Tian Yaoqin spoke.
Zhang Fei turned to them. "I live a leisurely life in the Three Mortal Realms, so I have plenty of time to learn all kinds of things. Without realizing it, I had reached the peak in those fields."
’You are a liar!’ Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin screamed in their hearts.
Tian Hanyun asked. "How do you learn all those fields if your body and mind are only one?"

"There’s no way you can learn them all at once, especially at your age, which is less than half a century." Tian Yaoqin said this while suppressing her urge to hug and kiss Zhang Fei. "Even if your talent in those fields is extraordinary, you won’t be able to reach their peak stages in your lifetime."

"Other people may not be able to do it, but that doesn’t mean I can’t do it, right? Those are all my secrets, and you can’t possibly expect me to reveal them, right?" Zhang Fei’s answer made Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin curious about him, as no cultivator could study all fields to the peak stage. "I just like new things that I’ve never learned before, and I learn them in turn to fill my spare time. If I find new things again, and I feel interested in them, I will definitely learn them too."

Qing Qiu’er spoke to them. "You two don’t know Zhang Fei, and he will spend days, months, or even years learning new things. He will never stop until he has mastered them, and he will work hard to learn them."

Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin didn’t argue with Qing Qiu’er because people like that did exist, but they didn’t believe that Zhang Fei could learn all these fields and reach the peak stage in each of them at such a young age.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei and the two women took Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin to see the other halls, starting with the Body Hall, the Speed Hall, the Assassin Hall, the Domain Hall, the Puppetry Hall, and the Book Hall. However, the two guests were not interested in any of these halls, mainly because the people there were too weak.

Their next stop was the Medical Hall, where Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin saw Elmyra treating disciples who had suffered injuries after going to other domains to train and carry out missions. However, Zhang Fei had already hidden Tian Zhiling, Tian Gongzhu, and Tian Jianxia elsewhere.

Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin recognized those from the Qiao Clan because they were renowned healers, and only the Zhi Clan held a higher status than them due to the larger number of healers in the latter clan. However, they did not expect that the Qiao Clan would willingly join the Moonlit Passion Sect, and they taught several disciples who were interested in healing methods.

Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin were shocked when they saw Jiang Yinghua, Meng Tianshi, Daniella, and Chiel in the Medical Hall, especially since the four of them were Winged Race like them. They turned to Zhang Fei, asking for an explanation.

Zhang Fei shook his head at them before explaining. "The four of them are not the Winged Race from this realm, so you two don’t need to worry about that. They are my women, and I brought them from the Three Mortal Realms."
"Are there many people from our race in the Three Mortal Realms?" Tian Hanyun questioned this because he had never descended there, especially since it was useless and a waste of his time.

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Tian Hanyun. "There is a realm called the Tian Realm within the Three Mortal Realms, and its inhabitants belong to the Winged Race, like the two of you. Their numbers are quite large, around tens of thousands. Not all of them can cultivate like us, and I only found out about a few of them. The Winged Race also inhabits several other realms, but I have no connection to them."
"How big are the Three Mortal Realms?" Tian Yaoqin asked calmly, but her desire to hug and kiss Zhang Fei grew stronger as time passed.

"Wait." Zhang Fei took out the memory extractor, showing Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin the Three Mortal Realms. "Compared to this Paradise Realm, the Three Mortal Realms are much smaller when all the realms there are combined. They are divided into three different categories: the lower realm, the Middle realm, and the upper realm."
"What about the Tian Realm?"
"The Tian Realm is in the lower realm, and its inhabitants are not cultivators like us."
Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin looked at the four Winged Race members, but neither could determine when they cultivated, especially since their bone age indicated they were quite old.
Zhang Fei turned off the memory extractor and took the two women with him, leading Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin to another area, which was the Blacksmith Hall.

Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin recognized some of the people there, such as people from the Liao and You Clans, who were busy teaching the disciples of the Moonlit Passion Sect. They were also shocked to see people from both clans, especially since they were willing to join the sect to teach the disciples.
Zhang Fei led his two women and their two guests toward the Array Hall, where Liao Hanxue and Duanmu Luolan were busy creating new array formations.

Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin were no strangers to the presence of the young miss of the Liao Clan, especially since they had already seen people from her clan in Blacksmith Hall. However, they were curious about Duanmu Luolan because they sensed Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi within her body, which proved she was one of his women.

Zhang Fei didn’t explain much to Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin about the Array Hall, which made them curious about the void barrier that protected the sect. He led them to the last hall, which was the Alchemy Hall.

Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin were shocked when they arrived, finding several god-rank alchemists there, such as Lin Jingxia, Tian Shuixiang, and Feng Shanxi. Not to mention, there were also several other senior alchemists, such as Nanfeng Yunxi, Huoyun Zhiyan, Sun Jianming, and Xiu Hanyu.
Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin’s attention was drawn to Feng Shanxi, who was concentrating on concocting pills. "That woman isn’t human and is a Fire Phoenix, right?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded at them. "Feng Shanxi is a fire phoenix, and she is an old friend of mine from the Three Mortal Realms."

chapters.title: Chapter 1414: Trapped Two Grand Elders
paragraphs: Zhang Fei, accompanied by Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling, took Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin to inspect other areas, especially the residences of the other races.
Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin were shocked when they saw humans, mythical beast races, and natural races living together in one sect in peace and harmony, something unprecedented.

Zhang Fei deliberately revealed the current situation of their sect to Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin, but he did not show them the existence of the demons, mainly because the winged race hated them so much. "They are all my friends from the Three Mortal Realms, so I brought them here after I ascended here for a few years."
"Does that mean you can return to the Three Mortal Realms easily?" Tian Hanyun asked.

"No." Zhang Fei denied with a shake of his head. "Like other people from this Paradise Realm, I can return there through one of the tunnels that connect the two realms. That tunnel tends to be shorter than the others, and I have a flying artifact with quite high speed, but it still takes me quite a long time to travel there. They have helped me a lot in the past, so I couldn’t possibly forget them, and I took the time to pick them up and bring them here."

Tian Yaoqin didn’t say anything to Zhang Fei, as she tried hard to suppress the urge that rose up from within her to hug and kiss him, which made her frustrated because she had to keep holding herself back. ’Shit! At this rate, I won’t be able to hold myself back from hugging and kissing him, so I have to leave this sect immediately.’

Zhang Fei was naturally aware that Tian Yaoqin was increasingly being affected by her demonic abilities, and he just smiled, waiting for her to fall under his influence. ’Ha ha! Let’s see, how much longer can you hold yourself back? At that time, I would enjoy having a grand elder like you in my arms.’
Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling also noticed Tian Yaoqin’s action of glancing at Zhang Fei repeatedly, and they exchanged glances while smiling at each other without the two grand elders realizing.

"I see." Tian Hanyun nodded in understanding. "At first, I didn’t believe that this sect would transform from a dual cultivation sect to a universal one, but I’ve seen all the changes with my own eyes. In this Paradise Realm, this sect is probably the only one inhabited by people from various races, especially since some races are always hostile to each other."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "If all races could live in harmony and peace, why would we be enemies with each other, right? For me, all races have their advantages and disadvantages, and each race has evil members. The winged race in my home realm is far more malevolent than the demon race, and they want to rule all three realms. I could have wiped them out because they were not cultivators, but I didn’t do that because the balance in the three realms must be maintained, and that balance would be destroyed if one of the races disappeared from there."
Tian Hanyun was shocked to hear that. "Is the winged race in your realm that evil? What about the demon races in your home realm?"

"Both races are the same, and they have the ambition to enslave humans." Zhang Fei took out the memory extractor again, showing Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin the situation in the Tian and Diyu Realms, especially when he killed many people from the demon and winged races. "You two might think that I was cruel by killing them, but I did that to protect the human race from being enslaved by them."
Although he didn’t know the winged race from the Tian Realm, Tian Hanyun felt sorry for Zhang Fei killing them. However, he was human, so he must have acted to protect his race.

On the other hand, Tian Yaoqin didn’t feel sorry for the winged race from the Tian Realm, but she didn’t expect Zhang Fei to be so cruel as to kill so many of them. Even so, she smiled with satisfaction after seeing him kill so many demons, especially since those demon races were her race’s eternal enemies.

Zhang Fei suddenly released his killing intent, which shocked Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin, especially since his killing intent was much stronger than old cultivators like them. "I don’t mean to threaten you two, but this is the principle of life that I have followed all this time. I don’t care if they are humans, beasts, demi-humans, demons, or winged races; I will crush them and kill them all if they dare attack those closest to me."

’Terrifying! This kid is much scarier than it looks from the outside!’ Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin screamed in their hearts after sensing Zhang Fei’s killing intent. They were so frightened that they broke out in a cold sweat, even though their cultivation was far higher than his.

"Whoever dares to harm those closest to me, I will destroy them down to their roots." Zhang Fei withdrew his killing intent, allowing Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin to breathe a sigh of relief. "For me, I prefer to live in peace and not seek enmity with any races, but I will protect those closest to me from anyone who tries to harm them."

Tian Hanyun nodded to him. "We winged races are like you, and we don’t like to find trouble with any race, except demons. We have had a grudge against them for millions of years, and it will never end. We will hunt down any of them, and we will kill any of them."

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "The winged races and demon races in all realms have always been hostile to each other, so I’m not surprised to hear your words. However, I would rather not get involved in the problems of the two races, and I choose to live a leisurely life while protecting those closest to me."
"Sigh." Tian Hanyun sighed to himself. "Are there any other areas in the sect?"
"Grand Elder Hanyun, the other areas are exclusively for dual cultivators." Qing Qiu’er spoke.
You Feiling pointed towards the mountain. "The area designated for dual cultivators spans from the foot of the mountain to the entire mountain area, including the back."

"Hmm?" Tian Hanyun looked at the mountain for a moment before speaking to them. "Since we have explored all areas of this sect, except for the area designated for dual cultivators, the two of us will return to our domain now, and we will report everything we see to our leader."
Zhang Fei, Qing Qiu’er, and You Feiling nodded to him. "Thank you for your visit to our sect."
"I’ll leave now." Tian Hanyun flew away.
Tian Yaoqin did not immediately follow Tian Hanyun; Instead, she walked up to Zhang Fei and briefly kissed his lips, but she quickly turned away to follow her friend.

"Hahaha." Qing Qiu’er laughed at that. "It seems like your plan to influence that winged race woman with your demon abilities has succeeded. She even kissed you without hesitation, but she still seems to be holding back from giving herself to you."

You Feling also said. "I’m curious to imagine her reaction if she finds out you’re a demon, but I’m even more curious about Tian Qiye’s reaction if she finds out that a grand elder of her race has fallen into your embrace."

"You don’t need to imagine those things, right?" Zhang Fei covered his body with qi again. "Tian Yaoqin will eventually come to me, and she will voluntarily surrender herself to me. As for Tian Qiye, she’s still too strong for me now, but I will make her fall into my arms, and I will enjoy her body then."

"Haha! I’ll be looking forward to that day." Qing Qiu’er held You Feiling’s hand. "Since you’re leaving, and all your clones are also in other domains, Feiling and I will return to the mountaintop now. The two of us will wait for your fifth clone to return, and we will resume our dual cultivation."
"Yeah." After the two women left, Zhang Fei hurriedly went to Jiangshen Main Domain to check on Tian Qiye and Tian Liefeng.

In the Nirvana Sky Main Domain, Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu, who were about to attack the Spirit Temple, were shocked by the sudden appearance of Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu. ’How did they both know that we were going to attack this domain?’

Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu grew wary as Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu each summoned other demons, which increased their power severalfold, surpassing their own. ’Shit! They have become much stronger than us, and only our leaders can face them.’
*Swoosh*
Sheng Yaohun led several clan leaders to surround Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu, which was in accordance with Jiu Mozu’s orders.
’Crap! We’re trapped.’

Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu thought about running away, but Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu immediately moved to attack them. However, the two grand elders of the winged race summoned powerful light shields, preventing them from approaching them.
’We have to leave this domain now, or we’ll die here.’ Tian Guangyu nodded in agreement with Tian Qiantian, and they immediately took out their returning jades.
However, Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu were shocked because their returning jades had suddenly disappeared. ’Shit! We’re forced to face them in order to escape.’

"You two might think that I was cruel by killing them, but I did that to protect the human race from being enslaved by them."
Although he didn’t know the winged race from the Tian Realm, Tian Hanyun felt sorry for Zhang Fei killing them.
However, he was human, so he must have acted to protect his race.
On the other hand, Tian Yaoqin didn’t feel sorry for the winged race from the Tian Realm, but she didn’t expect Zhang Fei to be so cruel as to kill so many of them.
Even so, she smiled with satisfaction after seeing him kill so many demons, especially since those demon races were her race’s eternal enemies.
Zhang Fei suddenly released his killing intent, which shocked Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin, especially since his killing intent was much stronger than old cultivators like them.
"I don’t mean to threaten you two, but this is the principle of life that I have followed all this time.
I don’t care if they are humans, beasts, demi-humans, demons, or winged races; I will crush them and kill them all if they dare attack those closest to me."
’Terrifying!
This kid is much scarier than it looks from the outside!’ Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin screamed in their hearts after sensing Zhang Fei’s killing intent.
They were so frightened that they broke out in a cold sweat, even though their cultivation was far higher than his.
"Whoever dares to harm those closest to me, I will destroy them down to their roots." Zhang Fei withdrew his killing intent, allowing Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin to breathe a sigh of relief.
"For me, I prefer to live in peace and not seek enmity with any races, but I will protect those closest to me from anyone who tries to harm them."
Tian Hanyun nodded to him.
"We winged races are like you, and we don’t like to find trouble with any race, except demons.
We have had a grudge against them for millions of years, and it will never end.
We will hunt down any of them, and we will kill any of them."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at that.
"The winged races and demon races in all realms have always been hostile to each other, so I’m not surprised to hear your words.
However, I would rather not get involved in the problems of the two races, and I choose to live a leisurely life while protecting those closest to me."
"Sigh." Tian Hanyun sighed to himself.
"Are there any other areas in the sect?"
"Grand Elder Hanyun, the other areas are exclusively for dual cultivators." Qing Qiu’er spoke.
You Feiling pointed towards the mountain.
"The area designated for dual cultivators spans from the foot of the mountain to the entire mountain area, including the back."
"Hmm?" Tian Hanyun looked at the mountain for a moment before speaking to them.
"Since we have explored all areas of this sect, except for the area designated for dual cultivators, the two of us will return to our domain now, and we will report everything we see to our leader."
Zhang Fei, Qing Qiu’er, and You Feiling nodded to him.
"Thank you for your visit to our sect."
"I’ll leave now." Tian Hanyun flew away.
Tian Yaoqin did not immediately follow Tian Hanyun; Instead, she walked up to Zhang Fei and briefly kissed his lips, but she quickly turned away to follow her friend.
"Hahaha." Qing Qiu’er laughed at that.
"It seems like your plan to influence that winged race woman with your demon abilities has succeeded.
She even kissed you without hesitation, but she still seems to be holding back from giving herself to you."
You Feling also said.

"I’m curious to imagine her reaction if she finds out you’re a demon, but I’m even more curious about Tian Qiye’s reaction if she finds out that a grand elder of her race has fallen into your embrace."
"You don’t need to imagine those things, right?" Zhang Fei covered his body with qi again.
"Tian Yaoqin will eventually come to me, and she will voluntarily surrender herself to me.
As for Tian Qiye, she’s still too strong for me now, but I will make her fall into my arms, and I will enjoy her body then."
"Haha!
I’ll be looking forward to that day." Qing Qiu’er held You Feiling’s hand.
"Since you’re leaving, and all your clones are also in other domains, Feiling and I will return to the mountaintop now.
The two of us will wait for your fifth clone to return, and we will resume our dual cultivation."
"Yeah." After the two women left, Zhang Fei hurriedly went to Jiangshen Main Domain to check on Tian Qiye and Tian Liefeng.

In the Nirvana Sky Main Domain, Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu, who were about to attack the Spirit Temple, were shocked by the sudden appearance of Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu. ’How did they both know that we were going to attack this domain?’
Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu grew wary as Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu each summoned other demons, which increased their power severalfold, surpassing their own. ’Shit!
They have become much stronger than us, and only our leaders can face them.’
*Swoosh*
Sheng Yaohun led several clan leaders to surround Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu, which was in accordance with Jiu Mozu’s orders.
’Crap!
We’re trapped.’
Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu thought about running away, but Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu immediately moved to attack them.
However, the two grand elders of the winged race summoned powerful light shields, preventing them from approaching them.
’We have to leave this domain now, or we’ll die here.’ Tian Guangyu nodded in agreement with Tian Qiantian, and they immediately took out their returning jades.
However, Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu were shocked because their returning jades had suddenly disappeared. ’Shit!
We’re forced to face them in order to escape.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1415: Obtained
paragraphs: Just as Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu were thinking about that, two qi swords shot towards them out of nowhere, destroying their light barriers. They were shocked to see their light barriers shattered into pieces, as were Sheng Yaohun and the cultivators from the Nirvana Sky Main Domain.

Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu were not surprised to see this, especially since they already knew that their master was there. They moved to attack Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu, who no longer had any defense.

Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu tried to send voice transmissions to the other grand elders of the winged race, but they felt something prevented them from calling for help. They decided to spread out to engage Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu, but the battle was uneven because the two Demon Gods were assisted by their subordinates, which made it difficult for the two grand elders to deal with them.
"Should we move to help them?" Gongsun Ye asked.

Sheng Yaohun first observed the progress of the two battles in both places. "I don’t think we need to move because our two masters can handle those two grand elders easily and they will defeat both of them without a long fight."

The people from the other clans agreed with Sheng Yaohun, especially since they could see that Jiu Moze, Jiu Mozu, and their subordinates had the upper hand in the battle against Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu. Additionally, some qi swords continued to emerge and destroy the defenses of the two grand elders, prompting them to search for their origins.
"Who exactly is helping our two masters?" Gongsun Ye asked again.

"I can’t confirm it because I can’t find the owner." Sheng Yaohun looked around the night sky, but he found no one there. "Whoever helped them is a skilled swordsman; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to destroy the protective barrier of the two grand elders so easily."
Up in the sky, Zhang Fei [5] stood there in invisible mode, with Ma Kuangyu beside him.

Ma Kuangyu clenched his fists tightly, looking at the people who had betrayed and killed him in the past. He wanted to kill them with his own hands, but his current strength wasn’t comparable to theirs, so he couldn’t do it yet.

Zhang Fei [5] turned to him. "You don’t need to rush, Old Ma. When your strength returns to its former peak, you can kill them with your hands. I can kill them, but I will never do that, and they must die in your hands for their betrayal of you."

"Yeah." Ma Kuangyu let out a soft sigh and looked at the battle in both places. "Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu are strong, but their strength is no match for Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu, especially after they used their techniques to borrow the strength of their subordinates. They should be able to defeat those two grand elders quickly, but they seem to be stalling for time to drain their strength."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "I ordered the two demon gods to drain the power of the two grand elders."
Ma Kuangyu turned to him. "Why did you order them to do that? Wouldn’t that be a waste of time?"

"Old Ma, the soul strength of the two grand elders of the winged race is higher than mine, and they seem to protect their souls." After Zhang Fei [5] made that statement, Ma Kuangyu immediately scrutinized Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu. "Their soul strength is at the perfection stage of the divine soul level, so I won’t be able to do anything to their souls. Therefore, I asked the two demon gods to weaken them first, and I will do something to them afterward."
"What are your plans for them?"

"Tian Qiye." Ma Kuangyu nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei [5]. "I wouldn’t have done anything to that woman if I didn’t know Nalan Yushu, but she’s now one of my women. She killed her in the past and imprisoned her soul in the Star Tower, so I’ll help her take revenge on her."

"Hahaha! Nalan Yushu is lucky to have a husband like you." Ma Kuangyu laughed at that. "Although your relationship was initially awful because she tried to devour your soul, things have gotten better for both of you, and you’ve also gained her big sister as your wife."

"Yeah." Zhang Fei [5] swung the Demon Extermination Sword towards Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu as soon as they activated other barriers, causing Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu’s attacks to hit their bodies heavily.

Zhang Fei [5] and Ma Kuangyu could see Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu spurting a lot of blood from their mouths, but Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu did not give them a chance to breathe and attacked the two of them continuously, assisted by their subordinates.

Time passed, and Zhang Fei [5] repeatedly helped Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu destroy Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu’s barriers, which made the two grand elders of the Winged Race.

Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu tried to escape several times, but the two demon gods and their subordinates prevented them from doing so, which made them weaker and weaker as they suffered increasingly severe injuries.

After fighting for a long time, Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu were finally unable to face them any longer. They lay on the ground, covered in blood, their consciousness thin due to their injuries and their drastically reduced stamina. From the start, they had no confidence in fighting the two demon gods, especially since their strength had increased considerably after borrowing the strength of their subordinates, which far surpassed their own.
Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze landed beside Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu, sealing their cultivation. However, these two clearly had no intention of killing them, which confused them.
Sheng Yaohun, Gongsun Ye, and the others immediately flew to the side of Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze. "Why don’t you kill them, Masters?"
Tian Qiantian sneered at them. "Kill us if you dare! Our leader has already broken through to the Celestial God Realm, and he will avenge our deaths by destroying your entire race."
Gongsun Ye thought about killing Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu, but Jiu Moze immediately attacked him, sending him flying backwards and spurting a lot of blood from his mouth.
Sheng Yaohun and the others were shocked by Jiu Moze’s actions. "Master, you—"

Sheng Yaohun swallowed his words back when he felt a powerful aura coming from above. He and the others immediately looked up to the sky to see Zhang Fei [5], who had already transformed into his lust demon form and put on the huangying mask to disguise his aura.
Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu were also shocked to see Zhang Fei [5] walking down from the sky, and staircases made of qi continued to appear every time he walked down.
Sheng Yaohun, Gongsun Ye, and the others wondered in their hearts about Zhang Fei [5]’s identity.
Jiu Moze, Jiu Mozu, and their subordinates lined up beside the bottom of the stairs. "Master."
As if struck with lightning, Sheng Yaohun, Gongsun Ye, and the others gasped in shock after their two masters addressed Zhang Fei [5] as their master.

Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu were no less shocked than them, especially because Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu were powerful. However, they recognized Zhang Fei [5] as their master, which was completely unreasonable according to their logic.
Zhang Fei [5] didn’t say anything as he pulled out Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu’s souls, which he duplicated before fusing them with his.
Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu stared at Zhang Fei [5] in horror after he returned their souls to their bodies, but he immediately crouched beside them, using his memory manipulation on them.

Zhang Fei [5] purposefully refrained from enslaving Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu out of fear that Tian Qiye would uncover his actions against them, and he chose the safest way to keep an eye on her.

Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu tried hard to resist Zhang Fei [5]’s actions against them, but their efforts ended in vain. Although he didn’t alter all their memories, he altered some of them, making them completely loyal to him.

Thereafter, Zhang Fei [5] put some pills into Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu’s mouths, which made their injuries slowly recover and their qi replenished. "Rest first! You two should return to the Radiance Domain once you’ve fully recovered, and I want you to report all of Tian Qiye’s activities to me."
Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu hurriedly got up and saluted Zhang Fei [5]. "Thank you, Master."

Zhang Fei [5] did not say anything more to Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu, and the two flew away from the Nirvana Sky Main Domain. He turned to Sheng Yaohun and the others, making them subconsciously take a few steps back. However, he did not do anything to them and disappeared from the domain, much to their relief.
"Master—" Sheng Yaohun wanted to ask Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu, but the two of them hurriedly led their subordinates away from the domain without explaining anything to him.
