chapters.title: Chapter 1416: Meet Tian Yizu
paragraphs: "How are your injuries? Are you seriously injured?"

"No." Gongsun Ye shook his head at Sheng Yaohun. "Our master’s attack was powerful, but he didn’t mean to hurt me, and I only suffered minor injuries. But who exactly is that male demon? Why do our two masters seem so respectful to him?"

Sheng Yaohun replied by shaking his head. "I can’t see the mask because it’s a special artifact to hide his identity, but he’s powerful since he was able to subdue both of our masters, and they are so respectful to him. For now, you should return to your clan residence, and we will wait for their next orders."
"Alright." Gongsun Ye immediately left the spirit temple.

Meanwhile, Sheng Yaohun went to the underground prison, where he met two prisoners who were suffering from serious injuries. He entered the prison room and injected the two prisoners with his demon aura, turning them into demons like him.
Sheng Yaohun gave recovery pills to them, and he ordered them to do something for him. "Who exactly is that male demon? How can he make my two masters submit to him?"

Zhang Fei [5] had already brought Ma Kuangyu back to the Moonlit Passion Temple. "Old Ma, you don’t need to keep thinking about them. You just need to focus on restoring your old strength. If necessary, you can become a dual cultivator like that, and you can choose any elder you like to assist you."

"Hahaha." Ma Kuangyu laughed when he heard that. "In the past, I was not a dual cultivator, and I will never become one in the future. I will regain my old strength with my efforts, and I will destroy those traitors in the future. The main problem is whether Tian Qiye will find out that those people are still alive or not, and she will probably send other grand elders if she finds out that they are still living."

"You don’t need to worry about those people because the two grand elders of that race are already under my control, and I will order the two demon gods to save them if Tian Qiye finds out they are still alive. I won’t let them die at the hands of that woman, and I want you to kill them yourself, so I will definitely help you keep them safe." Ma Kuangyu nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately opened a portal to the Yin-Yang Space. He disappeared inside for a moment before coming out again, bringing Ma Yaoling out of there. "I have already gained control over Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze, so they will no longer be able to control this woman. Since she was a member of your clan in the past, I will give her to you, and she will obey all your orders."
Ma Yaoling was shocked to hear that and asked him. "Are those two demon gods under your control now?"
"Why don’t you ask your lord?" Zhang Fei [5] pointed at Ma Kuangyu.

Ma Kuangyu nodded to Ma Yaoling when she turned to him. "Even though Zhang Fei [5] didn’t control Jiu Moze using his own power, he managed to control Jiu Mozu on his own. The Nine Nether Demon Race is already under his control, so you don’t need to be afraid that the two demon gods will control you anymore."

"Phew." Ma Yaoling breathed a sigh of relief and knelt before Ma Kuangyu. "Lord Ma, I am indeed no longer human, and I have transformed into a corpse demon. Please allow me to serve you as in the past, and I will help you reunite our Ma clan in the future."

Ma Kuangyu lifted her to her feet. "Although you’ve become a corpse demon now, I still remember your loyalty to our Ma clan in the past, and you became like this because of my weakness. Moreover, Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze can no longer control you, so you can serve me as in the past. Unfortunately, I can’t ask Zhang Fei [5] to release you from their control because you will die, so you will continue to live as a demon corpse for the rest of your life."
"That’s not a problem for me." Ma Youling clenched her fists. "I don’t care if I have to be a corpse demon for the rest of my life as long as I can help you reunite our Ma clan."
Ma Kuangyu nodded to her. "Let’s go; I will take you to meet our clan members in this sect."
"Yes."
Zhang Fei [5] watched Ma Kuangyu and Ma Youling leave with a smile, and he went back to the mountaintop to meet his four wives.
"How did it go?" Qing Qiu’er asked when he arrived there.

You Feling, Sima Huiqing, and Yan Jinwu were also curious about it. However, there was another woman with them, and Qing Qiu’er had deliberately brought Wang Yin there to join them, especially because she had started to become used to Zhang Fei [5]’s presence during the last week they spent together.

Qing Qiu’er wanted to bring Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua, but both female demons refused her request because they hadn’t decided on their relationship with Zhang Fei, and they chose to stay with the other demons.

Zhang Fei [5] told them about his actions against Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu. "If it weren’t for the help of Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu, I couldn’t do that to those two grand elders because their soul cultivation was one level above mine. This way I can monitor Tian Qiye’s movements, and that woman won’t realize that her two subordinates are already under my control."
"Haha." Qing Qiu’er laughed at that. "Tian Qiye would probably vomit blood if she found out that her two subordinates were already under your control."
"Is your cultivation stable now?" Yan Jinwu asked him.

"I’ve already taken three Flame Consolidation Pills to break through to the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm and stabilize my cultivation, so I didn’t use the True Foundation Pill for stabilization, mainly because I need many pills for this stage. Moreover, the qi I need to break through to the next major stage is large, and it won’t be possible to fulfill it any time soon, so I’ll stabilize my cultivation as I go." Zhang Fei [5] approached Wang Yin and hugged her. "I’m glad you decided to join us, Yin’er."
Wang Yin nodded with a smile. "I wish I could remember all our old memories soon, so I decided to accept Qing Qiu’er’s offer to join you all here."
"Don’t worry about that, okay?" Zhang Fei [5] rubbed her cheek. "If you still can’t remember our past memories, we will make new memories that are more beautiful than before."
"Yeah."

Zhang Fei [5] then sat cross-legged with his four wives around him, but Wang Yin didn’t join them because she didn’t have a soul, and she helped them increase their soul power through dual soul cultivation.

Wang Yin sat on the side watching them perform dual soul cultivation, and she smiled to herself as she looked at Zhang Fei [5]. However, her eyes went blank for a moment, like in the past, but they returned to normal after that.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Radiance Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
"Zhang Fei." Tian Huangjin was surprised by his sudden arrival. "Why did you come to this domain?"
"Take me to see your father, Huangjin."
"Alright." Tian Huanjin took Zhang Fei to Tian Yizu’s private place.
Tian Yizu was slightly surprised by his arrival. "Why did you come here?"

"I intended to find out information about Tian Qiye, so I waited for nightfall to infiltrate this domain. However, I couldn’t find her anywhere, so I came to you to ask you." Tian Yizu was not surprised that Zhang Fei wanted to do that, but he felt that he was too reckless. "By the way, Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu have already fallen into my control, and they are both loyal to me now."
"What?" Tian Yizu and Tian Huangjin shouted in shock. "How—"

"I asked Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu to weaken them until they were completely weak, and I used my abilities to manipulate their minds." Zhang Fei explained the situation to Tian Yizu. "Unfortunately, they don’t know where Tian Qiye went, so I came here to look for you."

Since his daughter had already told him about the two demon gods of the Nine Nether Demon, Tian Yizu was no longer surprised to hear that from Zhang Fei. "Unfortunately, I don’t know where she went because she didn’t inform us of her destination, and she took Tian Liefeng with her. However, I have a way to find out her destination, and I will use it now."
"Alright."

Tian Yizu closed his eyes, his body glowing golden for a while. "Tian Qiye brought Tian Liefeng to the Jiangshen Domain, and they suspect that one of the pieces of the Holy Radiance Equipment is there. By the way, she has the Holy Radiance Shield, and I only found out about it today."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned. "Is the Holy Radiance Shield really in Tian Qiye’s hands?"
"Yes." Tian Yizu opened his eyes. "I saw Tian Qiye showing the shield to Tian Liefeng before they went to Jiangshen Domain."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding, but he was not that crazy to snatch the shield from Tian Qiye. "I will go to Jiangshen Domain now."

sentences.text: "How are your injuries?
Are you seriously injured?"
"No." Gongsun Ye shook his head at Sheng Yaohun.
"Our master’s attack was powerful, but he didn’t mean to hurt me, and I only suffered minor injuries.
But who exactly is that male demon?
Why do our two masters seem so respectful to him?"
Sheng Yaohun replied by shaking his head.
"I can’t see the mask because it’s a special artifact to hide his identity, but he’s powerful since he was able to subdue both of our masters, and they are so respectful to him.
For now, you should return to your clan residence, and we will wait for their next orders."
"Alright." Gongsun Ye immediately left the spirit temple.
Meanwhile, Sheng Yaohun went to the underground prison, where he met two prisoners who were suffering from serious injuries.
He entered the prison room and injected the two prisoners with his demon aura, turning them into demons like him.
Sheng Yaohun gave recovery pills to them, and he ordered them to do something for him.
"Who exactly is that male demon?
How can he make my two masters submit to him?"
Zhang Fei [5] had already brought Ma Kuangyu back to the Moonlit Passion Temple.
"Old Ma, you don’t need to keep thinking about them.
You just need to focus on restoring your old strength.
If necessary, you can become a dual cultivator like that, and you can choose any elder you like to assist you."
"Hahaha." Ma Kuangyu laughed when he heard that.
"In the past, I was not a dual cultivator, and I will never become one in the future.
I will regain my old strength with my efforts, and I will destroy those traitors in the future.
The main problem is whether Tian Qiye will find out that those people are still alive or not, and she will probably send other grand elders if she finds out that they are still living."

"You don’t need to worry about those people because the two grand elders of that race are already under my control, and I will order the two demon gods to save them if Tian Qiye finds out they are still alive.

I won’t let them die at the hands of that woman, and I want you to kill them yourself, so I will definitely help you keep them safe." Ma Kuangyu nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei [5], who immediately opened a portal to the Yin-Yang Space.
He disappeared inside for a moment before coming out again, bringing Ma Yaoling out of there.
"I have already gained control over Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze, so they will no longer be able to control this woman.
Since she was a member of your clan in the past, I will give her to you, and she will obey all your orders."
Ma Yaoling was shocked to hear that and asked him.
"Are those two demon gods under your control now?"
"Why don’t you ask your lord?" Zhang Fei [5] pointed at Ma Kuangyu.
Ma Kuangyu nodded to Ma Yaoling when she turned to him.
"Even though Zhang Fei [5] didn’t control Jiu Moze using his own power, he managed to control Jiu Mozu on his own.
The Nine Nether Demon Race is already under his control, so you don’t need to be afraid that the two demon gods will control you anymore."
"Phew." Ma Yaoling breathed a sigh of relief and knelt before Ma Kuangyu.
"Lord Ma, I am indeed no longer human, and I have transformed into a corpse demon.
Please allow me to serve you as in the past, and I will help you reunite our Ma clan in the future."
Ma Kuangyu lifted her to her feet.
"Although you’ve become a corpse demon now, I still remember your loyalty to our Ma clan in the past, and you became like this because of my weakness.
Moreover, Jiu Mozu and Jiu Moze can no longer control you, so you can serve me as in the past.
Unfortunately, I can’t ask Zhang Fei [5] to release you from their control because you will die, so you will continue to live as a demon corpse for the rest of your life."
"That’s not a problem for me." Ma Youling clenched her fists.
"I don’t care if I have to be a corpse demon for the rest of my life as long as I can help you reunite our Ma clan."
Ma Kuangyu nodded to her.
"Let’s go; I will take you to meet our clan members in this sect."
"Yes."
Zhang Fei [5] watched Ma Kuangyu and Ma Youling leave with a smile, and he went back to the mountaintop to meet his four wives.
"How did it go?" Qing Qiu’er asked when he arrived there.
You Feling, Sima Huiqing, and Yan Jinwu were also curious about it.

However, there was another woman with them, and Qing Qiu’er had deliberately brought Wang Yin there to join them, especially because she had started to become used to Zhang Fei [5]’s presence during the last week they spent together.

Qing Qiu’er wanted to bring Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua, but both female demons refused her request because they hadn’t decided on their relationship with Zhang Fei, and they chose to stay with the other demons.
Zhang Fei [5] told them about his actions against Tian Qiantian and Tian Guangyu.
"If it weren’t for the help of Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu, I couldn’t do that to those two grand elders because their soul cultivation was one level above mine.
This way I can monitor Tian Qiye’s movements, and that woman won’t realize that her two subordinates are already under my control."
"Haha." Qing Qiu’er laughed at that.
"Tian Qiye would probably vomit blood if she found out that her two subordinates were already under your control."
"Is your cultivation stable now?" Yan Jinwu asked him.

"I’ve already taken three Flame Consolidation Pills to break through to the 3-Sun Celestial King Realm and stabilize my cultivation, so I didn’t use the True Foundation Pill for stabilization, mainly because I need many pills for this stage.

Moreover, the qi I need to break through to the next major stage is large, and it won’t be possible to fulfill it any time soon, so I’ll stabilize my cultivation as I go." Zhang Fei [5] approached Wang Yin and hugged her.
"I’m glad you decided to join us, Yin’er."
Wang Yin nodded with a smile.
"I wish I could remember all our old memories soon, so I decided to accept Qing Qiu’er’s offer to join you all here."
"Don’t worry about that, okay?" Zhang Fei [5] rubbed her cheek.
"If you still can’t remember our past memories, we will make new memories that are more beautiful than before."
"Yeah."

Zhang Fei [5] then sat cross-legged with his four wives around him, but Wang Yin didn’t join them because she didn’t have a soul, and she helped them increase their soul power through dual soul cultivation.
Wang Yin sat on the side watching them perform dual soul cultivation, and she smiled to herself as she looked at Zhang Fei [5].
However, her eyes went blank for a moment, like in the past, but they returned to normal after that.

chapters.title: Chapter 1417: Enter The Jiangshen Domain
paragraphs: "You—" Zhang Fei disappeared before Tian Huangjin could ask him anything.
"Cough... Cough... He’ll be fine, Huangjin." Tian Yizu wiped the blood from his mouth.
Tian Huangjin became worried about his condition. "Are you okay, Father?"

"Yes." Tian Yizu nodded in response. "This ability is really troublesome, and I experienced a backlash after using it. You don’t need to worry about me because my injuries aren’t serious, and my strength will return to its peak in a few days. Have Tian Hanyun and Tian Yaoqin returned to this domain?"

Tian Huangjin nodded to her father. "I saw them return a few hours ago, but I felt something was off with Tian Yaoqin, and I think Zhang Fei did something to her when they visited the Moonlit Passion Sect earlier."
"Hmm?" Tian Yizu raised an eyebrow. "Could it be that Zhang Fei used his demon abilities on her?"

"Do you need to ask that, Father?" Tian Huangjin responded with a shake. "Zhang Fei will not hesitate to use his demon abilities on all his enemies, and I’m sure that he’s already used them on Tian Yaoqin because she was by Tian Qiye’s side. She may be a grand elder of our Winged Race, but his demon abilities are fatal to all women, and I’m sure she will fall into his arms soon."

Tian Yizu nodded in understanding. "Zhang Fei isn’t an ordinary lust demon, and no one can detect his demon abilities when he’s in his human form, so I don’t need to worry that Tian Qiye will find out about that."
"I will return to my room now, Father."

Tian Yizu looked at his daughter as she walked away. "Huangjin, I hope you won’t waste your future because you’re obsessed with destroying evil demons, and I hope you find the right man to be your husband soon."

Tian Yaoqin felt uneasy about her situation, especially when she remembered her crazy act of kissing Zhang Fei. She did it in front of Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling, which made her even more embarrassed by her actions.
Tian Yaoqin had tried to calm her heart and mind since she returned to her domain, but images of Zhang Fei kept popping into her mind, especially her recklessness in kissing him.
Although Tian Yaoqin was not affected by Zhang Fei’s demon charm, she was already affected by some of his passive demon abilities, especially his passive lust aura, which awakened her hidden lust.

Tian Yaoqin was a grand elder of the Winged Race, but she was still a living being with lust, and Zhang Fei’s passive lust aura made her think of her lust. She felt tempted to taste the pleasure of lust, and she wanted to do it with him because of the influence of his passive lust aura.
Not to mention, Zhang Fei used his Subconscious Manipulation and Free Will Manipulation abilities on Tian Yaoqin, which had a deep impact on her.
Tian Yaoqin stopped cultivating because she couldn’t concentrate, and she was afraid that she would run into trouble if she forced herself. She opened her eyes and let out a heavy breath.

"What exactly has he done to me? Why does his face keep appearing in my mind? I can’t feel his movements from within his body, so I don’t know when he did what he did to me." Tian Yaoqin got out of bed and changed from her formal clothes to a nightgown. "If I think about it again, his abilities resemble those of a lust demon; however, I don’t sense any demon aura emanating from his body, and he appears to be just like an ordinary human. Moreover, demon abilities won’t work on me, so I’m not sure that he’s a demon."

Tian Yaoqin lay on the bed and closed her eyes, but her expression turned irritated because Zhang Fei’s face kept appearing in her mind. The more she resisted, the more often her face appeared in her mind, which was due to the effects of her Subconscious Manipulation and Free Will Manipulation abilities.
Tian Yaoqin opened her eyes again. "Should I go to see Zhang Fei again? My leader is away in another domain, and she won’t be back any time soon, so I can take advantage of her absence to see him."

In the end, Tian Yaoqin closed her eyes and tried hard to sleep, even though Zhang Fei’s face kept appearing in her mind. She had already decided to go see him tomorrow, or else her feelings would never calm down due to the influence of her abilities.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Jiangshen Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
[Generating new quests.]
[Quest: Defeat the Ghost Emperor.]
[Quest rank: Abyss]
[Reward: Abyss Gift Pack x 1]
[Quest: Meet the Spirit Willow Tree to Obtain Its Treasure.]
[Quest rank: Special]
[Reward: Special gift pack x 1]
"Fuck!" Zhang Fei cursed as soon as he read the first quest. "Since the quest is of abyss rank, I believe the Ghost Emperor is as powerful as Mo Shentian and Shang Zhanluo."

’You aren’t wrong about that; the Ghost Emperor is as powerful as Long Wuzhao, Long Xukong, Tianshi Bailong, and the four perils. He is slightly stronger than Mo Shentian and Shang Zhanluo, so you have to be very careful if you meet him.’
Zhang Fei almost vomited blood when Feng Yao said that, especially since all those beasts were immortal-rank beasts. "How could the Ghost Emperor be so strong?"
’Try to feel the ghost aura in that domain.’
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "The ghost aura in this domain is incredibly powerful, and it is much stronger than anything I have ever felt in other domains."

’Do you understand now? The Ghost Emperor was born from the souls of the cultivators who died in this domain, and they gathered together to form him. His strength is incredibly great, and you will die if you fight him with your current strength, so you should run away if you encounter him.’
"Yeah." Zhang Fei opened the system map, but it didn’t show anything.
[Master, this domain is different from the others, and I can’t help you track anything inside here, so you must be careful because you have to act alone.]

"Yeah." Zhang Fei’s two clones appeared beside him, and they hurriedly spread out in two different directions of the Jiangshen Domain. "Hmm? Where should I look for Tian Qiye? With the viewing distance being so short and the system map not being able to detect anything, I have to find the woman’s whereabouts with my own abilities."
[Master, you have many rewards that you can unlock in your inventory. Do you want to open them now?]
Zhang Fei suddenly remembered something and asked the female Ai. "Hey, Mei! The mysterious egg has been in my beast space for over two decades, but it still hasn’t hatched to this day."

[Master, we don’t have clear information about the beast inside the mysterious egg, okay? Moreover, some beasts take years to hatch from their eggs, so you should be patient for now, and the egg will eventually hatch on its own.]
Zhang Fei released a soft sigh. "Open those gift boxes, Mei."
[Yes, Master.]
[You obtained 1 Fragment of the Temple of the Forgotten Flames.]
[You obtained 1 Incomplete Reincarnation Art.]
[You obtained 1 Heaven-Sealing Stele.]
[You obtained 1 Celestial Ink Essence.]
[You obtained 1 Life Preservation Talisman.]
[You obtained 1 Dragon-Phoenix Essence.]
[You obtained 1 Battle Boost Bead.]

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow. "Another map fragment, huh? This way, I have four of the six map fragments, and I only need to find the remaining two so I can solve the mystery within that place. Show me the description of other items, Mei."
[Incomplete Reincarnation Art: Needs another half to figure out its function.]
[Heaven-Sealing Stele: The owner can use it to suppress cultivation, bloodline powers, divine senses, and heavenly laws within a wide radius.]
[Celestial Ink: Used to create high-level formation arrays.]
[Life Preservation Talisman: The user can use it to save lives in critical situations. Limit: one-time use.]
[Dragon-Phoenix Essence: Used to complete the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror.]
[Battle Boost Bead: Contains the power of the Asura Demon. Limit: one-time use.]

"I’m curious about the Incomplete Reincarnation Art, but I can’t figure out its function without the other half, so I’ll ignore it for now. The Heaven-Sealing Stele has a great function, but I’m not sure its effects will work on Tian Qiye." Zhang Fei ignored the Celestial Ink, and he planned to give it to Duanmu Luolan. "The Life Preservation Talisman has an excellent function, but I can only use it once, so I’ll use it when I’m truly in danger."

Zhang Fei was shocked when he read the Dragon-Phoenix Essence, and he didn’t expect that the Dragon-Phoenix Soul Mirror wasn’t perfect yet. He planned to use his fifth clone to retrieve it later, after he completed his soul cultivation with the four women, as he preferred not to take the mirror out in public.

"Power of the Asura Demon, huh?" Zhang Fei nodded in satisfaction after reading the effects of the Battle Boost Bead. Although he could only use it once, it was very beneficial to him, and he could use it to fight either Mo Shentian or Shang Zhanluo.
Zhang Fei immediately took out the Lantern of Hidden Paths and activated it, allowing him to see the hidden paths within the domain. "Now it’s time to look for Tian Qiye."

chapters.title: Chapter 1418: The Spirit Willow Tree’s Soul
paragraphs: ’You’ve finally arrived in this domain, the heir of the ten-tailed fox.’
Zhang Fei stopped upon hearing that. ’Who are you?’

’I don’t have a name, and some people in the past knew me as the Spirit Willow Tree.’ Zhang Fei was shocked to hear that. ’I’ve been dead for a long time, and I’ve been waiting for my seed to return to this domain. I can sense that my seed is in your hands, and I can reshape my body with it.’
Zhang Fei took a deep breath. ’So, it’s true that the Spirit Willow Tree became extinct a long time ago, huh?’

’Hahahaha! I don’t know who told you that the Spirit Willow Tree is extinct, but I will never become extinct as long as my seed remains in this universe. I was the lifeblood of this domain, but I died a long time ago due to a great calamity that occurred in the past, and it turned into a ghost domain because there was no one to guide these souls to the afterlife. I used my soul to prevent these ghosts from invading other domains, but my strength continues to decline with each passing moment, and this domain is now controlled by them. If I don’t reshape my body soon, these ghosts will break free from their confinement and attack other domains.’
’I see.’ Zhang Fei then asked. ’Where is your soul now? Where should I take your last seed?’

’You cannot go to this area because your strength is not yet sufficient to defeat the Ghost Emperor,’ Zhang Fei pondered, as he had no clear information about his enemy this time. ’The Ghost Emperor is truly powerful, and you will die in vain if you face him with your current strength. Instead, you should go south, and you will find a dead lake there. You can bring my seed at the dead lake, and my soul will meet you there to fuse with it. Zhang Fei did not answer the Spirit Willow Tree, and he asked the female Ai. ’Mei, how does the quality of qi in this domain compare to my beast space and training space?’

[Master, the quality of qi in your two spaces is already on par with this domain, but you cannot move the Spirit Willow Tree there. ’That’s true.’ Zhang Fei then asked the Spirit Willow Tree again. ’Where is south? The ghost miasma here blocks my senses, so I’m blind to direction now.’
’I will guide you to the dead lake, and you just need to follow it.’

Zhang Fei saw a white light in the distance, and it was close to the location of his second clone. He didn’t go there, and Feltia [2] hurriedly followed the light. ’Hey, old tree! Did you see two people of the winged race in this domain?’

’They were fighting with those ghosts in another area, and their actions angered the Ghost Emperor.’ Zhang Fei wanted to go to Tian Qiye and Tian Liefeng’s location, but the Spirit Willow Tree hurriedly stopped him. ’You must not go there because the Ghost Emperor will make his move soon, and he will make those two people of the winged race suffer. Zhang Fei didn’t dare underestimate the warning from the Spirit Willow Tree because it had lived in the domain for a long time, and it had imprisoned the Ghost Emperor there. He suddenly remembered something and asked again. ’What exactly is their purpose in coming to this domain and looking for trouble with the Ghost Emperor?’

’They came for the cape.’ Zhang Fei realized something about the cape. ’The cape belonged to the first ancestor of the winged race, so they were thinking of taking it. Unfortunately, they will never be able to do that, especially since the Ghost Emperor will never be defeated as long as he remains in this domain.’
Zhang Fei fell into deep thought after hearing that. ’What if the first ancestor of the winged race comes here to take it? Will the Ghost Emperor be able to stop her?’
’Does that mean you know the reincarnation of the first ancestor of the winged race?’
’Yes.’ Zhang Fei nodded slightly. ’The reincarnation of their first ancestor is one of my women.’

’Hahaha!’ The Spirit Willow Tree laughed loudly. ’Fate’s arrangement was truly terrifying! You are the successor of the ten-tailed fox, and the reincarnation of the first ancestor of the winged race is your woman! You can bring her here, but you should wait for the two people of the winged races to leave this domain; otherwise, they will be aware of her presence, and they will give you no end of trouble.’
Zhang Fei thought for a long time before speaking. ’Please guide me to their place, Old Tree. I will not show myself to them, and I will observe them from afar.’
’Are you sure about that? The Ghost Emperor is already on the move, and he will arrive at their location soon.’
’I’m sure.’ Zhang Fei nodded with determination. ’I don’t have any information about that woman, so I want to get information about her to use against her in the future.’

The Spirit Willow Tree was silent for a long time before Zhang Fei saw a white light appear in front of him. ’You can follow that light to get to their place, and I will protect you from the Ghost Emperor so he won’t be able to attack you.’
’Thank you, Old Tree.’ Zhang Fei made a move, following right behind the white light.
"Shit." Tian Liefeng cursed as he fought off the ghosts that were attacking them, and their strength grew stronger for a grand elder like him the more they walked inside.

Even so, the ghosts didn’t pose much of a problem for Tian Qiye, especially with her cultivation having already reached the Celestial God Realm. The woman immediately destroyed the ghosts that were charging at her, but they were stubborn and continued to attack her. No matter how many ghosts she killed, they continued to come from all corners of the domain, and they tried hard to attack her. "These ghosts are really stubborn, and their numbers are endless."

"Leader, I think we should withdraw now." Tian Liefeng spoke to her. "If we force ourselves to go deeper, we will run out of qi to fight these ghosts, and we will never reach that place. Moreover, our actions will lure that Ghost Emperor to come to us, and we will face big trouble if we have to fight him in this domain."

Tian Qiye didn’t listen to Tian Lifeng because she wanted to get the Holy Radiance Cape, and that way she could prevent Tian Huangjin’s return. She didn’t want anyone standing above her, including their first ancestor. If their first ancestor returned, she would take over their race, which would make her lose control over their members.

Tian Liefeng could only sigh in his heart and continue fighting the ghosts in the domain, especially since Tian Qiye was so stubborn. ’If only I could reach her level, I wouldn’t have to obey her orders, and I wouldn’t have to bother fighting these damn ghosts.’
*Roar*
Tian Liefeng was shocked to hear the powerful roar, and he warned Tian Qiye. "Leader, that’s the roar of the Ghost Emperor, and he seems to have noticed our presence in this domain."

"The Ghost Emperor, huh?" Tian Qiye hurriedly used her peak form and summoned her golden sword, preparing to face the enemy that was coming at them. She scanned her surroundings with her golden eyes, searching for her enemy’s location. However, the ghost miasma was blocking her sight and senses, preventing her from detecting too far away.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei arrived at their location with the help of the Spirit Willow Tree, as their position was close to the domain entrance where the ghost miasma was particularly thick.

Zhang Fei activated his invisible mode and used the ghost miasma to conceal himself from Tian Qiye’s detection, mainly because that woman was still too strong for him at the moment, and he wanted to avoid any confrontation with her.

Zhang Fei wasn’t concerned about Tian Liefeng because he could use the Soul Link to borrow the strength of the demon beasts in their fight, but he didn’t want to underestimate him because he was a grand elder of the Winged Race. ’Scan her, Mei.’
[Wait, Master.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1419: The Ghost Emperor
paragraphs: [Master, the winged race has seven supreme ranks, similar to the demon race: Low Heaven, Mid Heaven, High Heaven, Divine Threshold, Half-Divine, True Divine, and Origin Heaven. However, none of them can reach Origin Heaven, just like the demons cannot reach the Primordial Demon Rank.]

Zhang Fei thought of the winged races by his side, such as Jiang Yinghua, Meng Tianshi, Daniella, and Chiel. They hadn’t reached the peak of the Winged Race rank, but he didn’t have a solution to help them achieve it because he wasn’t a winged race like them.
[Why don’t you ask Tian Yizu about that? He is a grand elder of the winged race, and he should have a way to help them increase their rank.]

’Yes.’ Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. ’I’ve asked Tian Huangjin about that matter, but he doesn’t have a solution to help them. Even so, her father might have a solution to help them, and I’ll ask him later.’
*Roar*
’So fast!’ Zhang Fei was shocked as the Ghost Emperor flew at high speed toward Tian Liefeng and Tian Qiye.
Tian Liefeng and Tian Qiye went on alert after they sensed the Ghost Emperor’s aura. "Leader, we have to escape now, or we’ll be in serious trouble."
Tian Qiye didn’t listen to Tian Liefeng, and she held her golden sword firmly, looking forward to the arrival of the Ghost Emperor.
Tian Liefeng gritted his teeth, and he jumped away from Tian Qiye. He nearly died at the hands of the Ghost Emperor in the past, so he wasn’t stupid enough to fight him again.

Even so, Tian Liefeng still took out his weapon, which was a large golden bow. He summoned several large golden arrows, preparing to face Ghost Emperor. ’Shit! I don’t want to die in this damned place, but she will punish me if I run away now.’

Tian Qiye raised an eyebrow after sensing the Ghost Emperor’s aura, and her body trembled slightly due to the power of his aura. She tried to calm herself as quickly as possible, but his aura intimidated her, and her body couldn’t stop trembling. ’What exactly happened? I’ve reached the pinnacle of cultivation, but I feel fear towards that evil creature.’
*Boom*
Tian Qiye crossed her left arm in front of her face because of the explosion that occurred just now, which was caused by the arrival of the Ghost Emperor, pushing her back from her original spot.

Tian Liefeng breathed heavily, and his body trembled in fear, feeling intimidated by the Ghost Emperor’s powerful aura. ’Shit! Too late! He’s arrived, and his aura has become much stronger than when I met him in the past!’
’His aura is truly terrifying.’ Tian Qiye muttered as she looked at the scattering dust, which further limited her vision.
Soon, the scattering dust dissipated, revealing the figure of the Ghost Emperor shouldering a huge bone cleaver that was much bigger than his body.
Tian Liefeng, Tian Qiye, and Zhang Fei gasped in shock because the Ghost Emperor’s body size was truly enormous, and he was several times larger than the Giant Race.

The Ghost Emperor stared at Tian Liefeng and Tian Qiye with his eyes that took the form of white flames, which intimidated the two of them. "What are two birds like you doing at my place? You two killed my men from the start, so I can’t stand idly and let you kill them."
’He can talk now!’ Tian Liefeng screamed in shock in his heart because the Ghost Emperor didn’t say anything at their last meeting.
Tian Qiye took a deep breath, and a golden light quickly shot out from her body, forming the silhouette of a winged race with twelve golden wings whose body was as large as the Ghost Emperor.

The Ghost Emperor narrowed his eyes for a moment after seeing that, but then he laughed scornfully. "Hahaha! So, you are the leader of the winged race, huh? I admit you are strong, but you forgot that you are in my domain. I am the ruler of this domain, and all the ghosts here are the source of my strength. If you challenge me to a fight inside this domain, you must be prepared to die and become one of these ghosts."

"I don’t want to have any trouble with you, but I have to pick up an item near the Spirit Willow Tree." The Ghost Emperor tried to intimidate Tian Qiye even more, which made her body tremble even more. Even though she was afraid of him, she didn’t show it on her face. "That item belongs to my ancestors, so I must retrieve it and bring it back to my domain."

"I can’t give you that item because you’re not the owner." The Ghost Emperor shook his head in refusal, making Tian Qiye’s expression serious. "I promised someone to hand over the equipment to its rightful owner, so I will never hand it over to you."
Tian Qiye was furious to hear that, and she raised her sword in front of her face before activating her technique.
"Heavenly Radiance." The winged race’s figure glowed golden after Tian Qiye said that, but she didn’t stop there and activated another technique. "Eternal Judgment."
"Hahaha." The Ghost Emperor laughed upon hearing that, and he swung his huge bone cleaver towards the golden lights that were coming out from the Winged Race’s figure. "Wailing Ghost Cut!"

In an instant, the golden lights collided with the pale gray lights coming from the Ghost Emperor’s bone cleaver. Tian Qiye’s attack seemed to have the upper hand, but the situation quickly turned around, and his attack shattered hers.
The Ghost Emperor’s attack quickly flew towards the winged race’s figure and shattered it, bouncing Tian Qiye backwards before falling to the ground.
The winged race’s figure summoned by Tian Qiye instantly disappeared after being hit by the Ghost Emperor’s attack, making her spit out a mouthful of golden blood from her mouth.
Tian Qiye couldn’t believe the Ghost Emperor could effortlessly destroy her attack. "Impossible."

"Hahaha! The Ghost Emperor laughed at her expression. "If we fight in another domain, I might lose to you. However, you will never be able to defeat me as long as we fight inside my domain. Although our strengths are equal, I have several advantages in this domain, and the presence of these ghosts significantly enhances my strength compared to yours, so you can stop dreaming of defeating me. If you still wish to fight me, I assure you that you will join these ghosts and become my strength."
Tian Liefeng hurriedly moved beside Tian Qiye and helped her up. "Leader, we have to go now."
"I’ll kill you someday." Tian Liefeng and Tian Qiye instantly broke their returning jade, and both disappeared from Jiangshen Domain.
"Heh." The Ghost Emperor snorted after they left, but a man appeared in front of him.

Zhang Fei, who was hiding in the distance, was shocked by the man’s appearance. His body trembled violently after he recognized his identity, which was the ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul. ’What is he doing in this domain?’

The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul glanced briefly at Zhang Fei’s hiding place, making his heart tighten. His body trembled even more intensely when he remembered the incident at that time, when he almost died in his hands.

The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul ignored Zhang Fei and spoke to the Ghost Emperor. "The owner of the Holy Radiance Cape will soon appear in this domain, so you don’t need to return there to protect it."
"Hmm?" The Ghost Emperor looked at the ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul in surprise. "Does that mean my job is done?"

"Not yet." The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul shook his head. "The winged race won’t give up so easily, and Tian Qiye will come back to challenge you. For now, you don’t need to do anything, and you just need to wait until they come here again."
The Ghost Emperor nodded slightly. "Can I kill those people if they come here again?"
"Yes." The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul nodded to him. "If they come here again to bother you, you can kill them to your heart’s content, and you can turn them into ghosts inhabiting this domain."

"Hahaha." The Ghost Emperor laughed happily when he heard that. "Very well! I won’t do anything to the owner of that equipment! I’ll wait for those birdmen to come here again in the future, and I’ll kill all of them who dare to enter my domain."
Thereafter, the Ghost Emperor flew away and headed to another area, unaware of Zhang Fei’s presence.
The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul descended and stood before Zhang Fei. "Come out."
’Tch!’ Zhang Fei canceled his invisibility and stared at the ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul with utter fear.

The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul observed his body. "I see! You’ve obtained my Gluttony and Sloth Souls, and you’re in the process of obtaining my Bloodthirsty Soul. Unfortunately, you’re still too weak to obtain mine, and you need to train harder before our final battle."
"What do you mean by our final battle?" Zhang Fei asked while clenching both fists.

"I won’t tell you." The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul. "I know you’ve already obtained the key to enter the illusory Spirit Fox Domain, but you must not go there. You must find my Greed and Envy Souls and merge with them first, and you can go to that domain after. Otherwise, you will die in my hands, and this universe will lose its only hope."

His body trembled violently after he recognized his identity, which was the ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul. ’What is he doing in this domain?’
The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul glanced briefly at Zhang Fei’s hiding place, making his heart tighten.
His body trembled even more intensely when he remembered the incident at that time, when he almost died in his hands.
The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul ignored Zhang Fei and spoke to the Ghost Emperor.
"The owner of the Holy Radiance Cape will soon appear in this domain, so you don’t need to return there to protect it."
"Hmm?" The Ghost Emperor looked at the ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul in surprise.
"Does that mean my job is done?"
"Not yet." The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul shook his head.
"The winged race won’t give up so easily, and Tian Qiye will come back to challenge you.
For now, you don’t need to do anything, and you just need to wait until they come here again."
The Ghost Emperor nodded slightly.
"Can I kill those people if they come here again?"
"Yes." The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul nodded to him.
"If they come here again to bother you, you can kill them to your heart’s content, and you can turn them into ghosts inhabiting this domain."
"Hahaha." The Ghost Emperor laughed happily when he heard that.
"Very well!
I won’t do anything to the owner of that equipment!
I’ll wait for those birdmen to come here again in the future, and I’ll kill all of them who dare to enter my domain."
Thereafter, the Ghost Emperor flew away and headed to another area, unaware of Zhang Fei’s presence.
The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul descended and stood before Zhang Fei.
"Come out."
’Tch!’ Zhang Fei canceled his invisibility and stared at the ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul with utter fear.
The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul observed his body.
"I see!
You’ve obtained my Gluttony and Sloth Souls, and you’re in the process of obtaining my Bloodthirsty Soul.
Unfortunately, you’re still too weak to obtain mine, and you need to train harder before our final battle."
"What do you mean by our final battle?" Zhang Fei asked while clenching both fists.
"I won’t tell you." The ten-tailed fox’s Wrath Soul.
"I know you’ve already obtained the key to enter the illusory Spirit Fox Domain, but you must not go there.
You must find my Greed and Envy Souls and merge with them first, and you can go to that domain after.
Otherwise, you will die in my hands, and this universe will lose its only hope."

chapters.title: Chapter 1420: The Holy Radiance Cape
paragraphs: Zhang Fei clenched his fists tightly, stared at Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul, and asked. "Are your Greed and Envy Souls really in the Ancient Realm?"
"Yes." Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul waved his hand, creating a qi screen that displayed the domain. "The Ancient Desolation Domain was once part of the Ancient Realm."
Zhang Fei seriously stared at the qi screen. "That domain has been destroyed like the Endless Night Domain."

The Ancient Desolation Domain was once very prosperous, teeming with numerous living beings from various races. It was a vast ruin belonging to an ancient clan, but a catastrophe that occurred countless years ago destroyed the entire area, leaving behind ruins of its former glory.

The land of the Ancient Desolation Domain was dry and damaged, and the sky was dim and lacking in light, which made it uninhabitable. Even so, many cultivation resources still exist there, waiting to be explored.
In the Paradise Realm, there were no records of the Ancient Desolation Domain, and all the cultivators only knew that it was much older than all other domains.

Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul shot out a thing, which immediately entered Zhang Fei’s forehead, filling his mind with information about the Ancient Desolation Domain. "You can go to the Ancient Realm through that domain, but I don’t recommend you go there now. Currently, only beasts and demons live in that domain, and they are far stronger than all living beings in the Paradise Realm, including Long Wuzhao and the four perils. Their numbers may not be large, but each of them is capable of killing you like a cockroach."

"Huh?" Zhang Fei looked at Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul in shock because Long Wuzhao was the strongest cultivator in the Paradise Realm, but he said that all the beasts and demons living in the Ancient Desolation Domain were stronger than him. "Are those beasts really that powerful?"

"Do you doubt my words?" Zhang Fei smiled bitterly when he heard that, but Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul waved his hand, changing the image that appeared on the qi screen and showing the beasts in the Ancient Desolation Domain. "All of them are immortal-ranked beasts and demon beasts, and their strength surpasses all the beasts in this Paradise Realm. The Golden Dragon Emperor and the four perils are indeed capable of facing them with their current strength, but they will never be able to defeat them, and they will suffer injuries if they fight them."
Zhang Fei released a heavy sigh. "When can I go to that domain?"

"When your cultivation breaks through to the Celestial Venerable Realm." Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul dispelled the Qi screen. "As long as your cultivation hasn’t reached that stage, you shouldn’t try to go to that domain, or you’ll die a silly death there. I think that’s enough for now, and you should bring Tian Huangjin’s reincarnation to take her cape."
Hu Tianlang’s Wrath Soul instantly disappeared from Zhang Fei’s sight, leaving him wondering about the Ancient Desolation Domain.

"You must listen to his advice, and I forbid you from entering that domain until your cultivation reaches the Celestial Venerable Realm." A crimson flame quickly emerged from Zhang Fei’s body, transforming into Feng Yao. "That domain is different from the Endless Night Dungeon and the Zenith Solar Sanctum, primarily because it connects you to the Ancient Realm. Besides, the ancients often send the young cultivators from their clans there to train, and you are no match for them. You can defeat the cultivators in this domain with various tricks at your disposal, but you will never be able to defeat them, and you will die if you force yourself to go there before your cultivation reaches that stage."
Zhang Fei didn’t say anything and nodded to Feng Yao, who enveloped him with her aura and took him away towards the location of the Holy Radiance Cape.
The Holy Radiance Cape was an ultimate sacred artifact of the Winged Race, and it was made of soft golden fabric. It released a sacred glow that purifies demonic or corrupted qi.
"Bring Xu Ling’er here because she is the only one who can take the Holy Radiance Cape." Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao and opened a portal to his training space.

Sometime later, Xu Ling’er walked out from inside and spoke directly to Zhang Fei. "Big brother, I sensed vibrations from one of my Holy Radiance equipment yesterday, but it wasn’t this one, and it was something else."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei and Feng Yao looked at Xu Ling’er in surprise before looking at each other. "Do you have the same thoughts as me?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at him. "If my guess is correct, the equipment that Ling’er felt should be in Tian Qiye’s hands. The two grand elders of that race are on your side now, and you can use them to investigate that woman. However, I don’t know whether she will show it to them or not, but you can ask them to investigate her first."
"Yeah." Zhang Fei turned to Xu Ling’er. "You should move quickly and get the equipment right now, and I’ll send you back to our residence once you get it."

Xu Ling’er nodded and transformed into her old form, covered in the Holy Radiance Armor and the Holy Radiance Armor Crown, making her look like an imperfect war goddess. She shot her qi into the barrier covering the Holy Radiance Cape, making it glow several times before opening itself.
The Holy Radiance Cape shot out and flew towards Xu Ling’er, blending perfectly with the Holy Radiance Armor, causing all three pieces of equipment to glow bright gold.

Some new memories resurfaced in Xu Ling’er’s mind, causing her expression to change slightly. She quickly returned to her original form and kissed Zhang Fei directly. "Thank you, Big Brother. This way, I just need to find my shield and boots, and my equipment will be intact again."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed softly. "I’ll order those two grand elders to investigate Tian Qiye, and I’ll think of a way to snatch your equipment from her if they manage to find it."
Xu Ling’er smiled sweetly and nodded to Zhang Fei, and she entered the training space before returning to the Moonlit Passion Sect.
Zhang Fei closed the portal. "My second clone is almost at that dead lake."
"Yeah." Feng Yao looked in that direction. "The Spirit Willow Tree will revive because of you, and its return will bring significant changes to this Paradise Realm."
"What do you mean by that?"
"Secret." Feng Yao quickly transformed into a crimson flame and re-entered Zhang Fei’s body.

"If only my strength was higher than hers, I would spank her ass hard." Zhang Fei heard Feng Yao laugh in his mind, making him sigh helplessly. After that, he and one of his clones left the Jiangshen Domain, and he went to another domain to check something.
"Cough... Cough..." Tian Qiye coughed heavily.

Tian Liefeng sighed in relief that the Ghost Emperor hadn’t attacked him like in the past, and he hurriedly left Tian Qiye’s room and returned to his own to calm down, especially since the previous incident had worried him.

Tian Qiye sat cross-legged on her bed, took out a healing pill, and swallowed it straight away. She still couldn’t believe that the Ghost Emperor could break her technique so easily, which had left her injured. Although the injury wasn’t serious, she was disappointed with the final result, and she felt humiliated by it.

"How is it possible that he was able to destroy my technique so easily? Is it possible that he was able to do it because of his increased strength thanks to the ghosts in that domain?" Tian Qiye clenched her fist tightly. "I’ve worked hard for so long to reach this stage, but that damn ghost was able to defeat me so easily. Even if I were to fight him with all my strength, I’m not confident I could defeat him, especially since he has the help of the ghosts in that domain. To defeat him, I have to think of something to get rid of the ghosts."
*Knock... Knock...*
Tian Qiye raised an eyebrow as she checked out the room with her senses. "Come in."
Soon, Tian Hanyun walked into the room, and he reported to Tian Qiye everything he saw in the Moonlit Passion Sect.

Tian Qiye was truly surprised to hear that, but she was even more surprised to hear the presence of the four members of the winged race from the Three Mortal Realms in the Moonlit Passion Sect. "Did you feel anything special from those four women?"

"I don’t feel anything special from those four women, and their cultivation is too low to be a threat to us, Leader." Tian Qiye pondered for a moment, but Tian Hanyun immediately continued. "Although I can’t be certain, I feel there’s something different about Zhang Fei. Tian Yaoqin and I have been hiding our identities, but Qing Qiu’er was able to tell that we were the grand elders of our race, and I suspect he told her about our identities. Additionally, that sect has the void barrier, but we didn’t manage to find out the identity of the person who helped them create it."
Tian Qiye nodded slightly. "Do you think that sect will pose a threat to us?"
"I don’t know." Tian Hanyun answered with a shake of his head. "We should not do anything to that sect, especially because of the presence of people from those clans in there."

chapters.title: Chapter 1421: Shang Yuelan Join In
paragraphs: After Tian Hanyun left, Tian Qiye pondered the changes in the Twin Flames Main Domain, especially since it was impossible for them to drastically change the domain in less than seven months. Even if the natural races assisted Zhang Fei, she didn’t believe they could accomplish all that in such a short time.
Tian Qiye wondered about Zhang Fei’s ability to gather the natural races in one place, especially since they never liked contact with humans.

The natural race usually lived in remote places far from the hustle and bustle of the cultivation world, but they were willing to follow Zhang Fei and gather in a sect full of humans, which puzzled Tian Qiye about their situation.
Even though they came from the Three Mortal Realms, Tian Qiye believed that those natural races were the same as those living in the Paradise Realm, and they should have the same character.
Unfortunately, Tian Qiye didn’t know about Zhang Fei’s other identities, especially his identity as the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox, which made the natural races respect him very much.
Tian Qiye was increasingly curious about how Zhang Fei was able to convince Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, Zhuxian Sheng, and people from several clans to join the Moonlit Passion Sect.

The Liao, Qiao, You, Zhang, Jun, Gu, and Lian Clans were famous and influential clans in their respective domains, and most of them had never liked dual cultivators, so Tian Qiye was confused about how Zhang Fei would convince them to join the sect.

Tian Qiye also felt confused by the presence of so many mythical beast races in the Moonlit Passion Sect, which had never been heard of before. They usually live in the Divine Origin Main Domain, especially in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain under the leadership of Long Wuzhao.

Tian Qiye let out a soft breath, ignored all distractions, and closed her eyes to focus on recovering from the injury she had received from the Ghost Emperor earlier. "I will focus on recovering from my injuries first, and I will visit the Moonlit Passion Sect to see everything with my own eyes later."
After some time, Feltia [2] arrived at the dead lake, and he took out the Spirit Willow Tree Seed.

When Feltia [2] arrived, the soul of the Spirit Willow Tree was already waiting for him there. "Are you sure I should plant your seed here? Is there a different, more suitable location for planting your seed?"

’Hahaha! This domain has long been destroyed, but I can tell you that this dead lake is the most suitable place to plant my seed. Unfortunately, I won’t be able to return soon because my tree grows very slowly, but this domain will undergo significant changes once I grow and come back to life. Not only will this domain benefit from my return, but this Paradise Realm will also gain huge benefits from my return.’
Feltia [2] raised an eyebrow and looked at the soul of the Spirit Willow Tree. "What do you mean by that? What huge benefit will this Paradise Realm gain from your return?"

’You don’t need to be curious about that, the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox. You will know the answers to all your questions in the future, and you just need to wait until the time comes.’ Feltia [2] frowned, but the soul of the Spirit Willow Tree was unwilling to say anything. ’Please plant my seed into the middle of this dead lake, and I will begin the process of my rebirth.’
Feltia [2] could only hear because the soul of the Spirit Willow Tree was as secretive as Feng Yao, but he didn’t ask anything else and planted the seed in the middle of the dead lake. "Done."

’Thank you so much, the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox. I will enter my seed and start my rebirth process, so we have to separate now. However, we will meet again in the future, and I will help you fulfill your destiny.’

Feltia [2] wanted to ask something, but the soul of the Spirit Willow Tree quickly disappeared from his sight and entered the seed, which caused it to emit a bright white light. Within seconds, the entire area of the dead lake was enveloped in a white barrier, preventing anyone from entering and disturbing the seed.
"Haish! Everyone is playing secrets with me." Since Feltia [2] had nothing else to do in the Jiangshen Domain, he opened a gate and went elsewhere to hunt beasts to complete the daily quest.

Zhong Yan, who was watching the shop assistants serving the customers, raised her eyebrows when a woman entered the shop. "What are you doing here? Did your leader order you to cause trouble in my shop?"
"No." Shuang Yuelan replied with a shake of her head. "I came here to look for your husband."
"Why are you looking for my husband?" Zhong Yan asked in confusion because Zhang Fei had not told her about his plans for the woman.

Shuang Yuelan explained the reason for her visit to Zhong Yan, which surprised her. "I’ve been practicing swordsmanship for a long time, but your husband defeated me so easily, and he even destroyed my beloved sword. I’ve been thinking about it since yesterday, and I want to meet him to learn swordsmanship from him, so I hope you can tell me about your husband’s whereabouts."
"I see." Zhong Yan contacted Zhang Fei first and conveyed her wishes. "If you want to meet my husband, you should go to the Moonlight Passion Temple because he lives there."
"Huh?" Shuang Yuelan was completely surprised to hear that. "Does he really live in that dual cultivation sect?"

"Do I need to lie to you?" Zhong Yan shook her head. "My husband and I are dual cultivators, so we live in that sect. However, that sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect, but it has changed into a universal sect, and you can go there to see everything for yourself."
"Is the Moonlit Passion Temple truly a universal sect now?" Zhong Yan nodded to Shuang Yuelan. "In that case, I’ll go to the sect now to look for your husband."
Zhong Yan could only shake her head as she watched Shuang Yuelan leave, but she wondered in her heart about her husband’s plans for her, especially since he had asked her to come to the sect.

However, Zhong Yan was sure that her husband would not like Shuang Yuelan because they had been together for decades, and she was familiar with Zhang Fei’s character. "Perhaps he wants to recruit that woman into our sect because we still lack disciples."
Shuang Yuelan arrived at the Twin Flames Main Domain, and the situation in the domain had shocked her greatly, as the entire area had turned into a forest.

Shang Yuelan could sense the movement of many people in other areas, and she directed her senses there, where she discovered many members of the natural races. The giants and many other races were building many new residences in the domain, which Zhang Fei planned to use to house members of the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race.

Shang Yuelan ignored the natural races and went straight to the Moonlit Passion Temple, where she was once again shocked to find that Tian Kui and Serpentera had both reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.
Tian Kui escorted Shang Yuelan to the Sword Hall because Zhang Fei did not have much time to teach her about swordsmanship, and she could learn about the Sword Path from Jian Kuang.
During the journey there, they passed several other halls, which made Shang Yuelan amazed by all the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Soon, they reached the Sword Hall, and Tian Kui left the place without saying anything to her, leaving Shang Yuelan confused.
"Are you a new member of this sect?"
Shang Yuelan turned to Jian Kuang with wide-eyed shock, and she stammered. "Senior... Senior Sword Maniac."
"Oh?" Jian Kuang rubbed his chin in thought. "Do you know me?"

"Yes." Shang Yuelan nodded her head repeatedly. "When I was young, I accidentally saw you fight Lin Nanshan, which ended in your victory. Since then, I decided to train in the sword path because I wanted to become a skilled swordsman like you, but my skills were still average."

Jian Kuang tried to recall his fight with Lin Nanshan back then, but Shang Yuelan took out a small sword, showing it to him. He took it from her hand, and he nodded slightly after recognizing it. "Oh? So, you were that little girl back then, huh? I didn’t expect that a long time has passed, and you are all grown up now; even your cultivation has already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm."
"I... I’ve been looking for you for a long time, but I never managed to find any trace of you because you kept moving from one domain to another." Shang Yuelan received the sword back from him.
"Haha." Jian Kuang laughed at that. "I never stay in one domain, and I always go to domains to develop my skills with the sword. So, what is your goal in this sect? Are you going to join us?"
Shang Yuelan naturally wouldn’t pass up the opportunity to train under Jian Kuang. "Yes! I’ll join this sect! However, I don’t have a sword right now, especially since Zhang Fei broke my old sword."
"Sigh." Jian Kuang sighed helplessly. "That kid is too much! He shouldn’t have destroyed your sword."

Not only will this domain benefit from my return, but this Paradise Realm will also gain huge benefits from my return.’
Feltia [2] raised an eyebrow and looked at the soul of the Spirit Willow Tree.
"What do you mean by that?
What huge benefit will this Paradise Realm gain from your return?"
’You don’t need to be curious about that, the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox.

You will know the answers to all your questions in the future, and you just need to wait until the time comes.’ Feltia [2] frowned, but the soul of the Spirit Willow Tree was unwilling to say anything. ’Please plant my seed into the middle of this dead lake, and I will begin the process of my rebirth.’
Feltia [2] could only hear because the soul of the Spirit Willow Tree was as secretive as Feng Yao, but he didn’t ask anything else and planted the seed in the middle of the dead lake.
"Done."
’Thank you so much, the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox.
I will enter my seed and start my rebirth process, so we have to separate now.
However, we will meet again in the future, and I will help you fulfill your destiny.’
Feltia [2] wanted to ask something, but the soul of the Spirit Willow Tree quickly disappeared from his sight and entered the seed, which caused it to emit a bright white light.
Within seconds, the entire area of the dead lake was enveloped in a white barrier, preventing anyone from entering and disturbing the seed.
"Haish!
Everyone is playing secrets with me." Since Feltia [2] had nothing else to do in the Jiangshen Domain, he opened a gate and went elsewhere to hunt beasts to complete the daily quest.
Zhong Yan, who was watching the shop assistants serving the customers, raised her eyebrows when a woman entered the shop.
"What are you doing here?
Did your leader order you to cause trouble in my shop?"
"No." Shuang Yuelan replied with a shake of her head.
"I came here to look for your husband."
"Why are you looking for my husband?" Zhong Yan asked in confusion because Zhang Fei had not told her about his plans for the woman.
Shuang Yuelan explained the reason for her visit to Zhong Yan, which surprised her.
"I’ve been practicing swordsmanship for a long time, but your husband defeated me so easily, and he even destroyed my beloved sword.
I’ve been thinking about it since yesterday, and I want to meet him to learn swordsmanship from him, so I hope you can tell me about your husband’s whereabouts."
"I see." Zhong Yan contacted Zhang Fei first and conveyed her wishes.
"If you want to meet my husband, you should go to the Moonlight Passion Temple because he lives there."
"Huh?" Shuang Yuelan was completely surprised to hear that.
"Does he really live in that dual cultivation sect?"
"Do I need to lie to you?" Zhong Yan shook her head.
"My husband and I are dual cultivators, so we live in that sect.
However, that sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect, but it has changed into a universal sect, and you can go there to see everything for yourself."
"Is the Moonlit Passion Temple truly a universal sect now?" Zhong Yan nodded to Shuang Yuelan.
"In that case, I’ll go to the sect now to look for your husband."
Zhong Yan could only shake her head as she watched Shuang Yuelan leave, but she wondered in her heart about her husband’s plans for her, especially since he had asked her to come to the sect.
However, Zhong Yan was sure that her husband would not like Shuang Yuelan because they had been together for decades, and she was familiar with Zhang Fei’s character.
"Perhaps he wants to recruit that woman into our sect because we still lack disciples."
Shuang Yuelan arrived at the Twin Flames Main Domain, and the situation in the domain had shocked her greatly, as the entire area had turned into a forest.
Shang Yuelan could sense the movement of many people in other areas, and she directed her senses there, where she discovered many members of the natural races.
The giants and many other races were building many new residences in the domain, which Zhang Fei planned to use to house members of the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race.

Shang Yuelan ignored the natural races and went straight to the Moonlit Passion Temple, where she was once again shocked to find that Tian Kui and Serpentera had both reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.
Tian Kui escorted Shang Yuelan to the Sword Hall because Zhang Fei did not have much time to teach her about swordsmanship, and she could learn about the Sword Path from Jian Kuang.
During the journey there, they passed several other halls, which made Shang Yuelan amazed by all the changes in the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Soon, they reached the Sword Hall, and Tian Kui left the place without saying anything to her, leaving Shang Yuelan confused.
"Are you a new member of this sect?"
Shang Yuelan turned to Jian Kuang with wide-eyed shock, and she stammered.
"Senior...
Senior Sword Maniac."
"Oh?" Jian Kuang rubbed his chin in thought.
"Do you know me?"
"Yes." Shang Yuelan nodded her head repeatedly.
"When I was young, I accidentally saw you fight Lin Nanshan, which ended in your victory.
Since then, I decided to train in the sword path because I wanted to become a skilled swordsman like you, but my skills were still average."
Jian Kuang tried to recall his fight with Lin Nanshan back then, but Shang Yuelan took out a small sword, showing it to him.
He took it from her hand, and he nodded slightly after recognizing it.
"Oh?
So, you were that little girl back then, huh?
I didn’t expect that a long time has passed, and you are all grown up now; even your cultivation has already reached the 3-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm."
I’ve been looking for you for a long time, but I never managed to find any trace of you because you kept moving from one domain to another." Shang Yuelan received the sword back from him.
"Haha." Jian Kuang laughed at that.
"I never stay in one domain, and I always go to domains to develop my skills with the sword.
So, what is your goal in this sect?
Are you going to join us?"
Shang Yuelan naturally wouldn’t pass up the opportunity to train under Jian Kuang.
"Yes!
I’ll join this sect!
However, I don’t have a sword right now, especially since Zhang Fei broke my old sword."
"Sigh." Jian Kuang sighed helplessly.
"That kid is too much!
He shouldn’t have destroyed your sword."

chapters.title: Chapter 1422: Hun Lingwu - Xuan Meiyun
paragraphs: "Senior, it wasn’t Zhang Fei’s fault, and he did it because I tried to attack him." Shang Yuelan explained the situation between them to Jian Kuang.

"You’re lucky that kid didn’t do anything to you." Jian Kuang let out a sigh of relief. "I can tell you that he is cruel, and he will do anything to his enemies. If they are useless to him, he will kill them. If they are useful to him, he will do something else to them, such as enslaving them."
Shang Yuelan smiled bitterly upon hearing that. "Is Zhang Fei your disciple, Senior?"

"Hahaha." Jian Kuang laughed as he gave her a sword. "I would very much like to be his master, but I am not qualified to teach him swordsmanship. In fact, his swordsmanship is already well-honed, and his abilities are almost on par with mine, so I have nothing more to teach him."
"Huh?" Shang Yuelan was stunned after hearing that. ’Are Zhang Fei’s swordsmanship skills really that outstanding? Can he really match Senior Sword Maniac?’
"Come in." Jian Kuang led Shang Yuelan into the Sword Hall, introducing her to his disciple, Jun Qingling. "She is my first and last disciple, and she will be my successor in the future."

Shang Yuelan envied Jun Qingling because she also wanted to be Jian Kuang’s disciple, but he seemed to deem her unworthy. ’I will train very hard under his guidance, and I will prove to him that I am worthy of being his disciple.’

Thereafter, Shang Yuelan began her first sword training under Jian Kuang’s guidance, but she trained separately from Jun Qingling and the other disciples because she was much more experienced than them.
Zhuxian Sheng approached Jian Kuang and asked him. "Why don’t you accept that woman as your disciple? Her swordsmanship is quite good, and she seems eager to become your disciple."

"Haha." Jian Kuang laughed at that. "There are so many people who want to become my disciples; should I accept them all? Shang Yuelan is still young, and her sword skills are good, but I have no plans to accept new disciples now. If you are interested in her, you can appoint her to be your disciple."
"No." Zhuxian Sheng shook his head in response. "I do master swordsmanship, but you know that my true ability lies in the spear path, so I don’t deserve to take her as my disciple."

Jian Kuang turned to him. "The sword path and the spear path are actually not that different, and the principles of both are almost the same. You learn swordsmanship because of the sword intent, but spearmanship also has the spear intent, right?"

"Yes." Zhuxian Sheng stretched out both hands forward. He used his sword intent in his right hand and his spear intent in his left hand. "The two are similar, but sword intent is softer than spear intent, which is violent. I like the sword path, but I like the spear path more, mainly because its reach is wider and longer."

Jian Kuang observed Zhuxian Sheng’s sword intent and spear intent, but he felt that the latter was stronger than the former. "Unfortunately, this sect doesn’t have any disciples who are interested in spearmanship, and many of them are more interested in swordsmanship."
"Yeah." Zhuxian Sheng dispelled both of them. "I don’t need to rush with that, and I will wait for the disciples who are interested in the spearmanship."
Thereafter, Zhuxian Sheng left Jian Kuang, and he went to train his disciples in swordsmanship.
Lan Xuening, Dongfang Yuechan, Nong Qinwei, and Yin Chang are watching the natural races who helped them establish their new sect in the Twin Flames Main Domain.
In just forty days, the new building for the Hidden Moon Sect had almost taken shape, and they only needed to wait a little longer for it to be completely finished, which was impressive for them.
Nong Qinwei spoke to them. "Master! Senior Xuening! Our new sect is already half-finished, and we will bring all our disciples to move to this domain once it is complete."

"Yes." Dongfang Yuechan nodded to her. "Fortunately, Zhang Fei has the natural races by his side, especially the giant race. Otherwise, we would have waited a long time to move our sect to this domain."
"At this rate, we can move our sect to this domain in two months, and we can start our assassination operations again." Lan Xuening spoke.

Yin Chang spoke to them. "Our members often ask me about when we’ll be getting assassination missions again, especially since we’ve been rejecting those people recently. They also ask me when we’ll move to this domain and whether we’ll still accept assassination missions like before."

"Although we’ve decided to join Zhang Fei, we’re not part of the Moonlit Passion Temple, and we’ll maintain our Hidden Moon Sect traditions as before." Lan Xuening nodded in agreement with Dongfang Yuechan. "Yichang, you can tell our disciples that we’ll be moving to the domain in the next month, but we won’t be accepting assassination missions for now. I want them to train to improve their abilities first, and they can also cultivate at the Celestial Yin Lake to further their cultivation."

Yin Chang turned to her in surprise, as she herself had experienced the benefits of the Celestial Yin Lake for her cultivation, but she doubted that Zhang Fei would allow a disciple of their sect to cultivate there. "Can they really cultivate there, Master?"

"Yes." Dongfang Yuechan replied with a nod. "Zhang Fei and Qing Qiu’er have already permitted our sect’s disciples to cultivate there, and they should encounter no issues doing so because their male disciples have already relocated to the Blazing Union Sect."
Yin Chang nodded in understanding. "I’ll return to our sect now and inform the disciples about it."
"Do you know where Zhang Fei is now, Qinwei?"

Nong Qinwei shook her head at Lan Xuening. "I haven’t seen Zhang Fei since last time because he’s been busy with many things, and I don’t know where he is now. If you want to see him, you can ask Qing Qiu’er to contact him."
"No need." Lan Xuening declined. "I just want to talk to Zhang Fei about a few things, including our sect. Since he’s still busy with his personal affairs, I’ll go see him when he returns."
"Alright."
"Master."
Hun Lingwu, who was cultivating, immediately opened his eyes. He asked his disciple, who had just arrived. "What happened? Why does your expression look so awful, Tianyu?"

"Master, you asked me to go to the Stygian Dusk Domain to deliver the pills to Linghu Minghua, but I found no one there except for a bunch of corpses." Hun Tianyu hurriedly told his master about the situation at the Dusk Pavilion, where he found all its members had become rotten corpses.
Hun Lingwu was shocked to hear that, and he hurriedly stood up before running out, forcing Hun Tianyu to follow him.
A few minutes later, Hun Lingwu and Hun Tianyu had already arrived at the Stygian Dusk Domain, and they hurriedly went to the Dusk Pavilion.

Upon arrival, Hun Lingwu was instantly shocked to see so many corpses strewn outside the sect. He covered their bodies with qi because the stench of corpses was too strong, and he immediately led his disciples to the innermost room.

In the last room, Hun Lingwu found Linghu Minghua’s corpse, which was rotting and difficult to recognize. Even though the corpse was difficult to recognize, he could still recognize the person from the marks on the body, and he was truly shocked after finding out the identity of the corpse.
"See? There’s no one left here, and everyone was killed by a mysterious person, Master."

Hun Lingwu nodded slightly, led his disciple out, and burned the place afterwards. "Who was their real killer? Why did that person kill them without mercy? That person killed all the members of this sect, and that person didn’t spare a single person."
"Where are we going now, Master? Are we going back to our sect directly?" Hun Tianyu asked.
Hun Lingwu looked in another direction, precisely at the headquarters of Xuan Meiyun and the Black Lotus Spider Beast Race. "Let’s go."
A while later, they arrived at the location, and Hun Lingwu led his disciple into the innermost chamber, where Xuan Meiyun was waiting for them.

Xuan Meiyun was furious with Hun Lingwu, especially since she no longer had her freedom after Zhang Fei had duplicated her soul and merged it with his. However, she didn’t dare to trouble the old man either, and she asked him, "Why did you come here today? I haven’t made a move on that man yet, but I’ve sent my men to his sect to monitor him. Once I’m certain, I’ll catch him, and I’ll hand him over to you."

"I didn’t come here to talk about that." Xuan Meiyun was surprised to hear that, and Hun Lingwu immediately asked her. "Do you know anything about the deaths of Linghu Minghua and the people from the Dusk Pavilion?"
"Huh?" Xuan Meiyun stood up from her chair and stared at the old man in shock. "Are you serious? Did someone kill Linghu Minghua and the people from the Dusk Pavilion?"

Hun Lingwu didn’t say anything and created a qi screen, which showed the situation in the Dusk Pavilion. "As you can see, a mysterious person slaughtered them all without sparing a single person, but you and the residents of this domain seem to be unaware of it."
