chapters.title: Chapter 1423: Move The Spider Beasts
paragraphs: ’Linghu Minghua and the people from the Dusk Pavilion, huh? The situation in this domain would become chaotic if people found out about their deaths, and they would use all means to search for their murderers.’ Xuan Meiyun came to a realization due to her recent experiences. ’Could he and his four wives be the culprits? His abilities cannot be underestimated, especially his speed. I’m sure this old man also visited those people before he came to me, and they died because of him.’
Xuan Meiyun posed a question to the old man. "When did you find them dead? Did you come to them as you came to me at that time?"

"Today." Hun Lingwu hesitated to tell Xuan Meiyun the truth, but he decided to tell her anyway. "I approached those people before coming to you because I lacked confidence in your ability to defeat Zhang Fei, so I needed their help to capture him."

’As expected! That man must have killed Linghu Minghua and his people! With his speed and the help of those on his side, he can defeat them easily.’ Xuan Meiyun sat back in her chair and looked at him. "If you don’t have confidence in my abilities, you shouldn’t have come here to ask for my help. I do need your pills, but I don’t like it when you look down on me and the members of my race. Therefore, you can leave my place right now, and I will call back my people from the sect."
"You—"
"Leave." Xuan Meiyun shouted as she released her power.

Hun Lingwu stared at Xuan Meiyun in shock, especially since her strength had increased since the last time they met. He had deliberately used his pills as a bargain because he knew her strength hadn’t reached this level yet, but she had now managed to achieve it without his pills. "How—"

"I won’t repeat my words; you guys should leave my place right now." Xuan Meiyun summoned her subordinates, and countless spider beasts immediately appeared, surrounding Hun Lingwu and his disciple. "If you don’t leave now, I won’t hesitate to fight you. Even though I’m not as strong as you, this place is my nest, and I can do many things to the two of you here."
Hun Tianyu tugged at the hem of his master’s sleeve, mainly because he was afraid of those spider beasts. ’Master, we should leave this place now, or these spiders will really attack us.’

Hun Lingwu wasn’t afraid of Xuan Meiyun, but this place was her private domain. Moreover, he didn’t know what she was hiding there, which could be detrimental to him if he fought against her and her subordinates.

Hun Lingwu stared at Xuan Meiyun with fury, but she was undeterred and prepared to face him. He didn’t say anything else and immediately turned to leave, followed by Hun Tianyu. ’This damn spider woman dares to humiliate me and threatens me like this; I will kill her and her subordinates later.’

After Xuan Meiyun confirmed that the two people had left her place, she issued orders to her subordinates. "Pack up right now! We’re going to the Twin Flames Main Domain today, and we’ll be staying there from now on. If we stay here, that old man will send some powerful cultivators to slaughter us, and our race will be wiped out by their hands."
"Yes." Those spider beasts hurriedly transformed into their human forms, and they left the place to pack their personal belongings.

Xuan Meiyun let out a soft sigh and leaned back in her chair, looking around her room. She and the members of her race had lived there for thousands of years, but she never expected to have to move elsewhere for their safety. "I didn’t expect that that man was so cruel, and he slaughtered those people without sparing any of them. I don’t know whether following him would end well for me and Rasua or not, but I thought it would be better than us staying here and dying at the hands of those people. Moreover, he has already copied my soul and fused it with his, so I can’t disobey his order to move to his domain."
After she thought for some time, Xuan Meiyun decided to contact Zhang Fei, informing him about Hun Lingwu’s arrival just now.

To Xuan Meiyun’s surprise, Zhang Fei informed her that he would go there to pick them up, and Feltia [2] had already arrived in front of her in a few blinks of an eye. "I know your speed is so fast, but how did you get here so quickly?"

"Haha." Feltia [2] laughed. "You don’t know anything about me yet, but you’ll know more about me when you move there. I didn’t expect that old man would find out about those people’s deaths so soon, and I thought he would find out after some time."
"So, you killed those people after you came to my place that time, huh?" Xuan Meiyun muttered as she looked at Feltia [2].
Feltia [2] shrugged his shoulders. "Several hundred years ago they ambushed my parents-in-law, forcing them to flee to the Three Mortal Realms to hide."
"Who are your parents-in-law?"

"Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi from the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary." Xuan Meiyun naturally knew them, but she didn’t expect that they were Feltia [2]’s parents-in-law. "Since the old man ordered Linghu Minghua to capture me, I decided to go to him and settle the old grudge between them. I slaughtered all his subordinates, but I didn’t kill him, and I handed him over to them."
Xuan Meiyun was confused by that. "If you didn’t kill Linghu Minghua, how could that old man find his corpse there?"

Since Xuan Meiyun couldn’t possibly betray him, Feltia [2] showed her two identities as the lust demon and the heavenly fox. He returned to his human form again after that, leaving her dazed with her eyes wide open and her mouth agape. "Do you understand now?"
"How... how can you be a human, a fox beast, and a lust demon at the same time?" Xuan Meiyun asked, stammering.

"Because I’m special." Xuan Meiyun’s lips twitched at Feltia [2]’s nonchalant answer. "The residence for you and your race members isn’t ready yet, so you’ll be staying in my sect for the time being. Once the residence is ready, you can move them there, and I want all of you to set up defenses around the entire domain."

"What kind of defenses do you want us to set up?" Feltia [2] explained to Xuan Meiyun some things about his plans for the Twin Flames Main Domain. "I don’t think it’s difficult for us, but those defenses won’t be enough to protect your domain from attacks by cultivators as powerful as that old man. Therefore, we need additional defenses; otherwise, those people will be able to attack us easily."

chapters.title: Chapter 1424: Hu Lingwu - Three People
paragraphs: Xuan Meiyun had never been to the Moonlit Passion Sect before, so she was amazed when they arrived at the floating plateau. She used her senses to scan the entire sect area, but she was shocked to find many people from various races gathered within the sect. "Did you gather these people on purpose?"

"They are people I brought from the Three Mortal Realms." Xuan Meiyun turned to Feltia [2] in surprise. "Most of them helped me a lot in the past, so I brought them to this realm to develop themselves. Moreover, I still have many plans for the future, and I need the help of many people to make them come true. I will turn this sect into a utopia for all races, and they can live here in peace."

Xuan Meiyun asked again. "Why do you care so much about these people? Is it because you have three different identities? Usually, other cultivators will only care about themselves, and they will use others to gain benefits."

"Haha." Feltia [2] laughed at that. "You will laugh if you know my reasons, but I can tell you that I’m not doing this for profit. I just want to create a peaceful place for my family and all the people around me, so no one can disturb or hurt them."
Xuan Meiyun looked at Feltia [2] silently for a while. "Can my race and I be part of your plan?"

"Do you still need to ask that after I brought you all here?" Feltia [2] returned the question. "However, you won’t be staying here for free, and you must help me create the defenses, as I said before. If you all can do that, you guys can enjoy the peace I will create here later."
Xuan Meiyun nodded to him. "You can tell me the details, and I will order all my subordinates to create those defenses."

"Alright." Feltia [2] pointed towards the beasts’ residence. "You can bring your subordinates to that area, but there are many mythical beast races there. They might be uncomfortable with their presence, but they should get used to the situation, and I will move them when your new residence is ready."

Xuan Meiyun hurriedly led her subordinates to the mythical beast residence. As Feltia [2] just said, the spider beasts felt pressured by their presence, but they immediately suppressed their auras, giving the spiders some relief.
Feltia [2] decided to leave the Moonlit Passion Sect, heading elsewhere to finish the unfinished daily quests.
After he left Xuan Meiyun’s place, Hun Lingwu decided to meet some people in the Stygian Dusk Domain, who frightened Hun Tianyu.
"Why did you ask us to gather here, Old Man?" The man with a burly, muscular body asked.
Another man with the appearance of a scholar asked him. "Old man, it is unusual for you to come to us, and you would rather ask Linghu Minghua for help than us."

"Hehe." A woman chuckled as she walked over to Hun Lingwu’s side and sat on his lap. She wrapped her arms around his neck and teased him. "Did you miss me that much now? Do you want to have some fun with me this time?"
"Linghu Minghua is dead." The woman and the two men looked at Hun Lingwu in shock after he said that. "I don’t know the identity of the murderer, but I have a strong suspicion about that person."
Hun Lingwu created a qi screen and displayed Zhang Fei’s face there, including the Moonlit Passion Temple.
The three people knew about the Moonlit Passion Temple, but they were confused about his purpose in displaying it there, and they didn’t know Zhang Fei either.
"Who is that person? He looks delicious, and I really want to eat him." The woman in Hun Lingwu’s lap asked, licking her sensual lips while looking at Zhang Fei’s image.

"Shuang Yuelan, his name is Zhang Fei, and he’s an elder of the Moonlit Passion Sect." Hun Lingwu explained a few things to the three of them, but he didn’t tell them the truth, especially about the artifact mirror or Feng Yao. "He may be young, but the three of you shouldn’t underestimate him. I suspect he killed Linghu Minghua and slaughtered his subordinates, but I don’t know when or how he did it. I want the three of you to capture him and bring him to me, and I will give you a pill that can help you break through to the 2-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm as a reward."
The eyes of the three people lit up as soon as Hun Lingwu mentioned the reward, especially since they had worked hard to break through to that stage without success.
"Are you really going to pay us with those pills to capture him?" The man with a burly, muscular body asked.

The other man also asked him. "Why didn’t you capture that kid? I did want your pill to break through to the next stage, but I’m confused by your reasoning for not acting on your own. You even preferred to give us your pill, which is against your character."
"Is Zhang Fei so great?" Shuang Yuelan curiously asked.

"His cultivation is at the 3-Sun Celestial Lord Realm." The three people were a little surprised by Hun Lingwu’s answer. "Even though he’s not strong, he’s the son-in-law of Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi because he married their only daughter."
"Eh?" Shuang Yuelan screamed. "Don’t Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi only have two sons? Since when did they have a daughter?"

Hun Lingwu shook his head at them. "I never knew they had a daughter either, and I only heard about this from Linghu Minghua. I wanted to capture Zhang Fei myself, but someone was monitoring my movements, so I couldn’t do it."
"Who?"

"I won’t tell you because you will be afraid of that person, Wang Lei." The man with a burly, muscular body frowned at Hun Lingwu. "That person’s cultivation is at the Celestial God Realm, so you will never win against that person. Whichever of you three manages to bring Zhang Fei to me, I will give that person a breakthrough pill, and your strength will increase even more."

"I give up." The man with the appearance of a scholar stood up from his seat. "I desperately want to break through to that stage, but I don’t want to throw my life away in vain. Linghu Minghua is dead, and I think his death has something to do with Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi. They are both stronger than me, and they still have their ancestors. If I fight them, I will die in vain, so I choose to pass up this opportunity."
"You coward, Zuo Chang’an!" Shuang Yuelan shouted.
"Heh." Zuo Chang’an replied with a snort. "You can fight them if you’re brave, but it’s better to be a coward than die in vain."

"You—" Shuang Yuelan stopped cursing because Zuo Chang’an had already disappeared from the place, and she turned to Hun Lingwu. "I will accept your offer, and I will bring Zhang Fei to you. However, he is protected by Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, and their ancestors, so I want two breakthrough pills as payment."

Wang Lei nodded in agreement with her. "I will also accept your offer, but I need two breakthrough pills. If you are willing to give them to me as payment, I will go directly to the Moonlit Passion Sect to capture Zhang Fei."

’What greedy people!’ Hun Lingwu agreed to their request straight away. "If the two of you can capture Zhang Fei alive and bring him to me, I will give you two breakthrough pills. That way, you will be able to break through to the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, and no one will dare to oppose you anymore at that time."

"Deal." Shuang Yuelan jumped off Hun Lingwu’s lap. "I’m going to the Moonlit Passion Sect to infiltrate it soon, and I’ll bring Zhang Fei to your sect directly, so you must prepare those two Breakthrough Pills."
"Hahaha!" Wang Lei laughed as he rose to his feet. "I won’t hand over the two pills to you, Yuelan. I will capture Zhang Fei, and the pills will be mine."
"Humph!" Shuang Yuelan snorted at him and disappeared from the place.
"Hahaha." Wang Lei said to Hun Lingwu. "Prepare those two pills as soon as possible, and I will take them after I capture Zhang Fei."
After they disappeared, Hun Tianyu sat beside his master. "Why don’t you tell them the truth, Master? What if they die at the hands of Zhang Fei and Qing Qiu’er?"

"Hahaha! They are just stupid and greedy people." Hun Lingwu laughed at that. "If they die at the hands of Zhang Fei and Qing Qiu’er, then so be it. If they both fail and die at their hands, I will search for stronger people who can help me take my artifact mirror back from that brat. Let’s go back to our sect, and you don’t have to think about those two people."
Hun Tianyu sighed helplessly after hearing that, but he didn’t say anything and followed his master to leave the place, returning to their sect in the Samsara Domain.

Not long after they disappeared, Zhang Fei [1] appeared on the place. "Those two people are really idiots, huh? They have known that old man for so long, but they don’t understand his true character, and he wants to send them to die by my hands."
[Are you going to kill them, Master?]

chapters.title: Chapter 1425: Killing Two Birds
paragraphs: "We don’t need to waste time with useless, greedy people. Moreover, that woman’s yin qi is too weak, even though her cultivation has reached the 1-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm. If my guess is correct, she used pills to increase her cultivation, which made her yin qi so weak." After he said that, Zhang Fei [1] disappeared from that place and went to his next destination.

Shuang Yuelan had just arrived at her place, and she wanted to make some preparations to infiltrate the Moonlight Passion Sect. She didn’t dare to intrude there without any preparation, especially since she knew for sure Qing Qiu’er’s cultivation was at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, which was two stages above hers.
Shuang Yuelan was shocked when she found her two gate guards dead, and she quickly ran in to check, but she found several of her subordinates already lying on the ground lifeless.
The deeper Shuang Yuelan ran, the more she found her subordinates dead, and they seemed to have died without realizing it. "What’s going on here? Who dares attack my place?"

In my home realm, there was a human race that was far superior to other humans, but they were slaughtered by demons from the upper realms in the past. This is why I suspect that the winged race was originally part of the human race, but they evolved into that race long ago."

Long Wuzhao nodded slightly. "Humans and the winged races are almost the same, but the people of that race have wings, and they can evolve like demons and beasts. Are there any other images you haven’t shown us?"

"Nothing." Zhang Fei dispelled all the qi screens. "Now, we must focus on helping others reach the highest level of cultivation, but I know that won’t be easy. Unfortunately, we have no choice but to do so, or this Paradise Realm will be destroyed if those two primordial beasts send their avatars here."
Long Xukong looked at Zhang Fei. "So, do you think those two primordial beasts are our final opponents?"

"I’m not sure about that." Zhang Fei answered by shaking his head. "There are still many hidden secrets within this universe, and I don’t know them all yet, so I don’t dare say whether they will be our final opponents or not. For now, I don’t want to think too much about this matter because my strength is still far from facing them, and all of you should focus on helping those beasts reach the Immortal rank and the Celestial God Realm, especially since most of them are still far from achieving both."

Tianshi Bailong then spoke to Long Wuzhao. "Brother Wuzhao, we must speak to all the beast races in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain as soon as possible, and we will focus on helping them improve their beast rank and cultivation. If they don’t become strong quickly, they won’t be able to help us face the avatars of the two primordial beasts."

"Yes." Long Wuzhao nodded seriously. "I’ll meet Feng Jinhuang and the others after a while to discuss this matter with him, and I want them to help us train those people because we can’t train that many people with just the three of us."
"Is Feng Jinhuang really a golden phoenix?"

Long Wuzhao nodded to Zhang Fei. "Feng Jinhuang is indeed a golden phoenix, and he is the only one of his kind in this universe. However, he was not born a golden phoenix but a fire phoenix, and he transformed into one after he discovered something. chapters.title: Chapter 1435: Mythical Beasts Talk
paragraphs: "The Ancient Realm lies between this Paradise Realm and the Primordial Realm, but I didn’t know the location of the portal that would allow us to go there before, and I only discovered it last night." Long Wuzhao turned to Long Xukong, who was changing the display on the qi screen. "The images on the screen show the situation in the Ancient Desolation Domain, which is part of the Ancient Realm. The beasts in that world are powerful, far stronger than those that exist in this realm, including me. If we go there with our current strength, I’m sure we’ll face plenty of trouble there. Their numbers are not small, and they are far stronger than us, so we can’t possibly face them at this time."

Feng Jinhuang stared at the images one by one, and he then glanced at all the beasts present before letting out a heavy sigh. There were many mythical beasts in the Paradise Realm, but only four of them had reached the immortal rank. He was one of the four immortal-ranked beasts, and the three dragons were the others. With their overall strength, they had no chance in the Ancient Desolation Domain, and they would die if they forced themselves to fight the beasts there.

Feng Shizhu and the other leaders of the mythical beast races were aware of their current strength, and they were certain that they wouldn’t be able to survive long in the Ancient Desolation Domain. If they forced themselves into that domain, they would only be throwing their lives away in vain at the hands of those beasts.

Feng Bingying looked at the images on the qi screen in deep thought, and she thought of a solution that could help her Ice Phoenix members become stronger quickly. However, she was hesitant to do so, and she was unsure if her race members would accept her decision.

Feng Shizhu turned to Feng Bingying and spoke to her via voice transmission. ’I think we should go see Zhang Fei as soon as possible, Bingying. He is the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox, and he is the only person who can help the members of our ice phoenix race to become stronger faster. If we can reach the immortal rank, we can go to that domain to improve ourselves further.’

’Sigh.’ Feng Bingying sighed inwardly before replying to her ancestor. ’The problem is that members of our race aren’t necessarily willing to accept our decision to have them cultivate using Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi, ancestor. I know his Yang Qi is truly powerful because he is the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox, but all members of our race are used to being independent. Moreover, they don’t know him very well either, so I’m sure they will reject our decision.’

Feng Shizhu understood that. ’I will talk to them after this meeting, and I will convince them regarding this matter. Moreover, they’ve seen Feng Jinqiu and Feng Xueling’s progress in the past half a year, and their cultivation has accelerated significantly thanks to the assistance of Zhang Fei’s Yang Qi.’

’Speaking of those three women, Zhang Yue’s progress has been truly rapid since she returned to our domain a month and a half ago, Ancestor. Her mastery of the Ice Phoenix Scripture is almost at its peak, and her mastery of both body techniques has also increased significantly, so I think she will soon be ready to become the new leader of our race.’ Feng Shizhu herself had been closely monitoring Zhang Yue’s progress, so she also agreed with Feng Bingying. ’How about we appoint her as the leader of our ice phoenix race after she has fully mastered it?’

Feng Shizhu shook her head in response. ’We don’t need to talk about that now, especially since Zhang Fei won’t necessarily allow her big sister to stay away from his side. For now, we should let Zhang Yue focus on her cultivation, and we will appoint her as the future leader of our ice phoenix race.’
’Alright then.’ Feng Bingying sighed in her heart, especially since she wanted to enter long seclusion to pursue the immortal rank.

Long Wuzhao spoke to everyone again. "I plan to seal our domain soon, and you guys don’t need to worry about the affairs of the outside world. I want all of you to focus on your cultivation to raise your beasts to Immortal rank, and we will go to the Ancient Desolation Domain together in the future."
"What about the four perils?" Feng Jinhuang asked him. "They might become suspicious if you seal our domain, and they might cause trouble in the other domains in our absence."

"I know that." Long Wuzhao nodded at him. "I want to seal our domain so that no disturbance will be experienced by all the mythical beast races, but Brother Xukong and I will monitor the situation in other domains. Moreover, the four perils haven’t shown any activity, and they seem to be waiting for something. If they finally decide to move, the four of us will move to stop them. However, we have to be careful because I don’t know when the avatar of the Primordial Nihility Beast will descend into our realm, and we will die if we face him now."

Feng Jinhuang’s eyes flickered after Long Wuzhao mentioned the matter. "If the avatar of the Primordial Nihility Beast descends into our realm, we won’t be able to escape anywhere, right? Therefore, we have no other choice but to fight him, or he will exterminate our mythical beast race. If that happens, the four perils will rule this realm, and the casualties will be even greater."

"That’s right." Long Wuzhao then spoke to the other leaders of the mythical beast races. "Summon all members of your races who are outside and ask them to return to our domain as soon as possible, and I will seal our domain after they return."
"Yes." The other leaders of the mythical beast races left the place to carry out Long Wuzaho’s orders, including Feng Bingying and Feng Shizhu.
Feng Bingying and Feng Shizhu immediately left the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, and they went to the Moonlit Passion Temple in the Twin Flames Main Domain to look for Zhang Fei.

After they left, Feng Jinhuang asked Long Wuzhao again, "You’re hiding something from us, right? How did you find out about the Ancient Desolation Domain? We’ve known each other since you ascended to this domain, so I’m familiar with your character, and someone else told you about it."
"Hahaha." Long Wuzhao laughed at that. "I know that you ordered Kong Bai and Nu Liexi to search for Zhang Fei, but you underestimated him."

Feng Jinhuang immediately realized something. "Did Zhang Fei tell you about that domain? How did he know about that domain? Where is the location of the two primordial beast statues? Why have I never seen that place before?"

"Zhang Fei did tell me about the Ancient Desolation Domain, but I still won’t tell you his exact location. As you said before, we’ve known each other for so long, and I knew you would disturb him." When Long Wuzhao made that statement, Feng Jinhuang’s lips twitched. "I don’t know the exact location of the statues of the two primordial beasts because he didn’t tell me about it, and he managed to get there because he accidentally got lost there a few years ago."
Long Xukong changed the image on the qi screen, showing Feng Jinhuang the image of the sleeping male demon.

Feng Jinhuang instantly stood up from his seat, and his eyes widened as he looked at the image of the sleeping male demon. "Is that demon also in the Ancient Desolation Domain? Although I can’t confirm it, I can feel that he is stronger than all demon gods."

"Yes." Long Wuzhao nodded at him. "I couldn’t sense the power of the sleeping male demon either, but Zhang Fei and I suspected that he was a primordial-ranked demon. Unfortunately, the Ancient Desolation Domain was too weak to contain his power, so he decided to enter a deep slumber so that his presence wouldn’t harm the other demons and demon beasts there. If he chose to stay awake, his presence would weaken the domain, and they would die if the domain was destroyed."

"Why doesn’t that male demon go to the Primordial Realm if it exists?" Feng Jinhuang asked as he seriously observed the sleeping male demon, but the hairs on the back of his neck stood on end when he thought about the demon waking up from his slumber.

"I don’t know." Long Wuzhao paused for a moment before continuing. "The Primordial Realm does exist, but I don’t know how to get there. That male demon probably didn’t know about it either, so he chose to enter the deep slumber to keep the domain from being destroyed. "We’ve decided to cultivate in that domain, and I’ve asked Long Wuzhao for help to protect my ice phoenix members." The five female elders, along with Feng Bingying and Feng Shizhu, nodded.
"Good." Zhang Fei [1] opened a portal to that domain.
"You guys can enter now, and you will arrive in that domain directly.
You must go straight to the eastern area, and you should never try to go to the main hall, or you will get into serious trouble there."
Feng Bingying immediately got down from her chair and walked towards the portal.
"Zhang Fei, I entrust the members of my race to you, and please protect them."
"I will." Feng Bingying, Feng Shizhu, and the five female elders disappeared into the portal before Zhang Fei [1] closed it.
After they left, he went to the ice area, where Zhang Yue, Feng Xueling, and Feng Jinqiu were cultivating with the other ice phoenix members.
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in satisfaction after observing the progress of Zhang Yue, Feng Xueling, and Feng Jinqiu.
Moreover, the three women were also using their Yang Qi to support their cultivation, which significantly contributed to their progress.
He didn’t disturb them and went to the central area, where he started practicing both of his ice body techniques, especially since he had neglected them too long.
The seven female phoenixes have arrived at the lake in the eastern area of the Ashen Lotus Monastery.
They were curious about the main hall, but they chose to listen to Zhang Fei [1]’s warning not to go there.
Unbeknownst to them, the two spirits of the Giant Yin-Yang Lotus, Yang Lianhua and Yin Lianhua, appeared above them.

They knew that Zhang Fei [1] had sent the seven female ice phoenixes into their domain to cultivate, and they increased the strength of the Yin Qi within the lake before disappearing again. ’The seven of you must make the most of the opportunity before you, or you will not be able to help him save this universe.’
Feng Bingying crouched by the lake and dipped her hand into the water, but her expression turned to shock after she sensed the powerful Yin Qi within.
"Ancestor, try sensing the Yin Qi within this lake."
"Hmm?" Feng Shizhu, who was curious about this, immediately crouched down beside Feng Bingying and dipped her hand in.
"This!
The Yin Qi in this lake isn’t five times stronger but ten times stronger!
If we cultivate in this place for a few years, I believe we can reach the immortal rank by then."
"Yes." Feng Bingying turned towards the main hall.
"Do you think the lotus is deliberately increasing the strength of the Yin Qi in this lake to help us, Ancestor?"
"That’s possible." Feng Shizhu stood up and took off her clothes, followed by Feng Bingying and the five female elders.
"We don’t need to think about it too much, and we just need to focus on cultivating in this lake.
I hope we can really reach Immortal rank when we come back, and we no longer need to worry about the four perils attacking us."
"Yes." Feng Shizhu led Feng Bingying and the five female elders into the lake, and they cultivated in seclusion for a long period.

Three days passed quickly in the outside world, which was the equivalent of twelve days in the training space.
Zhang Fei finally stopped dual cultivating and dual soul cultivating with Nalan Wangzi.
Zhang Fei frowned after one of his clones outside received a voice transmission from Qi Qingxiu, informing him that Qiongqi had arrived in her domain.
"Did something happen?" Nalan Wangzi asked, hugging Zhang Fei from behind.
"Yes." Zhang Fei told Nalan Wangzi about Qiongqi and Qi Qingxiu.
"We should get dressed now, and I will go to her domain directly."

chapters.title: Chapter 1441: Meet Qiongqi
paragraphs: When he arrived at the Seven Emotions Demon Domain, Zhang Fei saw Qi Qingxiu sitting on her throne with an annoyed expression, with Qiongqi sitting on one of the chairs below.

Qi Qingxiu couldn’t recognize Zhang Fei because he transformed into a female demon to avoid Qiongqi’s suspicion, but he used the harem link to speak to her. She almost laughed after knowing his identity, but she hurriedly suppressed her laughter because the evil beast was watching them.
’Scan him, Mei.’
[Wait a second, Master.]
Name: Qiongqi
Gender: Male
Race: Malevolent Evil Beast
Rank: Immortal
Cultivation: 1-Sun Celestial God Realm
Element: Darkness [Peak Stage]
Elemental Law: Darkness [Perfection Stage]
Core: Darkness [Peak Rank]
Physique: Evil Winged Tiger
Strong: Darkness
Weak: Light
Zhang Fei was shocked after reading Qiongi’s status. ’Holy shit! This beast is really old, and he’s older than Long Wuzhao.’
Qiongqi raised an eyebrow as Zhang Fei walked behind Qi Qingxiu’s throne and stood there, and he knew that his cultivation was still at the 3-Star Celestial King Realm.

Qiongqi felt disgusted when he looked at Zhang Fei’s disguised face, especially because he made his face ugly to avoid him. "You should chase away that ugly woman behind you because she will only dirty your palace, Qingxiu."

"Who do you think you are to dare order me to chase away my subordinates?" Qi Qingxiu asked in a high voice as she looked at Qiongqi with disdain. "You should feel lucky that I still allow you to set foot in this palace, especially after what you did in the past. If you want to interfere in my personal affairs, I will throw you out of here right now, and I will never allow you to set foot here again. You are stronger than me physically because you are an evil beast, but you’re not immune to my ability to influence your seven emotions."

Qiongqi’s face darkened as he was enraged by Qi Qingxiu’s words, but he remembered for sure her abilities in controlling the seven emotions of living beings. Although he was physically stronger than her because he was an evil beast, he couldn’t prevent her abilities from influencing his seven emotions, and he had already experienced their effects in the past.

"So, what is your purpose in coming here today?" Qi Qingxiu asked lazily because she had never liked Qiongqi for a long time, mainly because he had forced her to marry him in the past. However, his try failed miserably as he was affected by her ability to influence all seven emotions, forcing him to flee with his tail between his legs.
Before answering Qi Qingxiu, Qiong stole a glance at Zhang Fei. "Like before, I hope you are willing to marry me, and—"

"I’ve told you many times that I’ve never liked any man, including you." Qi Qingxiu interrupted him directly. "You men disgust me because you always think with your lower bodies, so I would rather not have a relationship with any man. Besides, there are so many female demons by my side, and they can satisfy me when I’m in heat."

Qiongqi’s face turned ugly after Qi Qingxiu rejected him for the umpteenth time, and he wanted to kidnap her and take her back to his palace. He would use force to bring her back if necessary, but he hasn’t found a solution to withstand her abilities.

Qiongqi had wanted Qi Qingxiu to be his wife since he saw her for the first time, but she kept rejecting him again and again, which made his patience wear thin. He had asked his three friends for help, but none of them wanted anything to do with her because of her abilities.
"If you have no other business here, you can leave my palace now." Qi Qingxiu nonchalantly said.

Qiongqi stared at Qi Qingxiu for a while. "You can still refuse me now, but you won’t be able to refuse me anymore when my master arrives in this realm, and that time won’t be long. At that time, I will make you kneel before me, and I will force you to serve me as a slave for the rest of your life."
"Shameless! You always act arrogant, but it turns out you are just a coward who only dares to hide behind your master." Qi Qingxiu mocked him.
"Hahaha!" Qiongqi laughed shamelessly. "It’s up to you if you want to call me a coward or whatever, but the time for you to serve me as my slave will come sooner than you imagine."
After he said that, Qiongqi immediately disappeared from Qi Qingxiu’s palace, leaving her furious.

Qi Qingxiu turned to Zhang Fei and wanted to ask him a question, but he put his index finger to his lips, signaling her not to say anything. From the map, he could see that Qiongqi had not left the domain, and the evil beast would find out his true identity if he spoke to him now.

’Qiongxi is truly powerful.’ Qi Qingxiu sighed heavily and nodded to Zhang Fei. ’Even if I had reached the peak of cultivation, I’m not confident I could defeat him with my strength. The story will be different if I manage to collect all of Hu Tianlang’s souls and evolve into a ten-tailed fox, and I’m confident I can face him and his other friends. Unfortunately, his other two souls are not in this Paradise Realm, and they are hidden in the Ancient Realm. I’ve found a way to go to that realm, but the situation there is different from this one, and I don’t know when I can go there.’
Qi Qingxiu looked at Zhang Fei and asked in shock. ’Have you really found a way to go to the Ancient Realm?’

’Yes.’ Zhang Fei touched Qi Qingxiu’s forehead and shared the images of the Ancient Desolation Domain with her. ’You can see the situation in that domain yourself, Qingxiu. The beasts are as strong as Qiongqi and his three friends, and I also saw many powerful demons there, so I have to think twice about going there with my current cultivation.’

Qi Qingxiu hurriedly closed her eyes and saw all the images of the domain, which completely shocked her. Even though she didn’t see them in person, she was a powerful demon god, so she knew that the demons and beasts in the Ancient Desolation Domain were much stronger than those in the Paradise Realm.
Some time later, Qi Qingxiu opened her eyes and looked at Zhang Fei with a serious expression. ’Are those beasts and demon beasts of the immortal rank? Are these demons truly of demon god rank?’

’The beasts and demon beasts are of immortal rank, while the demons are of demon god rank. Moreover, their numbers are not small, and they are spread across various other domains.’ Qi Qingxiu took a deep breath after receiving confirmation from Zhang Fei. ’Now, you understand the difference in the strength of the inhabitants of the two domains, right? Moreover, I suspect there is a demon at primordial rank in that domain, but he is currently in a long slumber.’
Qi Qingxiu’s eyes widened when she heard that, but Zhang Fei immediately touched her forehead again, sharing his memories of the male demon he saw in the Ancient Desolation Domain with her.

’Shit!’ Qi Qingxiu cursed herself after seeing the figure of the male demon. ’How exactly am I supposed to reach the primordial rank? If I succeed in reaching that rank, no one will be able to match me anymore. That way, I can ensure the safety of myself and my race, and we will live in safety forever.’
Zhang Fei shook his head and raised both hands. "Actually, I still have some doubts about the male demon because I can’t detect his cultivation through my item, and his demon rank is just my guess."
"Has Qiongqi left my domain?"
"Yeah."

Qi Qingxiu breathed a sigh of relief after hearing that because she never liked Qiongqi, and she deeply hated his overbearing attitude, especially his insistence on forcing her to become his wife. "What are your doubts about that male demon?"

"I did suspect he was a primordial-rank demon, but I remember that there is only one primordial-rank living being per race." Qi Qingxiu furrowed her brows at Zhang Fei. "I’ve told you about the Primordial Nihility Beast and the Primordial Genesis Beast, and I’ve encountered the dead Primordial Demon in the past. Thus, I’m reconsidering my guess, and it’s possible that my guess about him was wrong. He probably entered deep sleep not because of his demon rank, but maybe there are other causes that I don’t know about."

Qi Qingxiu fell into deep thought after hearing that. "If your guess about the male demon is wrong, and if there is only one primordial from each race, then I won’t be able to reach the primordial rank, right?"

"Hahaha." Feng Yao immediately emerged from Zhang Fei’s body. "You’re wrong about that; there were many primordials in the past, but only five were able to reach their peak. However, this universe has weakened, and the number of new primordials born will not be as numerous as in the past. The primordial demon of the past has been killed by the two primordial beasts, but a new primordial demon will be born in the future, and I guess that person will be the only primordial demon in the future."
"Who?"
Feng Yao shook her head. "You two just need to wait for that demon to appear."

chapters.title: Chapter 1442: Feng Yao - Zhang Fei - Qi Qingxiu
paragraphs: "Tch!" Qi Qingxiu clenched her teeth in frustration.
Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao. "Is it true that only one demon can ascend to the primordial rank?"
"Yes." Feng Yao nodded at him. "That demon won’t appear anytime soon, but that person will appear once you successfully evolve into a ten-tailed fox."

Feng Yao created several qi screens, displaying images of the five primordials from the past. Qi Qingxiu couldn’t recognize them, but Zhang Fei could recognize them because he had met them in the last room of the Era of the Beginning in the past.
"Who are they?" Qi Qingxiu looked at the five figures.

"They are the first primordials of the human race, the beast race, the demon race, the natural race, and the demihuman race." Feng Yao zoomed in on the first screen. "Some of the primordials of all races are still alive today, except for the demon race because the Primordial Nihility Beast and the Primordial Genesis Beast already exterminated them in the past. However, they have long been in deep slumber, like the two primordial beasts, but their numbers are small. If they continue to roam around, this universe will grow stronger because of them."
"Then, what about the demon races?"

"The primordial demon that you encountered in the past was the first and the last." Feng Yao zoomed in on the image, which showed the room of the demon statues. "His seven subordinate in the past were also primordial demons, but they were not as powerful as he was, primarily because the power of the primordials is also determined by caste. As I said before, the new primordial demon will be born in the future, and that person will most likely be the only one."
"Am I really unable to ascend to the primordial rank?" Qi Qingxiu asked dejectedly.

"I don’t want to give you false hope." Qi Qingxiu became increasingly dejected after Feng Yao’s statement, which indicated that she truly had no hope of becoming the primordial demon. "According to my calculations, there will be a few primordials that will appear in the future, and one of them will be Zhang Fei."
Qi Qingxiu looked at Zhang Fei, but she had no doubt that he would ascend to the primordial rank in the future, especially since he was the next ten-tailed fox.
Zhang Fei hugged Qi Qingxiu’s waist and kissed her lips. "You don’t need to think too much about it, and I will think of ways to help you reach that rank in the future."
Qi Qingxiu didn’t answer and hugged Zhang Fei, but she was aware that her chances of reaching the primordial rank were very slim, so she didn’t have much hope that he could help her reach that rank.

Zhang Fei sighed inwardly because he wanted to help all his wives reach the highest point in the cultivation world, which meant they had to reach the primordial rank. "What about the human race? Will you be the primordial representing them?"

"I don’t have an answer to your question, especially since I don’t know my future." Zhang Fei frowned at that, but Feng Yao pointed her index finger to his chest. "As for you, you are the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox, so you will be the primordial of the beast race. However, you must first obtain all of Hun Tianlang’s souls, and you must also obtain the hearts of the two heavenly foxes."

Zhang Fei himself had been thinking about it for a long time, so he was not surprised by Feng Yao’s answer, and he had always hoped to become one. "Does that mean there won’t be any other beasts that can reach the primordial rank, including Long Wuzhao?"

"Hmm?" Feng Yao supported her chin with her hands and thought deeply. "The five-clawed golden dragon and the calamity demon dragon of the past were primordial beasts, but they were much weaker than Hu Tianlang, the Primordial Nihility Beast, and the Primordial Genesis Beast. They both ultimately died at the hands of the latter two, and they have been reincarnated several times. Long Wuzhao is indeed powerful for a beast living in this era, but I am uncertain whether he can reach the primordial rank, primarily due to the weakening of this universe. Therefore, it is unlikely for him to reach the primordial rank, and he will forever remain in the immortal rank."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and asked another question. "What about the other two powerful primordials, especially those from the natural and demihuman races?"

"I can’t yet determine the fate of the natural and demihuman races, so we can only wait for the answer in the future." Feng Yao thought for a moment before continuing. "However, a new primordial will likely emerge from the winged race in the future, and that person will be one of your wives."
"Xu Ling’er."

"That’s right." Feng Yao nodded at him. "I can’t say for sure about the process, but I have a hunch that she will become the first primordial of the winged race, and you will help her reach the primordial rank. By the way, it’s time for you to go to the Heavenly Mistveil Domain to meet the demihumans, and you might get something interesting from them."
Feng Yao dispelled all the qi screens, turned into a crimson flame, and entered Zhang Fei’s body again.
Zhang Fei sat on the throne with Qi Qingxiu on his lap, hugging her waist. "How about you move all your fellow members to my domain?"
"Hmm?" Qi Qingxiu looked at him in confusion. "Why did you suddenly think of that? Did you do it because you don’t want Qiongqi to bother me all the time?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei admitted it. "I am a possessive man, so I never like it when other men approach all my women, especially if that man has feelings for one of them. Qiongqi clearly wants you to be his wife, and he will do everything he can to get you. Therefore, I want you to bring members of your race to move to my domain, and he will never be able to find you there."

Qi Qingxiu was pleased that Zhang Fei thought of her, and she wrapped her arms around his neck, but she rejected his idea. "You underestimate the four perils too much; do you know that? If I bring members of my race to move to your domain, they will find us there, and we will only bring trouble to the residents there and your sect, so I must refuse your request. Qiongqi is indeed more powerful than me, but he is vulnerable to my abilities, and I can influence his seven emotions easily. Otherwise, I would have long fallen into his hands, and I would have become his wife. Therefore, you don’t need to worry about me, and I will be fine as long as he doesn’t bring his master here."

"Alright, I won’t force you to stay in my domain, but you have to inform me straight away if you encounter any problems in the future." Qi Qingxiu answered Zhang Fei with a serious nod, and he immediately put her down from his lap and stood up. "I will go to some other domains to check on the preparations of my shops now, and I will go to the Heavenly Mistveil Domain after that."
Qi Qingxiu immediately stopped him. "I have nothing to do right now, so I’ll accompany you to that domain, and you can bring some of your wives with us."
"Alright." Zhang Fei gave Qi Qingxiu an artifact that could suppress her demon aura as much as possible, and he took her away from her palace afterwards.

In the Samsara Domain, specifically in the Immortal Soul Palace, Hun Lingwu locked himself in his room, deep in thought. Ever since he woke up four days ago, he hadn’t left his room again, especially after he discovered that he had slept with his male disciple.

Hun Lingwu couldn’t remember everything that happened that day, and he had tried searching for his backup memories in his storage ring. Unfortunately, Feng Yao had destroyed his backup memories, preventing him from recovering his lost memories and leaving him frustrated with his situation.

Hun Lingwu couldn’t remember Zhang Fei or his actions in seeking help from cultivators from the Stygian Dusk Domain. He had already asked his disciple about it, but Hun Tianyu also couldn’t remember anything about the events of that day. "Damn it! What actually happened? Who infiltrated my sect and destroyed my backup memories?"

After several days of not leaving his room, Hun Lingwu decided to leave and went to the Stygian Dusk Domain to seek help. Arriving at the Dusk Pavilion, Hun Lingwu was shocked to find the sect completely destroyed and all its inhabitants gone. He went elsewhere, but he was disappointed because he couldn’t find Xuan Meiyun and her subordinates, especially since she and her subordinates had already moved to the Moonlit Passion Sect.

Hun Lingwu went to meet the other two, but he found both sects already destroyed. He tried to contact Shuang Yuelan and Wang Lei, but he couldn’t contact them. He contacted Zuo Chang’an and asked him to meet him.
Zuo Chang’an soon appeared in front of Hun Lingwu. "Why are you looking for me again? Do you want me to die like Shuang Yuelan and Wang Lei?"
"What?" Hun Lingwu immediately grabbed Zuo Chang’an by the collar. "How did they die? What caused their deaths? Who killed them?"

However, they have long been in deep slumber, like the two primordial beasts, but their numbers are small.
If they continue to roam around, this universe will grow stronger because of them."
"Then, what about the demon races?"
"The primordial demon that you encountered in the past was the first and the last." Feng Yao zoomed in on the image, which showed the room of the demon statues.
"His seven subordinate in the past were also primordial demons, but they were not as powerful as he was, primarily because the power of the primordials is also determined by caste.
As I said before, the new primordial demon will be born in the future, and that person will most likely be the only one."
"Am I really unable to ascend to the primordial rank?" Qi Qingxiu asked dejectedly.
"I don’t want to give you false hope." Qi Qingxiu became increasingly dejected after Feng Yao’s statement, which indicated that she truly had no hope of becoming the primordial demon.
"According to my calculations, there will be a few primordials that will appear in the future, and one of them will be Zhang Fei."
Qi Qingxiu looked at Zhang Fei, but she had no doubt that he would ascend to the primordial rank in the future, especially since he was the next ten-tailed fox.
Zhang Fei hugged Qi Qingxiu’s waist and kissed her lips.
"You don’t need to think too much about it, and I will think of ways to help you reach that rank in the future."
Qi Qingxiu didn’t answer and hugged Zhang Fei, but she was aware that her chances of reaching the primordial rank were very slim, so she didn’t have much hope that he could help her reach that rank.
Zhang Fei sighed inwardly because he wanted to help all his wives reach the highest point in the cultivation world, which meant they had to reach the primordial rank.
"What about the human race?
Will you be the primordial representing them?"
"I don’t have an answer to your question, especially since I don’t know my future." Zhang Fei frowned at that, but Feng Yao pointed her index finger to his chest.
"As for you, you are the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox, so you will be the primordial of the beast race.
However, you must first obtain all of Hun Tianlang’s souls, and you must also obtain the hearts of the two heavenly foxes."
Zhang Fei himself had been thinking about it for a long time, so he was not surprised by Feng Yao’s answer, and he had always hoped to become one.
"Does that mean there won’t be any other beasts that can reach the primordial rank, including Long Wuzhao?"
"Hmm?" Feng Yao supported her chin with her hands and thought deeply.

"The five-clawed golden dragon and the calamity demon dragon of the past were primordial beasts, but they were much weaker than Hu Tianlang, the Primordial Nihility Beast, and the Primordial Genesis Beast.
They both ultimately died at the hands of the latter two, and they have been reincarnated several times.
Long Wuzhao is indeed powerful for a beast living in this era, but I am uncertain whether he can reach the primordial rank, primarily due to the weakening of this universe.
Therefore, it is unlikely for him to reach the primordial rank, and he will forever remain in the immortal rank."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and asked another question.
"What about the other two powerful primordials, especially those from the natural and demihuman races?"
"I can’t yet determine the fate of the natural and demihuman races, so we can only wait for the answer in the future." Feng Yao thought for a moment before continuing.
"However, a new primordial will likely emerge from the winged race in the future, and that person will be one of your wives."
"Xu Ling’er."
"That’s right." Feng Yao nodded at him.
"I can’t say for sure about the process, but I have a hunch that she will become the first primordial of the winged race, and you will help her reach the primordial rank.
By the way, it’s time for you to go to the Heavenly Mistveil Domain to meet the demihumans, and you might get something interesting from them."
Feng Yao dispelled all the qi screens, turned into a crimson flame, and entered Zhang Fei’s body again.
Zhang Fei sat on the throne with Qi Qingxiu on his lap, hugging her waist.
"How about you move all your fellow members to my domain?"
"Hmm?" Qi Qingxiu looked at him in confusion.
"Why did you suddenly think of that?
Did you do it because you don’t want Qiongqi to bother me all the time?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei admitted it.
"I am a possessive man, so I never like it when other men approach all my women, especially if that man has feelings for one of them.
Qiongqi clearly wants you to be his wife, and he will do everything he can to get you.
Therefore, I want you to bring members of your race to move to my domain, and he will never be able to find you there."
Qi Qingxiu was pleased that Zhang Fei thought of her, and she wrapped her arms around his neck, but she rejected his idea.
"You underestimate the four perils too much; do you know that?
If I bring members of my race to move to your domain, they will find us there, and we will only bring trouble to the residents there and your sect, so I must refuse your request.
Qiongqi is indeed more powerful than me, but he is vulnerable to my abilities, and I can influence his seven emotions easily.
Otherwise, I would have long fallen into his hands, and I would have become his wife.
Therefore, you don’t need to worry about me, and I will be fine as long as he doesn’t bring his master here."

"Alright, I won’t force you to stay in my domain, but you have to inform me straight away if you encounter any problems in the future." Qi Qingxiu answered Zhang Fei with a serious nod, and he immediately put her down from his lap and stood up.
"I will go to some other domains to check on the preparations of my shops now, and I will go to the Heavenly Mistveil Domain after that."
Qi Qingxiu immediately stopped him.
"I have nothing to do right now, so I’ll accompany you to that domain, and you can bring some of your wives with us."
"Alright." Zhang Fei gave Qi Qingxiu an artifact that could suppress her demon aura as much as possible, and he took her away from her palace afterwards.
In the Samsara Domain, specifically in the Immortal Soul Palace, Hun Lingwu locked himself in his room, deep in thought.
Ever since he woke up four days ago, he hadn’t left his room again, especially after he discovered that he had slept with his male disciple.
Hun Lingwu couldn’t remember everything that happened that day, and he had tried searching for his backup memories in his storage ring.
Unfortunately, Feng Yao had destroyed his backup memories, preventing him from recovering his lost memories and leaving him frustrated with his situation.
Hun Lingwu couldn’t remember Zhang Fei or his actions in seeking help from cultivators from the Stygian Dusk Domain.
He had already asked his disciple about it, but Hun Tianyu also couldn’t remember anything about the events of that day.
"Damn it!
What actually happened?
Who infiltrated my sect and destroyed my backup memories?"
After several days of not leaving his room, Hun Lingwu decided to leave and went to the Stygian Dusk Domain to seek help.
Arriving at the Dusk Pavilion, Hun Lingwu was shocked to find the sect completely destroyed and all its inhabitants gone.
He went elsewhere, but he was disappointed because he couldn’t find Xuan Meiyun and her subordinates, especially since she and her subordinates had already moved to the Moonlit Passion Sect.
Hun Lingwu went to meet the other two, but he found both sects already destroyed.
He tried to contact Shuang Yuelan and Wang Lei, but he couldn’t contact them.
He contacted Zuo Chang’an and asked him to meet him.
Zuo Chang’an soon appeared in front of Hun Lingwu.
"Why are you looking for me again?
Do you want me to die like Shuang Yuelan and Wang Lei?"
"What?" Hun Lingwu immediately grabbed Zuo Chang’an by the collar.
"How did they die?
What caused their deaths?
Who killed them?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1443: Heavenly Mistveil Domain
paragraphs: Zuo Chang’an was confused by Hun Lingwu’s attitude, but he quickly recounted everything to the old man. "If my guess is correct, Zhang Fei killed Shuang Yuelan and Wang Lei because they accepted your request to capture him. Fortunately, I did not accept your request at that time; otherwise, I would have died like Shuang Yuelan and Wang Lei."
Hun Lingwu said nothing, and he fell into deep thought, mulling over Zuo Chang’an’s words just now.
Zuo Chang’an chose not to disturb Hun Lingwu and quickly disappeared from his sight, mainly because he was afraid the old man would kill him if he stayed there for too long.

Hun Lingwu was frustrated because he couldn’t remember all the events of that day, and he couldn’t restore his lost memories because his backup memories had been destroyed by Feng Yao. He thought about going to the Moonlit Passion Temple, but he was worried that he would die if he forced himself to go there to look for Zhang Fei.

Hun Lingwu’s cultivation had indeed reached the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, but Qing Qiu’er had also reached that stage, and he had no information whatsoever about her abilities. He was certain that Zhang Fei had a protector who was stronger than him, and that person helped him infiltrate his sect to destroy his backup memories.

Since he didn’t have the latest information about the Moonlit Passion Temple due to his lost memories, Hun Lingwu decided to leave the Stygian Dusk Domain and return to the Immortal Soul Palace in the Samsara Domain, thinking about the best way to deal with Zhang Fei and Qing Qiu’er. He was confident in facing the two of them with his current cultivation, but he wanted to confirm whether there were any powerful cultivators behind them before he decided to fight them.

Upon Hun Lingwu’s arrival at the sect, he returned to his room and sealed it with several defensive formations, mainly because he was still traumatized by the incident that happened to him four days ago. In his room, he devised several plans to deal with Zhang Fei and Qing Qiu’er, and he considered enlisting the help of other cultivators who hated the Moonlit Passion Temple.
[Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Heavenly Mistveil Domain, and the host can access it through the gate in the future.]
Zhang Fei and Qi Qingxiu had just arrived at the Heavenly Mistveil Domain, but they weren’t the only ones there. They were accompanied by several other women, such as Zhang Chen, Hu Yue, and Hu Lili.

Zhang Fei wanted to bring Tianshi Shengjie and Luo Yunxiao with him, but they were in closed-door seclusion. The other women didn’t want to go to that domain because they were afraid of bringing trouble to him, and they preferred to focus on their cultivation.

Although Zhang Fei was rarely with them at their residence in the Moonlit Passion Temple, they had no problem continuing their cultivation. He had left plenty of Yang Qi for each of them to cultivate, and they could use it while he was away. As for cultivating their souls, they could do it with his clones living in the sect, and they had no problem doing that as long as they didn’t have sex with his clones.

When they arrived at the outskirts of the Heavenly Mistveil Domain, Zhang Fei used his body modification ability on Qi Qingxiu because she was a demon god, and demihumans hated demons so much, just like humans.

Zhang Chen, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue were basically female beasts, so Zhang Fei didn’t need to disguise their appearances. They simply used their humanoid forms to blend in with the demihumans, as they had no problem with beast races.

"Haha." Zhang Chen laughed when she saw Zhang Fei transform Qi Qingxiu into a half-fox woman, similar to Hu Lili and Hu Yue. "When I see you like this, I think you’re more beautiful and sexier than when you were in your demon form, Qingxiu."
Hu Yue nodded in agreement with her. "Sister Qingxiu, you are really no different from female foxes like me and my mother, and your aura is also similar to a fox beast."

"That’s true." Hu Lili agreed with her daughter as she observed Qi Qingxiu. "Our husband’s body modification skills are truly extraordinary; not only can he transform you into a half-fox like us, but he can also disguise your demon aura perfectly."

Qi Qingxiu was still uncomfortable hearing Zhang Chen call her by her name directly, but she was Zhang Fei’s wife now, which meant she was her senior since she was his grandmother. She still had to adjust to her current situation, primarily because her husband had many wives, some of whom were related to him by blood. "Do I look beautiful in this form, Grandma Chen?"
"That’s true." Zhang Chen took Qi Qingxiu’s hand. "You are truly beautiful in this form, and Fei’er is truly lucky that a powerful demon god like you is willing to become his wife."
Qi Qingxiu smiled and turned to Zhang Fei. "You seem eager to devour me while I am in this form."
"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed and kissed her lips. "Whatever form you are in, I can’t wait to eat you, and I’m even more eager to eat you when you’re in half-fox form like this."

Qi Qingxiu shook her head while holding her forehead. "You have too many wives by your side, so I can’t monopolize you all to myself. You have to accompany your other wives, or they will be angry with me later."
"How about you join us, Sister Qingxiu?" Hu Yue asked her. "Our husband has already planned to take us into seclusion again, and you’re his wife now, so I thought you’d like to join us."

"Our husband has never brought you into the training space before, right?" Hu Lili also asked her. "You can train in the training space while you wait for your turn, and the heavy gravity there can increase your speed severalfold. With your current cultivation level, I’m sure you can already train to level eight or nine, since Sister Yunxiao and Sister Wangzi can already train to level seven with their current cultivation, and your cultivation is one major level above theirs."
Qi Qingxiu turned to Zhang Fei because he had never told her anything about his training space, so she was shocked to hear Hu Lili’s explanation about it. "Do you really have a place like that?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei explained a few things to her about his training space, pavilion, and several others. "Actually, I’ve been wanting to take you there ever since we left the Ashen Lotus Monastery, but you were still worried about Qiongqi, so I decided to postpone taking you there."
Qi Qingxiu nodded in understanding. "No wonder you and all your wives are so fast, and I can’t catch up with you guys at my current speed because your speed has far surpassed me."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "They have perfectly adapted to level six gravity with their current cultivation, resulting in a gravitational force that is sixty-four times heavier than that of this Paradise Realm. As for me, I’ve long since perfectly adapted to level seven gravity because I learned many body techniques, so my speed is already too fast for cultivators in this realm. In fact, I should be able to adapt to level eight if I borrow the power of all the evil beasts to increase my strength, but I’m in no rush to do so because all the cultivators here are already unable to catch up to me, including you demon gods."
"What about level nine or ten?"

"Let alone me, even a demon god like you wouldn’t be able to survive under the pressure of level nine or ten gravity. Therefore, I won’t be foolish enough to try training at those two levels, and I’ll try after I become a ten-tailed fox in the future." Zhang Fei enveloped the four women with his aura. ’Have you found the location of their main city, Mei?’
[Master, their main city is right in the middle of this domain, but it seems like it won’t be easy for you to enter there even if you’re in your half-fox form.]

Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow after hearing that, but he decided to head to the city first. After he confirmed the location of the city, he used his Nine Cloud Steps directly to bring the four women there.

Within seconds, Zhang Fei brought the four women to a land quite far from the city, which made Qi Qingxiu stare at him dumbfounded. She was a powerful demon god, and her cultivation was much higher than his, but she wouldn’t be able to move that fast with her current cultivation.
Zhang Chen, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue laughed in amusement when they saw Qi Qingxiu dumbfounded like that.

Zhang Fei was amused by her expression. "Why are you looking at me like that? My Nine Cloud Steps is extraordinary, and I’ve already mastered it to the eighth level, which allows me to move nearly 4,000 miles in a single step. This city is far from the portal, but the distance is too short for me, especially after I perfectly adapted to level seven gravity."
"I’m speechless." Qi Qingxiu sighed softly. "After we return from this domain, I’ll go straight back to my domain to prepare something, and I want to train in your training space after that."

chapters.title: Chapter 1444: Demhuman Kingdom
paragraphs: Zhang Fei led the four women into the city, but two guards stopped them as per the rules. However, they froze when Qi Qingxiu glanced at them because her cultivation was at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm, which was too powerful for guards like them.
’Shit! This fox woman’s strength is on par with our emperor and empress.’ One of the guards, who had a tiger-like body but stood on two legs, cursed in his heart.

The other male guard with a body like a white leopard was terrified of Qi Qingxiu, and his body couldn’t stop trembling with fear. ’Ugh! What bad luck! Why does a fox woman as strong as her have to come here when it’s our turn on guard duty today?’

Zhang Chen, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue noticed the two guards’ reactions towards Qi Qingxiu, but their fearful reactions made the three women feel relieved because they shouldn’t have any trouble in that domain.

Zhang Fei smiled faintly, hugged Qi Qingxiu’s waist, and then turned to ask the two guards a question. "What do we have to do to enter this city? To be honest, we’re not demihumans like you, and we come from the beast races, so we don’t know the rules in this domain because this is our first time here."
"Sir, you have to pay to enter this city: one hundred purple jewels for one person."

Fortunately, Zhang Fei had already opened a shop in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, and he got many jewels from customers, unlike when he first ascended to the Paradise Realm. Moreover, his shop has been running for several years now, and he has focused on seclusion with all his partners in the last six or so years. He never bought anything unusual either, so his jewel stash has grown significantly.

As for alchemy, Zhang Fei only needed to purchase a single stalk of all kinds of herbs; Janette and Lillea could multiply them with their Dryad abilities to plant in the Sealed World Pearl. He also had Shi Wu by his side, and she possessed the wood element to nourish all the herbs inside, ensuring an abundant supply.

Zhang Fei took out five hundred purple jewels and handed them to one of the guards, who exchanged them for five special identification tags. After he obtained them, he immediately led the four women into the city, causing the two guards to sigh in relief and pat their chests.
The tiger demihuman spoke to his friend. "That fox woman is truly powerful, and her strength is comparable to our two leaders."

"Yes." The leopard demihuman wiped the sweat from his forehead. "I’m really curious about their reason for coming to our domain. Since the five of them are beasts, they should have gone to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, but they came here instead."

"We better not be too curious about them or that fox woman will eat us alive." The leopard demihuman shivered in fear after the tiger demihuman said that. "I will go to meet our two leaders now to report their arrival to our city, and they can check on those five people."
"Yes."

Zhang Fei naturally listened to the two gatekeepers’ conversation, but he didn’t bother with the tiger demihuman’s decision to report to their two leaders. He hoped they would come to them on their own, as he and Qi Qingxiu could take care of them, so he wouldn’t have to bother looking for them.

Zhang Fei ignored them and led the five women on a stroll through the city, searching for items that might be useful to them, especially herbs for alchemy. Despite this, Qi Qingxiu increased her guard, and she enveloped the other three women with her aura so she could protect them if there was a change in the situation.

The tiger demihuman arrived at the palace located north of the city and immediately ran inside to meet his two leaders. Unlike other races, the demihuman population was not that large, and their numbers were far outnumbered by the demon race, let alone the other three races, especially the human race.
The tiger demihuman went to the throne room to meet his two leaders after the palace gatekeeper informed him that they were there, meeting with the high-ranking members of their race.

The tiger demihuman did not immediately enter the throne room, especially after he heard quite a large commotion from inside. He heard the two leaders, especially the empress, shouting loudly and angrily at everyone present at the meeting.

Ten minutes later, the tiger demihuman saw the door to the throne room open from the inside. All the higher-ups of the demihuman race rushed out, their faces filled with fear and their bodies drenched in sweat.

The tiger demihuman immediately ignored them, and he walked into the throne room before kneeling in front of the two thrones, reporting the arrival of Zhang Fei and the five women. "Emperor and Empress, four of them are from the fox race, but I can’t recognize their fox race. One other woman seems to be from the dragon race, and she seems to be a light dragon."

The two people were shocked after they heard about Zhang Chen, but they were also curious about Zhang Fei and the other three women because the fox race was rarely seen in the Paradise Realm, and no one knew their location because the Illusion Spirit Fox Domain had long disappeared from their realm.

From his appearance, the emperor of the demihuman race was clearly a mixed descendant of a human and a fire dragon, and he was much larger when compared to human men. His body closely resembles that of a fire dragon; his head has the features of a dragon, including sharp teeth in his mouth. His muscular hands resembled dragon claws, as did his feet. He possessed two large wings folded neatly behind his back and a dragon tail continuously swayed at his hips.

Meanwhile, the empress of the demihuman race had a mixed appearance between human and bird, but it was unclear what type of bird bloodline she had, and she had a tall and large body when compared to human females. Her head resembled that of a crow, but it also had features similar to a phoenix, and her hands were like human hands covered in fine feathers, while her legs were more akin to bird feet. Her appearance was alluring in her royal gown, which featured low cleavage that exposed a small area of her skin.
"What do you think those five beasts are here for, husband?" the empress asked.

"I can’t be sure because I haven’t seen any fox race members in a long time." The emperor descended from his throne and walked to the window, followed by the empress. They used their senses to search for Zhang Fei and the four women in their city, and they found the five of them inside an alchemist’s shop, but they felt afraid when Qi Qingxiu looked in their direction. "That fox woman has the same cultivation as us, but I feel that she is several times stronger than us."

The empress nodded in agreement and immediately focused her attention on Zhang Fei.
