chapters.title: Chapter 1445: Invitation
paragraphs: Zhang Fei accompanied Zhang Chen to look around the alchemy shops in the kingdom, and he bought many herb seeds for alchemy that were not yet available in the Sealed World Pearl.
Basically, all domains in the Paradise Realm sold herbs for alchemy, and while most types were similar, Zhang Fei discovered that several types of herbs differed in the demihuman kingdom.

Zhang Fei bought typical goods from the demihuman kingdom, especially women’s clothes. He asked Zhang Chen to try one, and he liked the way his grandmother looked in it, which showed off her sexy body.

Zhang Chen was uncomfortable wearing clothes from the demihuman kingdom because they were quite revealing, and her clothes were not suitable for a woman of her age because she thought that she was too old. However, she was too young compared to the cultivators in the Paradise Realm, and all her granddaughters-in-law were much older than her.

Zhang Fei hugged Zhang Chen and kissed her in front of the eyes of many demihumans, who looked at them with strange looks. After all, he was a fox beast, while his grandmother was a dragon beast, making their relationship seem unusual to them. "You look beautiful and sexy in this outfit, so you don’t need to mind their stares, okay?"

"Haha." Zhang Chen laughed softly and hugged her grandson’s arm. "If I’m paying attention, they don’t mind my clothes, but they find our relationship strange. You’re a fox and I’m a dragon, so they find our relationship strange."

Zhang Fei looked at the demihumans, but they hurriedly averted their gazes because the pressure from his body was too strong, making them realize that he was a mythical fox beast. "I think you’re right, Grandma. They—"

"Fei’er, please don’t address me as your grandma when we’re in public, or people will feel even more strange about our relationship." Zhang Chen stole a glance at the demihumans. "You should address me as Chen’er when we are in public, especially since I am your wife."
"Alright."
"Are the three women doing well in this kingdom?"

Zhang Fei searched for Qi Qingxiu, Hu Yue, and Hu Lili using his senses. He found them enjoying delicacies from the demihuman kingdom, including the female demon god. "They are enjoying themselves in this kingdom, including Qingxiu. You don’t need to worry about them because the people of this kingdom aren’t that strong, and only a few of them have reached the Celestial Venerable Realm, including their Emperor and Empress. Qingxiu is stronger than them, and her ability to control the seven emotions of living beings is extraordinary. Yue and Lili’s speed is faster than these people, and they won’t be able to catch them."
"I see." Zhang Chen nodded in understanding, but she suddenly saw a group walking towards them. "Who are they, Fei’er?"
Zhang Fei hugged Zhang Chen’s waist tightly. "They are officials from this kingdom, and their emperor ordered them to meet us."

Soon, the group of people arrived before them, and the male lion demihuman spoke to Zhang Fei. "Sir, my name is Wu Shizi, and my emperor has ordered me to invite you and your four wives to a banquet at the palace."

The demihumans around them gasped in shock upon hearing Wu Shizi’s words. They couldn’t believe what they were hearing; their emperor never invited guests who visited their kingdom, yet he had invited Zhang Fei and his wives to the palace for a banquet and had even sent his close attendant to invite them personally.
Zhang Fei nodded at him. "Please tell your emperor, we will go straight to the palace to meet him after my three wives have had fun in this kingdom."

"Yes, sir." Wu Shizi didn’t say anything else and hurriedly led his men away, leaving the demihumans confused by his behavior. They knew that he was very arrogant, but they did not expect that he would behave like a tame lion in front of Zhang Fei.
The demihumans turned their attention to Zhang Fei, but he ignored their stares and took Zhang Chen for a walk again to look at other items, which might pique their interest.

An hour later, Zhang Fei and his four wives were already in front of the palace, but Hu Yue and Hu Lili seemed surprised by Zhang Chen’s appearance. Even though her clothes were quite revealing, she looked prettier, younger, and sexier.
"Hehe." Zhang Fei chuckled at the reactions of the two fox women. "Do you three want to try wearing traditional clothing from this kingdom?"
"No." Qi Qingxiu immediately refused as she looked at Zhang Chen. "Traditional clothing from this kingdom is sexy, but it’s not my style, so I won’t wear it."
"What about you two?" Zhang Fei asked the fox mother and daughter.

Hu Lili and Hu Yue exchanged glances for a moment before nodding to their husband, but they were confused about changing clothes since they were in a public place. Zhang Fei immediately pulled the two fox women away with him. "Qingxiu, you can take Chen’er to meet the emperor and the empress of this kingdom first, and I’ll follow you there after they’ve changed clothes."
"Are we really going in with just the two of us, Qingxiu?"

"Grandma, you don’t need to worry about these demihumans, and you’ll be safe with me." Thereafter, Qi Qingxiu led Zhang Chen into the royal palace, and a guard escorted the two women to meet the emperor and the empress.
Sometime later, Qi Qingxiu and Zhang Chen arrived in front of the throne room, and the guard asked them to enter before leaving.
Qi Qingxiu enveloped Zhang Chen in her aura, took her hand, and led her into the throne room.
Inside the throne room, the emperor and the empress were waiting for Qi Qingxiu and Zhang Chen, but they did not sit on their thrones out of respect for the two women.
The emperor cupped his hands at them. "My name is Long Huoyan, and my wife is Huo Jinying."
"Please forgive us for inviting you all of a sudden." Huo Jinying said politely.

Qi Qingxiu also cupped her hands. "My name is Zhang Qingxiu, and the woman next to me is my sister, Zhang Chen. Our husband is accompanying his other two wives to change clothes, and they will be here soon."
"Thank you for your invitation." Zhang Chen spoke briefly.
Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying. "Please follow us to the dining room, and we’ll chat there while enjoying our royal specialties."
"Alright." Qi Qingxiu and Zhang Chen immediately followed them into the dining room.
Long Huoyan led in front of them, but Huo Jinying walked beside the two women. "If I may ask, where do you all come from?"

"We come from the Twin Flames Main Domain." Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying immediately turned to Qi Qingxiu in surprise because they knew that the domain was a human domain, and all the sects there were dual cultivation sects. "We are actually members of the Moonlit Passion Temple, and our husband is one of the leaders of that sect. In fact, their sect master and vice sect master, Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling, are also his wives."

Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying were even more shocked to hear that Zhang Fei had taken Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling as his wives, especially since both of them were human women. They knew that both women were powerful cultivators in the Paradise Realm because they had met each other in the past, and the former had the same cultivation as them.

Qi Qingxiu spoke to them again. "Even though our husband is a fox beast, he is different from people of all races, and he never cares about racial differences. Whether they are humans, demihumans, beasts, natural races, or demons, they are all the same in his eyes. In fact, he has many wives from all races, including those from the natural and demon races."

"What?" Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying were not too surprised that Zhang Fei had a human wife, but they were shocked to hear that he had wives from the natural and demon races too, especially the latter. "Why—"

"All races are actually the same, okay?" Qi Qingxiu interrupted Long Huoyan. "Whether they are humans, demihumans, beasts, natural races, or demons, they have good and bad people, and some of them are even more evil than demons. You may not have heard of this matter, but the former Fairy King was extremely evil, and he killed his predecessor to gain power over their race."
Long Huoyan sighed softly and nodded to her. "Actually, I’ve heard about Jia Zizhen’s evil past deeds, but he has been deposed and his successor is Jia Leixua."
"That’s right." Qi Qingxiu nodded slightly. "Actually, our husband defeated Jia Zizhen because he was targeting one of my sisters, who is the granddaughter of Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu."

Once again, Qi Qingxiu’s words shocked Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying. As the emperor and empress of the demihuman races, they had heard of Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu, and they knew that both of them were close confidants of the Fairy King before Jia Zizhen.
Long Huoyan took a deep breath. "Is it true that Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu’s granddaughter are your husband’s wives?"

"Do I need to lie to you?" Qi Qingxiu then contacted Zhang Fei and asked him to bring Jia Yuyan to the demihuman kingdom. "Our husband will bring their granddaughter with him, and you two can meet her later."

chapters.title: Chapter 1446: Banquet
paragraphs: When they arrived at the dining room, Zhang Chen and Qi Qingxiu saw two young male demihumans and three female demihumans already sitting around the dining table.

Three of them had a mix of Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying’s characteristics, indicating they were their children. The other two had different characteristics, and they were sitting next to their partners.

The five young demihumans looked at both women for a moment before turning their gazes because they felt a strong pressure on their bloodline coming from Zhang Chen, which meant the dragon bloodline in her body was stronger than theirs.

Long Huoyan led Zhang Chen and Qi Qingxiu to sit with them, and Huo Jinying introduced the five young demihumans to the two. "Seated on the left are our first son and his wife, Long Lingxun and Guang Lianyu. Seated on the right are our first daughter and her husband, Long Feiyue and Yao Qianmo. Seated at the end is our second daughter, Long Xiaolian."
"They are Zhang Qingxiu of the fox race and Zhang Chen of the light dragon race." Long Huoyan spoke to his three children and two children-in-law.
"Welcome to our kingdom." The five young demihumans greeted them.
Qi Qingxiu and Zhang Chen nodded and replied to them. "Thank you for your welcome."

The five young demihumans wondered about the identities of their other guests because their parents had said they invited five people, but only two had arrived. However, they didn’t have to wait long for their answer, as a guard walked in, followed by Zhang Fei and three other women.

The five young demihumans were surprised to see the three women being so intimate with Zhang Fei, which meant he was their husband. Unlike them, Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying were more shocked by Jia Yuyan’s presence with them because she was not previously in their group, but she had arrived with the others.

Zhang Fei casually walked towards Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying, cupping his hands in greeting. "My name is Zhang Fei, and the three women beside me are also my wives like Zhang Qingxiu and Zhang Chen. They are Hul Lili and Hu Yue from the moon fox race, and Jia Yuyan is from the fairy race, who is also the granddaughter of Jia Shengyun and Jia Lingzhu."
Hu Lili, Hu Yue, and Jia Yuyan followed their husbands by cupping their hands to Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying while greeting them.

Long Huoyan, Huo Jinying, and their five children had never heard of the moon fox race before because they did not exist in the Paradise Realm, so they were curious about Hu Lili and Hu Yue. Moreover, the two fox women had such similar appearances, and they guessed that they were mother and daughter.

Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying shifted their gazes to Jia Yuyan, but they did not recognize her because Jia Zizhen sent her to the Three Mortal Realms to look for Zhang Fei in the past, and the time flow difference between the two realms was very long.

"Thank you." Zhang Fei and the three women immediately sat in the same row as Qi Qingxiu and Zhang Chen.

"Yes." Zhang Fei pointed to Zhang Chen, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue. "They also come from the Three Mortal Realms, and I brought them to this realm a little over six years ago. "I’ve never minded establishing relationships with all races, including the demon race. Likewise, with other races, I will befriend anyone with good intentions, and I will kill anyone with evil intentions, especially if they harbor evil intentions towards all my wives."

Long Lingxun’s face darkened seeing his sister and brother-in-law like that, and he left the dining room because he would rather not gather with people like them.
Zhang Fei couldn’t care less about Long Lingxun because there were many people like him in all races, but he was also wary of him, and he would kill him if he dared to look for trouble with him.
Guang Lianyu sighed softly, and she immediately spoke to her parents-in-law before following her husband, leaving the dining room.
Zhang Fei also raised his glass. "As long as we share the same views, we can be good friends, Brother Yao."
"Hahaha! Good... Good..." Yao Qianmo laughed and drank the drink in his glass, followed by Zhang Fei.

"Don’t worry, I’m not that petty, and I can understand your son’s hatred for the demon races." Zhang Fei casually replied.
Jia Yuyan then asked Long Huoyan. "What’s the problem between your son and the demon races?"

"Sigh." Huo Jinying let out a soft sigh before explaining the situation to them. "Our son had two best friends in the past, and one of them was his first lover. Unfortunately, they died at the hands of the demons while they were traveling to another domain, and he almost died with them that time, so he’s hated them ever since."
"Which demon race is the killer?" Qi Qingxiu asked.

"The Torture Demon Race." Qi Qingxiu nodded to Huo Jinying, and she was not surprised that the demon race members killed demihumans. "Before the demons of that race killed them, they tortured both of them, and—"

"That’s enough, wife." Long Huoyan interrupted his wife as the servants had already begun bringing out the dishes. "Zhang Fei, I hope you’ll be willing to stay in my kingdom for the night, so we can have a lot to talk about after this banquet."
Zhang Fei nodded at him. "I don’t have any business for the next few days, so it’s fine if we stay here tonight. Moreover, I have something to discuss with you, but we’ll talk about that later."
"Good." After all the dishes were ready, Long Huoyan began the banquet, and all of Zhang Fei’s wives thoroughly enjoyed the specialties of the demihuman kingdom.

During the banquet they also talked about light matters, especially about the Moonlit Passion Temple, and Zhang Fei told them about his decision to change the sect into a universal sect with several different halls, which made Long Huoyan and his family curious about the sect’s changes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1447: Talk Between Women
paragraphs: "Husband."
Long Lingxun, who was standing by the fish pond, immediately turned to his wife. "Why did you follow me here?"

"How can I have fun there if you’re like this?" Guang Lianyu hugged him from behind. "I know you hate demons, but you can’t force your mindset on others. You have your choice, and Zhang Fei also has his own. If he likes demons, that’s his choice, so you shouldn’t act like this just because you disagree with him."
Long Lingxun did not say anything and returned his gaze to the front while clenching both fists tightly, making Guang Lianyu sigh in her heart.
"Husband, you—"
"Leave."

Guang Lianyu frowned because her husband chased her away; she took her arms off him and stared at him for some time. She didn’t say anything to him and turned away, leaving him alone. She understood her husband’s character, so she felt it was pointless to talk to him when his emotions were high, and she would wait for his anger to subside before talking to him again. ’Husband, you must remember that one of Zhang Fei’s women is as powerful as our parents, so you should think twice if you want to cause trouble with him.’

Long Lingxun stood pensively in his spot. "If only I were strong back then, you two wouldn’t have died at the hands of those demons. Anyone with ties to those damn demons is my enemy, and I will destroy them, regardless of who they are. I’m not that strong now, but I will become stronger in the future. When I gain strength, I will slaughter all those demons, and they will rot in the afterlife."
After the banquet was over, Long Huoyan invited Zhang Fei to go with him, and Huo Jinying went with Qi Qingxiu.
Long Xiaolian led Jia Yuyan, Zhang Chen, Hu Lili, and Hu Yue to the guest rooms.

Jia Yuyan looked at Long Xiaolian, and she felt that her appearance resembled a mix of a fire dragon and a phoenix. Her face wasn’t dragon-like, and she looked more like a woman in general. Her body was covered in red dragon scales and some bird feathers, and she also had a red dragon tail behind her hips.
"Does your husband have many wives?" Long Xiaolian suddenly asked.
"Our husband has over a hundred wives." Long Xiaolian looked at Zhang Chen in shock, especially since she had never met a man with so many wives.

Jia Yuyan immediately spoke to her. "His lust is too high, Xiaolian. Even with our large numbers, we never last long with him, and we’re always overwhelmed serving him. Although we don’t like sharing our husband with so many women, we love him with all our hearts, so we prefer him having many wives over being constantly exhausted."

"Is he really that strong?" Long Xiaolian curiously asked. "I don’t know about the beast fox, but my father has the fire dragon bloodline in his body. However, he doesn’t have as many wives as your husband, and he only has two wives."
"Two wives?"

"Yes." Long Xiaolian nodded at her. "Big Brother Lingxun and Big Sis Feiyue are my father’s children with the empress, and I am the daughter of his second wife. However, my mother doesn’t like attending royal events, and she prefers to focus on her cultivation, so she didn’t join in the banquet earlier."

The four women nodded in understanding, and Hu Yue answered Long Xiaolian’s previous question. "Our husband has been strong since his cultivation was at the elementary realm, and he becomes even stronger with each increase in his cultivation. Moreover, he has mastered eight body techniques, which makes him even stronger."

"Eh?" Long Xiaolian was shocked because a cultivator usually only mastered one body technique, and it was already difficult for them to increase the level of their technique. However, Zhang Fei learned eight body techniques at once, and she couldn’t imagine the strength of his body because of it. "How did your husband manage to learn eight body techniques at once? Didn’t he have difficulty increasing the levels of his techniques?"

Hu Lili shook her head and explained. "In fact, some of his body techniques have already reached the highest level, so he only needs to learn the rest. Once the rest reach the highest level, I’m sure he will seek other body techniques in the future, which will make his body even stronger, far stronger than other cultivators."

"If he continues to learn many body techniques, doesn’t that mean that all of you won’t be strong enough to serve him in the future?" Zhang Chen and the others could only sigh and shake their heads at Long Xiaolian because they didn’t have the answer to that yet, and they could only find out in the future after Zhang Fei learned the other body techniques. "Does that mean you guys will allow him to add other wives in the future?"
"Maybe." Jia Yuyan then asked her. "What about you, Xiaolian? You’re already hundreds of thousands of years old, but you still haven’t found your husband."

"Haha." Long Xiaolian softly laughed in response to her question. "With my cultivation at the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, I can live for several tens of thousands of years, so I’m not in too much of a rush to find my husband. Moreover, the members of our race are different from other races, especially the human race. We have beast bloodlines in our bodies, and our cultivation is slow because of it. Human cultivators at my age have already reached a higher level, for example, Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling."

Jia Yuyan nodded in agreement. "Even though the demihuman race is not as strong as the beast race, they are stronger than the human race. Unfortunately, your mixed bloodline resulted in a fatal flaw, which made your cultivation slow."

"I can’t do anything about it, can I?" Long Xiaolian released a soft sigh. "If I could choose, I would prefer to be born as a member of the beast race or the human race. This has become my path, so I am grateful for it, and I just need to try harder to become stronger. By the way, is the Moonlit Passion Temple really no longer a dual cultivation sect and a universal sect now?"

"That’s true." Jia Yuyan touched Long Xiaolian’s forehead and shared images of the current situation at the Moonlit Passion Temple. "You can see for yourself, and many races have gathered in our sect now, except for the demihuman race."

Long Xiaolian stopped walking, closed her eyes, and looked at those memories. She was shocked when they saw several mythical beast races there, such as the Phoenix Race, Dragon Race, and several others. Usually, the beast races who ascended from the Three Mortal Realms would join the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain under Long Wuzhao’s leadership, but they joined the Moonlit Passion Temple instead.

Long Xiaolian saw many natural races in the sect, but she was not surprised by their presence in the Moonlit Passion Temple because Jia Yuyan was Zhang Fei’s wife. She was truly surprised to see that all the races lived in harmony there, and the other races did not hate the demon races who lived with them.

Long Xiaolian recognized the races of the demons, and they came from five different races, such as the Celestial Demon Race, the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, the Eternal Night Demon Race, and the Seven Emotions Demon Race.

Long Xiaolan was shocked to see the Winged Race members at the Moonlit Passion Temple, especially the presence of demons. Since ancient times, the Winged Race and the Demon Race had been enemies, yet they gathered within the same sect as if nothing had happened.
After all the memories ended, Long Xiaolan opened her eyes and asked them, "Who gathered the Winged Race and Demon Race in that sect? Was it Zhang Fei who brought them there?"
"Yes." Jia Yuyan nodded at her. "Our husband has connections with some of those demon races, and he is the husband of the two princesses of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race."

"Huh?" Long Xiaolan was shocked once again. "Did your husband really marry the two princesses of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race? If I remember correctly, their names are Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Yushu, right? Moreover, I’ve heard that the latter is dead, and outsiders never knew the cause."

"You are right; they are indeed the two princesses of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race." Jia Yuyan told her something else. "Tian Qiye killed Nalan Yushu and imprisoned her soul in the Star Tower, and our husband met her soul in there long ago. He freed her from the tower and helped her reshape her body, so she is his wife now. As for Nalan Wangzi, she recently became his wife, so he has a close relationship with that demon race."
Long Xiaolan led them on their way. "What about those winged races?"

"Those three winged races are our husband’s wives, and they met in the Three Mortal Realms. They are different from the winged races in this realm, and they don’t hate demon races." Long Xiaolan nodded understandingly to Jia Yuyan, who explained a few other things to her. "Would you like to visit our sect? That way, you can see for yourself the harmony of all the races in our sect, and you’ll surely be truly surprised by their relationships with one another."
"I’m curious about your sect, but I have to ask my parents’ permission first to visit it."

After all the memories ended, Long Xiaolan opened her eyes and asked them, "Who gathered the Winged Race and Demon Race in that sect?
Was it Zhang Fei who brought them there?"
"Yes." Jia Yuyan nodded at her.
"Our husband has connections with some of those demon races, and he is the husband of the two princesses of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race."
"Huh?" Long Xiaolan was shocked once again.
"Did your husband really marry the two princesses of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race?
If I remember correctly, their names are Nalan Wangzi and Nalan Yushu, right?
Moreover, I’ve heard that the latter is dead, and outsiders never knew the cause."
"You are right; they are indeed the two princesses of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race." Jia Yuyan told her something else.
"Tian Qiye killed Nalan Yushu and imprisoned her soul in the Star Tower, and our husband met her soul in there long ago.
He freed her from the tower and helped her reshape her body, so she is his wife now.
As for Nalan Wangzi, she recently became his wife, so he has a close relationship with that demon race."
Long Xiaolan led them on their way.
"What about those winged races?"
"Those three winged races are our husband’s wives, and they met in the Three Mortal Realms.
They are different from the winged races in this realm, and they don’t hate demon races." Long Xiaolan nodded understandingly to Jia Yuyan, who explained a few other things to her.
"Would you like to visit our sect?
That way, you can see for yourself the harmony of all the races in our sect, and you’ll surely be truly surprised by their relationships with one another."
"I’m curious about your sect, but I have to ask my parents’ permission first to visit it."

chapters.title: Chapter 1448: Zhang Fei - Long Huoyan
paragraphs: "What exactly is your true identity?"
"Hmm?" Qi Qingxiu tilted her head at Huo Jinying.

"Even though you’re wearing a disguise, I know that you’re a female demon." Qi Qingxiu was surprised by that, but Huo Jinying suddenly turned fiery golden. "I have phoenix and golden crow bloodlines in my body, and my eye abilities are quite unique. Although I can’t recognize your demon identity, I can see your demon aura, so I’m certain that you are a demon."

"Haha." Qi Qingxiu laughed at that. "I didn’t expect you to have such amazing eye abilities, and you could still see my demon aura. I can’t undo my disguise because my husband turned me into this, but you’re right that I am indeed a female demon. My true name is Qi Qingxiu, and I—"
"The Seven Emotions Demon God." Huo Jinying said quietly as she looked at her.
Qi Qingxiu nodded casually. "I am indeed the Seven Emotions Demon God, and Zhang Fei is truly my husband."

"I see." Huo Jinying took a deep breath after hearing that. "Why would a demon god like you be interested in a weak cultivator like your husband? He’s not a demon like you, but a beast fox, so I find your decision strange."
"If you truly consider my husband a weak cultivator, then you’ve made a fatal mistake." Qi Qingxiu smirked at her. "Do you think a demon god like me would choose a weak cultivator as my husband?"
"No." Huo Jinying responded by shaking her head. "Then?"

Qi Qingxiu looked up at the night sky with her hands crossed behind her hips. "Believe it or not, my demon abilities have no effect on my husband, and he can defeat me easily. If he wants, he can defeat you and your husband easily because you are both weaker than me, even though our cultivation is equal."

Huo Jinying didn’t deny Qi Qingxu’s words because she had already realized from the start that she and her husband were still weaker than a demon god like her, even though their cultivation was at the same level, the Three-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm.

"My husband has enough strength to defeat you and your husband, and you two can’t do anything against him. He will not do anything as long as you two do not become his enemies, and he wants to build beneficial relationships with all existing races without exception." Huo Jinying looked at her questioningly, but Qi Qingxiu suddenly touched her forehead and imparted a lot of information into her mind. "See everything for yourself."

Huo Jinying hurriedly closed her eyes and looked at all the images that appeared in her memories, and she was truly shocked to see the situation in the Moonlit Passion Temple, especially the presence of all the races there, except the demihuman race.
Soon, Huo Jinying opened her eyes. "How did your husband gather all the races in his sect?"

"The majority of them are his friends from the Three Mortal Realms, and some of them are cultivators from this realm. Nalan Shizhe, the Soul-Devouring Demon God, is his mother-in-law because his two daughters are also his wife." Huo Jinying was once again shocked by Qi Qingxiu’s words about Zhang Fei’s relationship. "Just like me, Ye Mingran wants peace for our demon races, and we believe that my husband can make our wishes come true, so we joined him. Apart from the three of us, Wu Mian, the Faceless Demon God, also decided to join him. As for the Celestial Demon Race, Mo Shentian has not yet decided to join him, but his wife has already joined him. Thus, there are only five demon races left, but they are very difficult to conquer, and they have ambitions to become the rulers of this realm."

Huo Jinying was truly shocked to hear that half of the demon races had joined Zhang Fei, but she also knew that the other five demon races were difficult to conquer, and all of their demon gods had extraordinary powers. "Then, what about the winged race? Have they all joined him?

"No." Qi Qingxiu turned to face her. "Half of the grand elders are already on my husband’s side, but the other half are not. Moreover, Tian Qiye’s cultivation has already broken through to the Celestial God Realm, and they are extremely loyal to her."
"I see." Huo Jinying nodded in understanding and asked again. "What about the natural races and the beast races? Are they already on his side?"

"The beast races have been on his side from the start, mainly because of Long Wuzhao. Moreover, the princess of the Celestial Dragon Race is one of his wives, so they support him even more." Huo Jinying was surprised to hear that from Qi Qingxiu, but she also saw Tianshi Shengjie in her memories, and she lived in the Moonlit Passion Sect. "Among the natural races of this realm, only the Fairy Race has sided with him because he helped them defeat Jia Zizhen, and Jia Shengyun’s granddaughter has long been his wife. As for the rest, he hasn’t met them yet, but I’m sure they will also side with him in the future."
"Is Zhang Fei really going to gather all the races in the Moonlit Passion Temple?"

"Isn’t that obvious?" Qi Qingxiu asked Huo Jinying back with a smile. "For now, the people on his side are only less than the demihuman race, and all races will be in the Moonlit Passion Temple if you decide to join him. I know your race has never had a relationship with any party, and you guys are used to being independent. However, I can tell you it would be beneficial for your race to join him, and we will protect your members if you are on his side."

Huo Jinying let out a soft sigh, folded her arms across her chest, and looked up at the night sky. "We’ve never had a problem with the winged, natural, or beast races. However, we find it difficult to mingle with humans because they consider our race disgusting, especially since we are a mix of human and beast. Regarding the demon races, you must already understand the reason for our difficulties, as you are a demon god, and it will be challenging for both of our races to coexist peacefully in one place."

"I know." Qi Qingxiu nodded at her. "However, the situation in this realm is slowly changing, and you will know the answer if you send your representatives to our sect. If you and your fellow members wish to live in peace, then joining him is your best choice."

After viewing all of Qi Qingxu’s memories, Huo Jinying had no doubts about Zhang Fei’s abilities, as he successfully gathered many different races in the Moonlit Passion Temple, where they all lived together harmoniously. "I can’t decide this right now, and I have to discuss this matter with my husband first."
"I know."
Zhang Fei was walking around in another area, accompanied by Long Huoyan, while discussing various matters, especially his relationship with all the races.
"What exactly is your purpose for coming to our domain?" Long Huoyan asked.

Zhang Fei shook his head in response. "I didn’t know the situation in this domain beforehand, so I don’t have any specific plans or goals here. However, I’ve been looking around the alchemy shops in this city, and I feel that this domain lags behind other domains, especially in alchemy."

"Haish." Long Huoyan hissed after hearing that. "Our domain does have some alchemists, but none of them are as skilled as the alchemists in other domains. As a result, our domain is far behind others in the field of alchemy, and I have no solution to improve it."

Zhang Fei smiled and took out his alchemist badge, making Long Huoyan fall into a daze after finding out that he was an alchemy god. "I don’t have time to train others in alchemy, but some of the people by my side are also alchemist gods like me. If you wish, I can send one of them here, and that person will teach the alchemists in your kingdom."
"What do you want to teach the alchemists of my race?" Long Huoyan asked, but he held back his excitement.

"I don’t want anything complicated." Zhang Fei kept his alchemist badge. "I want to establish good relations with your race, and I want to open an alchemy shop in your kingdom. I don’t have people from the demihuman races by my side, but I have many people from the other races. I will send one of them here to open the shop, and I will also send one of the alchemists by my side here. My alchemist is a female beast, so the members of your race will not mind her, but I need a guarantee of protection for them because their cultivation is still at the Celestial Lord Realm."

Long Huoyan nodded in understanding. "As long as your people are members of the natural and beast races, they won’t have any problems in my kingdom. Moreover, my wife and I will protect them ourselves, so you don’t need to worry about them, and we will guarantee their safety."

"Are you sure you can protect them?" Zhang Fei looked at him. "It’s not that I want to doubt your abilities, but the depths of a living being’s heart are difficult to fathom, and you might not have the heart to take action against those members of your race who harm my people."

chapters.title: Chapter 1449: Obtain A Building
paragraphs: "I understand your worries." Long Huoyan grabbed Zhang Fei’s shoulder. "I promise you that I will protect everyone you send to my kingdom, and I will ensure their safety."

Zhang Fei didn’t answer Long Huoyan and thought things over carefully, but Feng Yao suddenly spoke to him. ’Send Feng Shanxi and a few others to that domain, and I’ll send Huo Xiaoyu there to protect them.’

’Alright.’ Since Feng Yao would send someone to protect his people, Zhang Fei had no qualms about sending them to that domain. "What are the rules for purchasing buildings in your kingdom? Can an outsider like me also buy a building here? Naturally, I have to open my shop here, and I need a building that isn’t too big for that. Once everything is ready, I’ll send some of my people here, and they’ll change the alchemy market in this domain."

Long Huoyan was relieved to hear Zhang Fei’s answer, and he called someone to get the building documents. "Actually, buildings in this kingdom are not for sale, even to my own people. I will give you a building, and it will be completely yours, so you can do whatever you want with it."

’He’s willing to do anything for the good of his race, eh?’ Zhang Fei didn’t refuse Long Huoyan’s offer. "Alright, I’ll accept it, and I’ll take a look tomorrow morning. If I don’t need any renovations, I’ll open my shop in a few days. If I still need minor renovations, I’ll open my shop after everything is done."

"Hahaha." Long Huoyan laughed and created a qi screen, which showed the area inside the building that he would give to Zhang Fei. "I remember all the buildings in my kingdom, and that image is the inside of the building I’m referring to, so you don’t need to go there to check it out."

Zhang Fei looked at the qi screen before nodding. "That building is in excellent condition and ready to be my shop, so I don’t need to do any renovations to fix it. I’ll contact my people now, and I’ll have them come here tomorrow morning. However, I still have one more request, but I don’t know whether you will agree to it or not."
"Tell me."
Zhang Fei created several qi screens and showed all areas of the Moonlit Passion Temple, except for the peak and back areas of the mountain. "See them for yourself."
Long Huoyan nodded and looked at all the qi screens seriously, but his expression changed after he saw demons from several demon races.

Long Huoyan remembered Zhang Fei’s words earlier in the dining hall that he didn’t mind the demon races as long as they didn’t harbor malicious intentions, so he assumed that the demons who joined the Moonlit Passion Temple had passed his selection. Moreover, their numbers weren’t that big in the sect, especially since each demon race only sent two of their representatives there.

Even though he saw them through qi screens, Long Huoyan could recognize the identities of the demons. He knew that they came from the Celestial Demon Race, the Soul-Devouring Demon Race, the Eternal Night Demon Race, and the Seven Emotions Demon Race.

Long Huoyan was shocked when he discovered several women from the Winged Race in the Moonlit Passion Temple, especially since that race hated all demon races much more than his demihuman race. However, he could see that all the women had no problem with the presence of the demons there, and their relationship seemed pretty good.

Long Huoyan saw many beast races there, starting with the phoenix race, the white tiger race, and various other races. Additionally, he also saw many members of the natural races there, starting with the dryad race, the elf race, the fairy race, and various other races. However, he didn’t see a single member of the demihuman race in the Moonlit Passion Temple, and he could guess Zhang Fei’s reason for showing him all those images.
Long Huoyan turned his head to Zhang Fei. "Do you want me to send some representatives of my race to your sect?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei answered matter-of-factly because he needed members from the demihuman race in the Moonlit Passion Temple to complete all the races. "I want to make my sect an ideal place for all races to gather together, and you can see for yourself that my sect doesn’t yet have any members from the demihuman race. That’s why I want you to send at least two people from your race to my sect, but you must choose those who don’t harbor hatred toward any demon race. Honestly, I could bring demihuman race members from the Three Mortal Realms, but none of them interested me, so I didn’t bring them to this realm in the past."

"I see." Long Huoyan thought of a few people to send to the Moonlit Passion Temple, but he doubted that they would accept if he sent them there, especially with the presence of the demons there. "Regarding this matter, I can’t give you an answer now, and I need to discuss it with several people first. Once we’ve reached a decision, I’ll contact you directly, and I’ll bring some people to your sect."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and dispelled the qi screen. "I’m not in a rush with that, so you can discuss it with your people first. However, I hope they will agree to this matter, and I want you to send some people who can get along with all races because I don’t want them to cause chaos there."

After they discussed a few other matters and someone delivered documents from the building, Long Huoyan escorted Zhang Fei to the guest area, and he returned to his private quarters to discuss his proposal with his wife.
"How was your conversation with Long Huoyan?" Qi Qingxiu asked Zhang Fei.

Zhang Chen, Hu Yue, Hu Lili, and Jia Yuyan were also curious, prompting Zhang Fei to explain to them about his conversation with Long Huoyan just now, including his request for him to send some demihuman members to the Moonlit Passion Temple.
After that, Qi Qingxiu explained to Zhang Fei about her conversation with Huo Jinying, including her decision to reveal her true identity as the Seven Emotions Demon God to the empress.

Zhang Fei had no problem with it, mainly because he was confident that he could stand up to the demihuman race if they wanted to trouble him. Moreover, Qi Qingxiu’s abilities could influence those people, so he didn’t need to be afraid to face them.

Jia Yuyan also conveyed some things to Zhang Fei, especially about her wish for Long Xiaolan to join the Moonlit Passion Temple. However, Zhang Fei asked her not to rush, especially since he had to wait for Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying’s decision.

After they finished their discussion, Zhang Fei wrapped five of his nine fox tails around their waists and released his own soul, followed by the five women who also released theirs. "Let’s dual soul cultivate."
"Mother." Long Xiaolian called out softly as she walked into a quite beautiful cave, with a woman sitting cross-legged in the middle.
Just like Long Xiaolian, the woman’s head didn’t look like a beast, and she looked like a human woman in general. Her body was covered in colorful bird feathers, and a bird’s tail was on her hip.
The woman’s name was Si Yingwu, and she was the second wife of Long Huoyan. She opened her eyes and smiled at Long Xiaolan. "Come here and sit with me, Xiaolian."
"Yeah." Leng Xiaolian sat beside her mother and created several qi screens, which showed Zhang Fei and his five wives. She explained their identities to her mother, which surprised Si Yingwu.

Then, Leng Xiaolian changed the pictures on the qi screen according to the memories Jia Yuyan shared with her before, and the existence of several demons in the Moonlit Passion Temple once again shocked Si Yingwu.

Leng Xiaolian explained to her mother their conversation with Zhang Fei in the dining room, and she also shared details about her earlier conversation with the four women. "What do you think about them and their sect, Mother?"

"They’re really rare." Si Yingwu looked at the picture of Zhang Fei and his five women on the qi screen. "I can’t recognize what kind of fox the man and his two wives are, but I feel that he is no ordinary fox. Somehow, I feel there is something else about him, but I can’t confirm it. Zhang Chen belongs to the light dragon race, which is quite rare in this realm. As for Qi Qingxiu, her appearance is just a disguise, but I have never seen such a perfect disguise before, and I can’t guess her true identity. Are you thinking of joining their sect, Xiaolan?"

"Hehe." Long Xiaolian giggled and hugged her mother. "You know me well, Mother. I’m bored of staying in this domain, and I want to explore other domains to broaden my horizon. However, my father would never allow that, mainly because he’s afraid that outsiders will hunt me down and capture me. That’s why I’m thinking of joining that sect, and I might find many new adventures by joining there."

Si Yingwu looked at her daughter and let out a soft sigh. "I’ll talk to your father tomorrow morning and persuade him to let you join the sect. I don’t know if he’ll agree, but you’ll have to take excellent care of yourself if he does."

Long Huoyan saw many beast races there, starting with the phoenix race, the white tiger race, and various other races.
Additionally, he also saw many members of the natural races there, starting with the dryad race, the elf race, the fairy race, and various other races.
However, he didn’t see a single member of the demihuman race in the Moonlit Passion Temple, and he could guess Zhang Fei’s reason for showing him all those images.
Long Huoyan turned his head to Zhang Fei.
"Do you want me to send some representatives of my race to your sect?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei answered matter-of-factly because he needed members from the demihuman race in the Moonlit Passion Temple to complete all the races.
"I want to make my sect an ideal place for all races to gather together, and you can see for yourself that my sect doesn’t yet have any members from the demihuman race.
That’s why I want you to send at least two people from your race to my sect, but you must choose those who don’t harbor hatred toward any demon race.
Honestly, I could bring demihuman race members from the Three Mortal Realms, but none of them interested me, so I didn’t bring them to this realm in the past."
"I see." Long Huoyan thought of a few people to send to the Moonlit Passion Temple, but he doubted that they would accept if he sent them there, especially with the presence of the demons there.
"Regarding this matter, I can’t give you an answer now, and I need to discuss it with several people first.
Once we’ve reached a decision, I’ll contact you directly, and I’ll bring some people to your sect."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and dispelled the qi screen.
"I’m not in a rush with that, so you can discuss it with your people first.
However, I hope they will agree to this matter, and I want you to send some people who can get along with all races because I don’t want them to cause chaos there."

After they discussed a few other matters and someone delivered documents from the building, Long Huoyan escorted Zhang Fei to the guest area, and he returned to his private quarters to discuss his proposal with his wife.
"How was your conversation with Long Huoyan?" Qi Qingxiu asked Zhang Fei.

Zhang Chen, Hu Yue, Hu Lili, and Jia Yuyan were also curious, prompting Zhang Fei to explain to them about his conversation with Long Huoyan just now, including his request for him to send some demihuman members to the Moonlit Passion Temple.
After that, Qi Qingxiu explained to Zhang Fei about her conversation with Huo Jinying, including her decision to reveal her true identity as the Seven Emotions Demon God to the empress.
Zhang Fei had no problem with it, mainly because he was confident that he could stand up to the demihuman race if they wanted to trouble him.
Moreover, Qi Qingxiu’s abilities could influence those people, so he didn’t need to be afraid to face them.
Jia Yuyan also conveyed some things to Zhang Fei, especially about her wish for Long Xiaolan to join the Moonlit Passion Temple.
However, Zhang Fei asked her not to rush, especially since he had to wait for Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying’s decision.
After they finished their discussion, Zhang Fei wrapped five of his nine fox tails around their waists and released his own soul, followed by the five women who also released theirs.
"Let’s dual soul cultivate."
"Mother." Long Xiaolian called out softly as she walked into a quite beautiful cave, with a woman sitting cross-legged in the middle.
Just like Long Xiaolian, the woman’s head didn’t look like a beast, and she looked like a human woman in general.
Her body was covered in colorful bird feathers, and a bird’s tail was on her hip.
The woman’s name was Si Yingwu, and she was the second wife of Long Huoyan.
She opened her eyes and smiled at Long Xiaolan.
"Come here and sit with me, Xiaolian."
"Yeah." Leng Xiaolian sat beside her mother and created several qi screens, which showed Zhang Fei and his five wives.
She explained their identities to her mother, which surprised Si Yingwu.

Then, Leng Xiaolian changed the pictures on the qi screen according to the memories Jia Yuyan shared with her before, and the existence of several demons in the Moonlit Passion Temple once again shocked Si Yingwu.
Leng Xiaolian explained to her mother their conversation with Zhang Fei in the dining room, and she also shared details about her earlier conversation with the four women.
"What do you think about them and their sect, Mother?"
"They’re really rare." Si Yingwu looked at the picture of Zhang Fei and his five women on the qi screen.
"I can’t recognize what kind of fox the man and his two wives are, but I feel that he is no ordinary fox.
Somehow, I feel there is something else about him, but I can’t confirm it.
Zhang Chen belongs to the light dragon race, which is quite rare in this realm.
As for Qi Qingxiu, her appearance is just a disguise, but I have never seen such a perfect disguise before, and I can’t guess her true identity.
Are you thinking of joining their sect, Xiaolan?"
"Hehe." Long Xiaolian giggled and hugged her mother.
"You know me well, Mother.
I’m bored of staying in this domain, and I want to explore other domains to broaden my horizon.
However, my father would never allow that, mainly because he’s afraid that outsiders will hunt me down and capture me.
That’s why I’m thinking of joining that sect, and I might find many new adventures by joining there."
Si Yingwu looked at her daughter and let out a soft sigh.
"I’ll talk to your father tomorrow morning and persuade him to let you join the sect.
I don’t know if he’ll agree, but you’ll have to take excellent care of yourself if he does."

chapters.title: Chapter 1450: Check The Building
paragraphs: Long Huoyan was already sitting on the bed with Huo Jinying, and his wife immediately told him about her conversation with Qi Qingxiu, including her real identity.

Long Huoyan was truly shocked upon hearing this. "I didn’t expect that the fox woman was not a beast; instead, she turned out to be Qi Qingxiu, the Seven Emotions Demon God. Moreover, her status as one of Zhang Fei’s wives was simply absurd, especially since their cultivation difference was too great."

"According to Qi Qingxiu, the strength that Zhang Fei showed us was not his true strength, and his true strength was much higher than that." Long Huoyan turned to Huo Jinying. "She didn’t explain the details to me, but she mentioned that her husband could defeat both of us if he used his true strength. I didn’t want to believe it at first, but his ability to gather all the races in one place was truly impressive, and he wouldn’t be able to do that without enough strength."

"Yes." Long Huoyan admitted that Zhang Fei’s actions were truly impressive, even though most of the members of the Moonlit Passion Temple came from the Three Mortal Realms. "In the past, Long Wuzhao once tried to unite all the races under his leadership, but he was unsuccessful because some races opposed his wishes, especially the winged race and the demon race. He ultimately decided to give up, and all races lived respectively in their domains, but the situation in this realm became more chaotic every year."
"Do you think we need to send members of our race to their sect?"

Long Huoyan had been thinking about that, but he felt hesitant about sending members of their race to the Moonlit Passion Sect, and members of their race would not necessarily agree with it due to the existence of demons in the sect.

"Or maybe we should send our family members to the sect?" Long Huoyan frowned at Huo Jinying. "Long Xiaolan is interested in joining the Moonlit Passion Sect, so I think we can let her join the sect, but we have to choose another person to accompany her."

Long Huoyan knew that Long Xiaolan was eager to join the Moonlit Passion Sect, but he would rather not take the risk. He was concerned that she might experience mistreatment at the sect due to the prejudice some races, particularly humans, have against demihumans.

Huo Jinying persuaded her husband again. "Husband, Long Xiaolan is already an adult, and there are many races there, including the beast and natural races. Moreover, we’ve seen the situation in the sect, and the relationship between the people there seems very harmonious. The humans of this realm have always been hostile to the demons, but they are not bothered by their presence, so I’m sure she won’t experience any ill-treatment there."

"That’s true." Long Huoyan didn’t deny her words, mainly because he had seen the situation in the Moonlit Passion Sect with his own eyes in the images Zhang Fei had shown him. However, he remained worried that his second daughter would be mistreated and ostracized by them because she came from the demihuman race, which would only hurt Long Xiaolan’s feelings. "I’ll talk to Si Yingwu first about this matter, and we should also talk to those people about some things."
"Alright." After that, the two of them went to rest because it was already late at night.
In the Soul-Devouring Demon, Nalan Shizhe looked at her two daughters as she sighed inwardly, especially since her daughters had already become Zhang Fei’s wives.

Nalan Huanzi also couldn’t believe that his big sister would become Zhang Fei’s wife as well, which meant that their demon race was now tied to him. Even so, he was happy that Nalan Wangzi didn’t have to suffer, especially since she would suffer if she married Mo Taizi.
"Why are you looking at me like that, Brother?" Nalan Wangzi asked with a playful smile.

Nalan Huanzi responded with a shake of his head. "I’m glad that you’ve finally found your happiness, Sister. If you marry Mo Taizi, you will definitely suffer like Shang Xueli, and you will live like a soulless doll just like her."
"Huh?" Nalan Wangzi turned to their mother. "Haven’t you told my brother about the situation of Shang Xueli and the Celestial Demon Race?"
Nalan Shizhe shook her head slightly. "Your brother just returned from taking care of some matters in several demon cities in our domain, so I haven’t told him about any of them."
"Did something happen to Shang Xueli and the Celestial Demon Race?" Nalan Huanzi asked them.

"Hahaha!" Nalan Yushu laughed at that. "You missed some important news about them, Big Brother. Our husband has already taken over the Celestial Demon Race after Mo Shentian decided to go to the Three Mortal Realms to look for Mo Tianshen, and he also freed Shang Xueli from her cage. The Asura Demon Princess has been staying with us for some time now, and he will use her as a bargaining chip to win the Asura Demon Race over to his side."

Nalan Huanzi was stunned upon hearing that, but Nalan Wangzi immediately told her something else. "The three princes of the Celestial Demon Race are already under our husband’s control, and he has also done something to Mo Zainan. She has already gotten rid of her husband’s men and imprisoned them, so Mo Shentian will have no control whatsoever if he successfully returns from the tunnel."
"What do you mean by that, Big Sis? Why can’t Mo Shentian return from the tunnel?" Nalan Huanzi asked in confusion.

"You’re too slow, Big Brother!" Nalan Yushu shouted as she shook her head. "Empress Huo has already done something to prevent Mo Shentian from exiting the tunnel, so he won’t be able to return to his domain for a while. Moreover, he’s on his way to the three Mortal Realms, and it will take him several years to get there, but he won’t be able to go there. Thus, he has no choice but to turn back to this realm, which will take another few years. This approach allows our husband to better prepare himself, increasing his chances of defeating him in the future."
Nalan Huanzi nodded in understanding. "In this way, five of the ten demon races are on Zhang Fei’s side, and—"

"Six, to be exact." Nalan Huanzi looked at their mother. "Zhang Fei has also controlled the Nine Nether Demon Race through Jiu Moze and Jiu Mozu, so they are also on his side. This way, only the Asura Demon Race, the Heavenly Fiend Demon Race, the Torture Demon Race, and the Ten Thousand Eyes Demon Race remain. However, those four demon races are difficult to deal with, especially Sha Mo, the Heavenly Fiend Demon God."

"Phew." Nalan Huanzi took a few deep breaths, mainly because Zhang Fei’s actions were too swift. He had already secured the support of more than half the demon races, and he only needed to win the rest over to his side, but that wasn’t easy because their four demon gods had great ambitions. "Mother! Sisters! I’m going to rest now, so you three can talk."
After Nalan Huanzi left, Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi stood up, both pulling their mother with them. "What are you two doing?"
"Hehe." Nalan Yushu laughed. "We just want to be with you, and the three of us will sleep together tonight."
"We want to discuss some things with you, but we’ll discuss them in your room." Nalan Wangzi said.

Nalan Shizhe raised her eyebrows, and she had a bad feeling because of the mysterious attitude of her two daughters. Moreover, they had once said that they wanted to draw her to Zhang Fei’s side to become his wife, but she had never thought of marrying any man, let alone becoming the wife of her son-in-law and sharing her husband with her two daughters.

Upon arriving at the bedroom, Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi pulled their mother to lie down between them, but Nalan Shizhe’s previous suspicions were wrong because her two daughters did not talk about Zhang Fei. Instead, they discussed some other things, which concerned the future of their Soul-Devouring Demon.

In the morning, Zhang Fei took his five wives to see the building Long Huoyan had given him. To their surprise, Long Xiaolian decided to join them, and she had a great time talking with the five women, especially Qi Qingxiu.
Jia Yuyan teased Zhang Fei about Long Xiaolian, but he has no interest in her, at least for now. He liked female beasts, but he didn’t really like female demihumans.

The building’s location was very strategic because it was located in the market center of the capital of the demihuman kingdom. Zhang Fei saw many demihumans passing by the building, and he felt that it was suitable for his shop.

Many demihumans stopped in front of the building and looked inside, curious about Zhang Fei and his five women’s activities. However, they quickly left after seeing Long Xiaolian with them, and they could guess their purpose inside the building.
"Feng Shanxi and a few of them have already arrived at this domain."
